...Didn't I mention I lived on the streets, Penny? I don't know what you expected of me.
...I'm sorry to shatter your illusions, Penny, but there's no such thing as a pirate who's above violence.
...Fighting is how criminals settle things, Penny. Why you expected anything else from me, I can't imagine.
...Did you have frequent issues with in-gang fighting, Saki? You ought to be a better leader.
...You should work on your leadership skills if you had girls fighting amongst themselves, Saki.
Both in your gang? I fought random girls on the streets...you need to keep your subordinates in line.
...I would never tolerate fighting among my pilots. You need to help them redirect their anger towards their enemies.
...That may be true, Sakura, but we're not part of Franchouchou. I think the violence is over for now.
...Did you say something, Sakura? Revy and I had a personal dispute...and we resolved it the way we know.
...Franchouchou may not be about violence, Sakura, but some girls' lives are. And we settle things that way.
...Don't look so shocked, Sakura. Your life is about singing...a pirate's life is about violence.
...I'm sorry, Streaming-chan, but I think that's all the fighting we needed for now. We'll still be naked, at least.
...I'm sorry to disappoint your viewers, but our fight is over... temporarily. I suggest you zoom in on our breasts.
It seems I finally provided what your audience was looking for, Streaming-chan...at least for a while.
...Well, then. All it took to win over your audience was for me to act like a typical pirate for once...not that it lasted.
...I think we've called a truce for now, Streaming-chan. That's good for me...but your viewers probably like blood.
...Fistfighting in a bar to drunken jeers...just like old times.
...Fighting for a crowd of half-nude girls. I never thought Earth and Mejare could be so similar.
...I have more than enough experience fighting bar thugs for jeering drunks.
...Half-nude, drunken girls cheering on a fistfight is just another day on the underbelly of Mejare.
...Would those two be men on your ship, Nami? I would expect as much from them...but women can be just as violent.
...Men fight on your ship, Nami? Ours get along just fine...it's the girls who are always fighting.
...I'm sorry if you thought that men were the only ones prone to violence, Nami. In my experience, they fight less...
...I'm sorry about that, Nami. Maybe men fight more on this planet...Mejare will teach you how brutal women can be.
...I'm sorry to shatter any illusions you had of humans being a peaceful race, Caulifla. Though you seem to prefer it this way.
...I'm sure you're proud of your race's violent tendencies, Caulifla...but humans are no strangers to that, either.
...Maybe humans and Saiyans aren't so different after all, Caulifla. I'm glad you're feeling at home on this planet.
...I may boast about humanity's engineering, Caulifla, but some humans survive on violence...like Saiyans do, right?
...So, explosions of violence make Earth feel like home for a Saiyan. The same is true for me...and many humans.
...There's no need to intervene, Starfire. That should be all we needed.
...That won't be necessary, Starfire. Revy and I understand each other a little better now.
...I fail to see how you forcing us apart would help matters, Starfire. I think we've worked things out.
...I'm sure you're anxious to exert your strength, Starfire, but Revy and I needed to settle that alone.
...I'm sorry to have instigated that in our friendly card game, Jessie. But it's how younger women can be.
...You'd best stay out of this, Jessie. I'm sure you're past the age where you settle things this way.
...An older woman chastising me for fighting? It's like I never left the ship.
...This is where age has matured you, Jessie. I still fight to solve my problems.
...I should've known men would find some sort of pleasure in seeing girls fight in the nude...
...Men really are barbaric. Two girls try to kill each other, and you salivate over our nude bodies...
...I know a few girls who might cheer a nude fistfight, but a man doing so doesn't surprise me in the slightest.
..."So hot"? Leave it to a man to see only bouncing breasts when girls trade punches...
...I'm sorry you had to see this, Rin. Some girls have to live lives of violence to survive.
...Are you alright, Rin? Make sure you stay in school...so you don't make your living fighting thugs in the nude.
...It's a shame we had to do this in front of a schoolgirl. Focus on your art, Rin---don't end up like Revy and me.
...Rin. If you ever feel like you don't fit in, remember that you haven't sunk to nude barfighting. Revy and I are the ones who don't belong.
...You seem lost in thought, Arash. I would've expected a man to cheer senseless violence...but then, it's women who're committing it.
...How hypocritical of Mejare to paint men as violent beasts. Here we are, two girls fighting naked over nothing---that man Arash hasn't even spoken.
...Do you have something to say, Arash? You've already risen past Mejare's view of men---staying calm as women fight like animals.
...This scene certainly turns Mejare's worldview around. That man Arash is standing civilized on the sidelines, watching two girls pointlessly scrap.
...I hope this is providing good entertainment, Merlin. It must be amusing to watch girls fight when we think ourselves so civilized.
...Watching nude girls fistfight must be like seeing stray cats claw at each other to a man. Or are you laughing for other reasons, Merlin?
...That man Merlin is laughing at us. Fighting nude is already an indignity, but I guess a man wouldn't see us as even a threat.
...Is it true that men see violence as sport, Merlin? It would explain your laughter---and watching two nude girls must make this all the better.
...I hope this doesn't really excite you, Mary. A girl your age shouldn't idolize pirates and punks...I did, and you can see the result.
...This is "doing things" for you, Mary? Unless your life goal is to fistfight in the nude for onlookers, you shouldn't see Revy and me as role models.
...I'm surprised you work in a place with constant violence, Lucy. I would discipline my pilots for petty violence.
...Any group with violent infighting will quickly disintegrate, Lucy. You should curb that problem in your guild---my Dread team could never function like that.
...Don't you fight for a living, Joe? Me and Revy trading blows shouldn't leave you in such a panic...
We're always taught not to fight men hand-to-hand...they tend to be bigger and stronger. Yet a trained male boxer is cowering at the sight of us...
...It's rude to insert yourself into every situation, Moon. Be quiet...did the picture come out alright, Mahiru?
...You may want to keep your camera clear of Moon, Mahiru, or she won't let you leave. In any case...how did the picture come out?
...The last thing I want is a memory of you, Moon. The childish way you describe your own perversion is disturbing.
...Tch! Don't try to muscle your way into a picture, Moon. Your stench is bad enough...I'm sorry, Mahiru. How does it look?
...You're right, Pyrrha, I should have smiled. Regardless, did it come out alright, Mahiru?
...I should have smiled, Pyrrha. It just...doesn't come naturally to me. Does the photo look acceptable without that, Mahiru?
...How does it look, Mahiru? I may have gotten camera-shy...maybe you and Myriam should compare angles.
...Does the picture look alright, Mahiru? I haven't taken one in a while...with Myriam's, I guess that makes two.

condition.saying: Number Two is actually our leader

case.state: Saki is your leader? She doesn't seem mature enough for that...unless she just shouted the others down.
...Was Saki chosen to be your leader? She seems more likely to shout at you for crying than boost morale.
...Saki is your group's leader? She does seem like the type to appoint herself...and you seem like the type to let her.
...Saki? She reminds me more of my pilot Barnette...too proud to accept others' views. Did you all agree to this?
...I don't think it's healthy to be so ashamed of your body, Florina. There's no harm in a picture with another girl...
...Well, this is meant to be a social event, Florina. Is it men who've taught you to be so ashamed?
...I'm doing my best to loosen up a bit, Florina. Mahiru is at least a woman---I wouldn't have accepted a man's invitation.
...I'm not thrilled about it, Florina, but I doubt it'll reach the crew. Why are you so embarrassed? Men's influence?
...Jura, is this a roundabout way of matchmaking me and Sei? Some of the men we know are more upstanding than she is...
...Jura, I understand that you want me to date Sei, but bringing up men just makes them look better. Male soldiers seem disciplined.
I am not about to date this girl, Jura, even if you bring up men by comparison. In fact, I might actually prefer a man...they're more principled.
...What's this really about, Jura? Are you trying to compare Sei to a man? Because my opinion of male soldiers has actually improved lately...
...I see. But I have no interest in fighting you...unless you adopt Revy's aggression.
I agree you have the size advantage---a lot like our quartermaster. But there was no need to "put that to the test." Not with you.
I'd rather not test my strength unnecessarily. My quarrel is with Revy, not you...so don't speculate on the sidelines.
...And if you're not willing to initiate that "test," then don't interject. This was an issue between me and Revy.
...You might have different standards for the kind of girl who ends up in piracy, Nami. I used to get in fights all the time.
...Why would you expect better of pirates, Nami? Where I'm from, a girl who gets in fights is exactly who ends up living that life.
...If an archer's role is to swiftly end fights, Arash, then why didn't you step between me and Revy?
...I guess if your role as an archer is to end fights, Arash, then Revy and I fighting must have been too entertaining for you to have done so.
Arash...if archers bring peace to a fight, is that only between men? You showed no interest in my fight with Revy.
"Relaxing" isn't how Jura sold this to me, Nayru. She told me we'd learn about men here...
I'm only here because Jura said we'd learn about Earth and men, Nayru. She just hopes I'll relax.
I appreciate the invitation to relax, Nayru. Jura wants to me relax, but I'm here to see what men look like.
I usually relax in our spa...poker doesn't relax me, Nayru. Jura got me here by playing to our curiosity about men.
You would have to put a baby in me. It's quite clear you lack the responsibility to carry it.
I would accept me being the Fama between us. I shudder to think how you'd handle carrying a child.
Well, I would certainly never put a baby in you. You'd probably drink while pregnant.
If it were between the two of us, you should absolutely put the baby in me. You're too drunk to be Fama material.
Babies are delicate things, Sei. I'm certainly more fit to carry one than you are.
On Mejare, couples have to choose who carries the baby. She'd be much better off with me.
Miss Jessie...how long do you intend to torture her, Tharja? You've made your point, and even brought her to tears.
...Miss Jessie, don't give her the satisfaction of seeing you beg. That's what she wants, to feed her own ego.
...Just put her right already, Tharja. She's crying, for God's sake. Or do you intend to shrink her completely flat?
Miss Jessie...don't start crying. You're more than your breasts---she wants submission from you, all for her own delusions!

state.text: A colder kind of sex appeal... that sounds about right.
...Sex without connection. When you put it like that, Jura...it fits.

case.state: "Aggressive men and calm women"...my homeworld would have you believe men and women are each monoliths of personality.
...You two know each other? You're wearing the same uniform...but Monika actually looks like an adult.
...Monika, don't bring your younger classmates to strip poker games. This is for adults.
The same uniform? ...Don't tell me this is some kind of perverted school field trip. Natsuki doesn't even look old enough.
I was about to comment on the look in your eyes, Monika, but I'm more worried about your underage schoolmate.
I'm not sure which schoolgirl fits in less here...the one who doesn't act mature, or the one who doesn't look mature.
Just what this table needed---two classmates that either look like children or act like children.
I'm not sure who tell to leave first---Natsuki, who looks underage, or Sayori, who acts underage.
I was afraid I'd get stuck with Earth schoolgirls in over their heads. Natsuki, you don't look like an adult. Sayori, you seem far too naive for this game.
Jura...I didn't want to draw attention to it, even if these are strangers.
...Earth is still a hostile planet, Jura. My birthday won't give us special treatment.
Jura...yes, it's my birthday. I agreed to come here so I'd only have one crewmate hounding me about it.
...My birthday is none of their concern, Jura. We're just strangers here, anyway.
...I know the crew throws me a party every year, Jura, but some strangers on Earth won't care it's my birthday.
...I can witness explosions back home. In any case, it's nice to hear that, Misato.
...And some Earth women feel the need to interject. I'm glad you're open to meeting other girls, Misato.
...Try to ignore her, Misato. You're very attractive, even by my Mejarian standards.
...And blow each other up with explosion magic, yes. If you ever decide men aren't worth the trouble, Misato, you'd fit in on Mejare.
I think you're a bit mistaken, Daria. We're descendants from Earth people who colonized other planets.
Daria, how do you think we got to Mejare? Our ancestors were people from Earth who colonized it.
Jura and I are not inhuman, Daria. The first women on Mejare were settlers from Earth.
Daria, do you think we simply sprung up on Mejare? We're descendants of its original Earth colonists.
You think we haven't seen each other nude? The ship has one shower and one spa.
Nude girls aren't exactly startling to Mejarians...especially crewmates with communal showers.
I wish I wasn't so comfortable seeing Jura nude.
We're not friends. We're colleagues...and pirates don't get private showers.
Show up to flight practice on time, and I couldn't care less what you tell her.
Jura is a lot more eager to be here. I would've given her permission if she cared to ask for it.
By all means, Jura, you don't need my go-ahead. Keep Daria busy while I work.
This is a perfect arrangement. You answer Daria's questions about Mejare, and I get some scheduling done.
Come home with---tch. You should try disavowing your military and working for us. That way you'd help women.
Nothing will make me come home with you, Sei. Your technological experience would make you a good asset for us, however.
Tch. Maybe I'd warm up to you if you cast off your loyalties...our crew could use a tech-proficient medic.
...You should come home with us. We need more medical staff, and you could work with a clean conscience.
~blank~
...You don't need to insult her to prove your loyalty, Jura. She's just making jabs.
...She's not worth it, Jura. She's just trying to make herself feel better.

Huh?
...Well, if you're not with Barnette, you're with me. I guess you know when to give me some space.

Jura...?
...We make a pretty good team. And---I guess we do hang out together.
You're not going to undermine me by asking my pilots, Erufuda. They wouldn't try to throw me birthday parties if they hated me.
Asking my team members what they think isn't going to win you the argument, Erufuda. Besides, I trust them not to undermine me...thank you, Jura.
I trust my pilots to tell me if they have criticisms, Erufuda. Gossiping behind my back would only compromise missions---so they wouldn't do it with you, either.
I think we've all been treating each other better lately, Erufuda. Maybe it's because we have the men to gossip about.
I've actually heard less gossip in the changing rooms lately, Erufuda. At least about each other---it's mostly what the men are up to.
Today's my twentieth birthday. Girls were always surprised to learn I was a teenager--- and way too eager to throw me a party.
I actually turn twenty today. I figured this was better than dealing with another surprise party.
...Jura. Jura, come in. Can you sense anything---off about your game? I mean---in your head.
...Jura? I think I might be under attack. Can you---feel anything? You know what I mean.
Jura told me about it, Neptune. Apparently the Paksis is linked to certain points in spacetime---so we took a chance.
...That's correct, Dust. Men tend to have a more curious reaction to hearing that...
...Mejare was intentionally settled by only women, Dust, so yes. You look somewhat frightened by that fact...
...Hm. When we've told other non-Tarakkians that Mejare has no men, they get excited at the prospect...not scared.
...Do you prefer other men's company, Dust? Men typically perk up when they hear that Mejare is all women...
J-Jura, are you alright? I warned you that girl is insane---! (...If she makes another move, yes, I agree.)
You're...large again? Do you feel the same? (...We can't just kill her on a hostile planet, Jura. Not unless we have to.)
Damn it, now what---oh, you're...back to normal? (If she reaches for that book again, I agree. She's too dangerous.)
...Oh, she fixed them. It was strange, having larger than breasts than you for a moment there...(if she attacks again, there's no other choice.)
Jura and I are part of a pirate crew, not a proper military with uniforms. I choose to wear our standard-issue pilot suit and wing commander armor, but it's her decision.
Jura is a high-ranking ensign pilot, and as such isn't particularly encouraged to wear our standard flightsuit. Pirates don't strive for uniformity the way a military does.
You speak as if you have experience piloting a fighter craft. Our Dreads have plenty of legroom for a dress to not hinder control.
That's an odd thing to focus on---I assume you have no piloting experience yourself. If wearing a dress hindered Jura's ability to pilot a Dread, I'd order her to stop.
A Dread cockpit doesn't interfere with a dress in any way. I'm not sure why you would assume otherwise, except for maybe exposure to military.
...I am Jura's superior officer, not her girlfriend. Do not misinterpret my coming here as more than security.
I am not Jura's girlfriend. Earth is a known hostile planet, and so I accompanied her here as a safety measure.
It would be foolish for Jura to have come here alone---she is an outlaw, and Earth is hostile territory. As Dread team leader, she is my responsibility.
This was Jura's idea---I am only here to protect her. As long as her romantic life does not compromise our team, it is none of my business.
Jura is my second-ranking pilot---I came here with her for her own safety. Her flirting habits are beside the point.
...Natsuki, how long have you hung around Monika? There might be a reason you're underweight.
...Have you always been this size, Natsuki? I get the feeling hanging around this girl would make me lose weight, too.
...Jura, did you feel that? The weird sense of pressure---!
U-ugh---Jura, you feel it, too, don't you? Something's not right...
I can multitask, Jura...
I'm playing the game, aren't I? There's plenty of downtime.
We're just getting started, Jura...
I don't want to be behind an entire ~background.time~. It's just the early rounds...
...I'll do things my way, Jura, and you do them yours.
...What's the purpose of this challenge? This game already takes away our privacy.
...Stripping nude is a reveal of our secrets already. Why are you posing this?
I came prepared to answer probing questions about my homeworld---and to field threats of being probed. Why do you want more?
...Why are you challenging us? Matching our physical secrets with emotional ones?
...We'll see how your challenge plays out. Just be aware you're negotiating with a pirate.
...Know that I'm a pirate, Mulan. I will honor your terms...if it's convenient for me.
...With how our people dress, I'm at a disadvantage already. We'll see if a pirate honors your challenge.
...The "Chinese" would honor that challenge, wouldn't you? Well, I am a pirate...and "honor" is whatever benefits me.
...I'm fine, Haru. Nothing to worry about...and I started it as much as Revy did.
Hoo...I wasn't sure I could still do that. Just relax, Haru---I instigated it, too.
...I think Revy and I have settled our differences, Haru. I'm equally at fault for that...
...Relax, Haru, it's over. I called Revy out...and we connected.
...My arm's a bit numb, Haru, but that's what I get for calling Revy out. It seems she's strong, after all.
...I'm fine, Haru. In fact, I think Revy and I both feel better... maybe we could spar sometime.
...I'm fine, Haru. I can handle myself in a fight---and so can Revy. Maybe more than I can...
...Don't worry about me, Haru. That was all Revy and I needed...I hope.
I'm not hurt, Haru...luckily. I hate to say it, but Revy would probably overpower me in the end.
...No, Haru, it's fine. I think we're finished now...which is probably lucky for me.
...I think that's all the fighting we needed, Haru. I called Revy a coward, and she proved she wasn't.
...I think we're finished, Haru. Our guns are still nearby, so I suggest you leave the owners out of this.
...There's no need to call the owners, Haru. We're done... and I'd rather not have the police ruin my stay on Earth.
Take it easy, Haru...the fighting's over. Better we did it now, without our weapons.
...Revy and I understand each other much better now, Haru. Be glad it wasn't a shootout.
Just relax, Haru...this is the way pirates tend to settle things. At least we didn't have our guns on hand.
...It's fine, Haru. That could've been a shootout had we fought any sooner---I'll take a numbed arm.
...I think Revy and I both needed that, Haru. The way we live, it's either guns or fists...be happy with the latter.
The life of a pirate doesn't stop for games, Ryuji. But I think things are settled for now.
Yes...we're playing poker. Violence follows a criminal wherever she goes...but it's done. For now.
Tch...I didn't think a man would be lecturing me on being violent...but I guess that's a pirate's life.
...It's alright, Ryuji. That was all Revy and I needed. Poker or not, our whole lives have been about fighting.
...A man, telling me to stop fighting? I guess I've never met a civilian man before...my life's too violent for that.
Earth has made a habit of invading Mejare, Jessie. And I am defending myself, as usual.
I believe Revy was the aggressor here, Jessie. That's typical of Earth and Mejare's diplomacy.
...You don't need to worry about a Mejarian invasion, Jessie. Earth, as usual, is the aggressor here.
...Revy is doing her best to invade me, Jessie. So it goes for Earth and Mejare, as well.
...Be quiet, Moon. The last thing we need is another of your childish cries for attention.
...I'm surprised, Moon. I expected you to cheer for me and Revy to have sex---preferably with you.
...We're not fighting because of you, Moon. But on the subject, your immature sex addiction is quite grating.
...If you want to have sex, Moon, then find someone who loves you. As you can see, this is a place for drifters who fight to survive.
...No, Moon, this isn't your fault. Revy and I were never going to get along---now stand clear.
...We should be done for now, Ryuko. Take care to not become a criminal like me and Revy...this is the life we have to lead.
...You're right, Ryuko. This is the life pirates lead...often without much dignity. Don't fall into it.
...There's no need for you to get involved, Cynthia. That should be all Revy and I needed to sort out our differences.
...That won't be necessary, Cynthia. Nor do I see how siccing an animal on us will defuse the situation, regardless of your talent as its trainer.
...In my experience, Cynthia, animals are used as attackers and escape options rather than peacemakers. I believe we're done here regardless.
...We seem to have angered the crazed lunatic. I don't suppose you want to dispatch her before continuing?
...Jason looks eager to bring her machete into this. Shall we double-team her for a moment?
...No, they're not much different at all, Jolyne. I guess every planet has a place for girls who don't fit in anywhere else.
...I should've figured as much, Jolyne. Even Mejare, with all its beauty, has an underbelly for woman criminals. Earth would be the same.
...Have I finally started to "brawl" to your liking, Brock? After all you've said, I thought it'd take more than a nude fistfight.
...It sounds as if Brock is used to this sort of spectacle. I wish I could say that bothered me at the moment.
...Why are you so concerned with us, Stella? For some girls, this is how we resolve our differences.
...What would fighting you accomplish, Stella? Our quarrel is with each other.
...There's no need for you to get involved, Pyrrha. Nor do I see why you would want to.
...You're more noble than I am, Pyrrha. I wouldn't bother breaking up a barfight between two girls I barely know.
...Your job is to break up fights between strangers, Stella? What exactly do you do for a living?

state.text: I'm not sure what you're implying, Chara. Are you saying you manipulated us into fighting?
...If you're implying our fight is the result of your manipulations, Chara, I've hardly paid attention to you.
...You can claim to have orchestrated this, Chara, but Revy and I were never going to get along.

case.state: ...We're fine, Yuri. I'm sure we've both been in much worse fights than that.
...It's over now, Yuri. Besides, I think that was tame by both of our standards.
...You don't need to get involved, Lucina. Any more fighting would be pointless.
...Stay out of this, Marth. This between me and her, and I doubt a man would understand.
...You can relax, Bernadetta. You keep glancing between us as if there's someone to root for---there isn't.
...You don't need to worry about us fighting, Bernadetta. Nor do you need to give me that hopeful look. I'm no better than she is.
...You're right, Lyralei. This should be friendly. That's why I waited until our weapons were gone.
This could've been much less friendly if we were still armed, Lyralei. It was better this way.
...I'm no better than she is, Yusuke. It's funny, though---fighting is how I've earned the respect of the other men I've met.
...You shouldn't root for either of us, Yusuke. But I guess it's always been in combat that I've won a man's favor.
...It's funny how words can change, Wikipe-tan. On Mejare, a "catfight" is between two beautiful girls who ought to know better.
...Where I'm from, Wikipe-tan, this isn't a catfight. It's just two thugs trading blows.
...It'd actually be flattering for you to call this a catfight back home, Wikipe-tan. Catfights are for girls too pretty to have brawls.
...Are you enjoying this, Bobobo? I don't suppose you could show me how to trip Revy with my nosehair.
...It looks like Bobobo is recording this. You'd think he'd be entertained enough by his own nosehair.
...Men can certainly be strange. I understand settling things with our fists, but not why a man who fights with his nosehair would care.
...You look concerned, Miku. If you're worried about your image, we can take this elsewhere.
...Don't worry about this reflecting on you, Miku. It sounds like Revy and I have always been criminals.
...Ngh. Don't get involved, Penny. I wouldn't want some android settling things for us.
...Thank you, Penny, but I can handle this. A robot ending the fight wouldn't leave us with any kind of understanding.
...If you stand clear, Fina, no one else will get hurt. This is the kind of thing that only involves girls like us.
...Just stay back, Fina. Revy and I are the types to settle things this way. No one else needs to get involved.
...Stringing us up won't solve anything, Gwen. Let us settle things on our own.
...This is the only way Revy and I are going to communicate, Gwen. You'd only be delaying the fight.
...Cheered on by some wisecracking girl. It's like I'm back home in the slums.
...Maybe it's just the way you talk, Kumatora, but it reminds me of the hecklers on Mejare.
...This is none of your business, Trixie. Sometimes breaking up a fight just makes things worse.
...My captain likes to let us sort out our differences on our own, Trixie. You could learn from her.
...The last thing we need is a man butting in, Dunban. I'd think you'd understand.
...Don't men learn things by fighting? Stay out of this, Dunban.
...We'll see if that was enough, Juno.

This is between us, Juno.
...And it might be over with.
...People have fought since the dawn of time, Rosie. You should know.
..If you've studied history, Rosie, then you've seen plenty of fighting.
...You say that like it's not good entertainment, Rosie.
...This is the kind of thing card-players come to see, Rosie.
...Sorry, Priscilla, but I think the show's already over.
...You're easily amused, Priscilla. Or maybe you were expecting more...
We'd heard about Earth's animals in my time, but not its animal-people. I hope they did manage to find their way off-surface.
It doesn't bode well for animal-people's future that we've never seen their kind out on any colonies.
...At least this bar is clean and comfortable. I don't care for bright lights...or constant chatter.
I can appreciate this bar, at least. I wasn't expecting a dim alcove for us to play in...
At least this place had the courtesy to seclude us. I couldn't get work done in a crowded casino hall, much less strip naked...
...I have to admit, the space they gave us to play in is perfect. Secluded...dim...quiet.
..."The Inventory." What are they stockpiling here to give a bar that name?
Maybe we should raid this place before we leave, Jura...calling it "the Inventory" is tempting.
Hmm...I was actually worried they'd make us strip in a large hall with tables everywhere. This is much better...

state.text: What a hassle that outfit was. I can't believe you wear that kind of jewelry every day, Jura.
...Much better. Jura---how can you stand all that stuff bouncing on you all the time?

That still didn't feel like enough.
...Maybe this'll do the trick.

I think you're overreac---mm! I---I see. That's indeed...appropriate for a stripping game. You squirmed in such a cute way...
Are you feeling alright, Nay---mm. I see now...and I see that you're a beautiful girl.
It's just a song---oh. Oh...Nayru, I'm never this forward, but the way your hair flowed as you played your harp...was something else.
W-what is that? Like a deformed decoy...I won't doubt your magic again.
...Your music really is magical. Making a decoy could actually be very useful for a pilot.
...A magical song indeed. It'd be nice to have a silent decoy of myself for Jura to bother.
Is that...some magical doll of yourself? Like a soulless husk of a girl...
Piloting is thrilling...especially with a man. I've sat right up against Hibiki in my Vandread---wait, why'd I say that?
I...don't like tight spaces, but I feel safe in my Dread. Safe enough to masturba---w-what am I saying?
...So the song's effect is that you reveal secrets? I'd never say how I've masturbated to the thought of men's---mm!
I flew a long way here, after all. I'm curious what men's seed tastes like---d-did I just say that out loud?
Don't bother, "Veran." I'm not interested in prostrating myself before some strange shadow.
Do you expect me to kneel at your feet, "Veran"? Displays of power don't impress me---I've seen plenty from the Mejarian empire.
You must think you have some authority over me, "Veran." There a few women I answer to, and you're not one of them.
Flattery? I'm a pirate, "Veran." I don't kneel before the first woman to claim authority.
My suit? ...So, men enjoy seeing the female form, too. For an Earth girl, you have a low opinion of them...
...Hm. If I regard men as beasts, you seem to think of them as little more than perverts. I thought Earth girls liked them...
...Have men wronged you in the past, Revy? You're much more cynical about them than I expected of the women here...
...So even after centuries of contact, men lust after women's bodies, and women assume them perverts. Unless that's just you...
I am not interested in throwing away my humanity. And I don't think you are, either---just in scaring girls into leaving you alone.
...Is that really what you want? You still have enough humanity to come here...strip naked...and ask us questions.
...No sane woman could ever take that much pleasure in killing. But pretending to is certainly a good defense mechanism.
...Some of my pilots do try to act sadistic. But we can tell it's a front...and in time, they admit their vulnerability.
...Sei, are you saying Earth girls can get pregnant by accident? Men are more trouble than they're worth...
Why would you want to stop pregnancy? On Mejare, getting pregnant is a conscious, informed decision.
...Sei...with a man, then, you can sometimes unintentionally get pregnant? Just another reason to avoid them...
...If I'm interpreting this correctly, Sei, then Earth girls can have accidental pregnancies. ...Unthinkable on Mejare.
...Twilight, you asked earlier about this. I use it to map out flight patterns and keep records on our pilots' performance.
...You commented on my tablet earlier, Twilight? At the moment, I'm comparing our pilots' target elimination rates...
...Twilight, you wanted to know about my tablet. It's just a personal data tool...I make sure the squadron is being efficient.
...This is the tablet you wanted to see earlier, Twilight. I'm analyzing my team's shot accuracy and fuel usage rates.
..."Condoms"? What are those? Something that controls birth?
...What's a condom? Why are you all hushed up about it?
...No, I don't know. You could be more considerate of a girl who isn't from Earth and doesn't know what condoms are.
...What is it about sex with men that makes Earth girls get all quiet? And what's a condom?
...I'm not sure what you mean, Nayru, but holding onto the past is a horrible way to live. What's lost is lost.
That's a strange mindset, Nayru...never letting go of anything. I tried that, and it made me miserable.
I think it may be better to not hold onto false hope, Nayru. Whatever powers you have, losing things helps you grow.
Are you saying you possess some sort of power, Nayru? That sounds dangerous...never having to let anything go.
You shouldn't be so quick to judge others, Raven, but then I guess my stoicism didn't do me any favors.
Maybe it's my own fault for being unfriendly, Raven. But it's not in my nature to back down.
It's alright, Raven. I know I don't exude much approachability...nor do I mean to.
It takes a strong girl to admit she was wrong, Raven. Besides...I acted just as callously. Just my job spilling over...
...What are you implying, Ochako? I was not the product of some cynical experiment like these Quirk Marriages.
Are you implying I was bred, Ochako? I don't know what "Quirk Marriages" are, but Mejarians are not eugenicists.
My parents loved me, Ochako. I was not the product of a "Quirk Marriage," or whatever you call eugenics on Earth...
..."Quirk Marriages"? My parents were together by love, not eugenics, Ochako. Don't you dare imply otherwise.
These "Quirk Marriages" sound exactly like the cruel conduct I expect from Earth. And I resent the notion that women can't fall in love...
Typical of Earth to reduce children to something so cynical...I assure you, Ochako, women can be together without a "Quirk Marriage."
I should've known Earth would conduct cruel experiments and call them "Quirk Marriages." Love between two women can run deeper than that...
At least you see the cruelty in Earth's methods, Ochako. Still, you seem convinced women can't fall in love without it being a "Quirk Marriage."
I've learned to respect some men, Elizabeth. As for injustices...well, the first man I ever saw was a dead one.
Mejare's government has hurt me more than a man ever did, Elizabeth. Actually, the first man I ever saw in person was a corpse.
Elizabeth, I have a...complicated relationship with men. It wasn't until I joined the pirates that I saw one...a dead one.
I've fought plenty of men, Elizabeth, but the same is true of women. The first man I ever saw in person was a dead soldier.
Is that so? I think you've been interested in me this entire time, Sei...I have more deniability.
You can try to turn this around on me, Sei, but I haven't been drinking and flirting all night.
"In a few drinks" shouldn't take much time at all, Sei. That's why I don't like you very much.
You're not interested in me after I show the slightest interest back? And you accuse me of playing hard-to-get...
..."Murders." Do you have something more to share about this place, Ini?
...Are "murders" the only reason you know about that temple, Ini?
...You recommended me the site of a recent murder. I shouldn't bother speaking to you.
...Murders must have been quite devastating to your community. But apparently not to you.
...Tomoko. You said something about "boys" on this planet? Why should I be concerned with male children?
...Tomoko. What did you mean by suggesting I go see "boys"? Do girls mate with men much younger than them?
...What did you say earlier, Tomoko? "Boys" are male children, right? That seems...inappropriate.
...I meant landmarks to see on Earth, Tomoko, not men. ...Actually, aren't "boys" child men? Are girls not meant to date men their age?
...Tomoko, what did you recommend earlier? "Anuh-may"? I used to watch animation when I was a girl, if that's what you mean... Mejarian superwomen.
"Anuh-may," you said, Tomoko? If that's Earth slang for animation, I watched cartoons as a girl. Mostly starring brave fighter pilots...
...Did you mean to say "animation" earlier, Tomoko? That reminds me of the cartoons I watched as a girl... brave forces of women foiling men's plans.
...Tomoko, what is that "anuh-may" you told me about? Mejare has animation for young girls, if you meant that...heroic women in starfighters.
...I agree with what you said earlier, Tomoko. This game will prove interesting---but I meant sights outside of nudity. Landmarks and such.
Do you know of any Earth landmarks, Tomoko? I played this game to see the "other" sights you brought up.
...I'm aware of the "sights" strip poker can offer, Tomoko. I came here for a reason...men's tubes and such. But what about the planet itself?
...This is your homeworld, Tomoko. Surely there's more to it than the nude bodies of its people---which I'm already experiencing.
...Flutter, you asked about my tablet, right? I use it to store and analyze the performance data of my pilots.
Dita's shot accuracy has been going up...Flutter, you expressed interest in this tablet? I'm organizing squadron data with it.
...Flutter. You wanted to know more about this device? It's a personal data organizer---Dread team leaders are given them to manage pilot information.
...Flutter, you brought up my tablet earlier. It's just a simple personal computer---I track pilot efficiency and lethality figures with it.
...For the record, Flutter, I don't expect my laser ring to malfunction. But as this is a hostile planet, I want to make sure I'm armed.
...If my ring were to malfunction, Flutter, it simply wouldn't work. But Earth is too dangerous a planet to be without a weapon.
...Flutter, you sounded worried about my laser ring malfunctioning. The only one who would be in danger would be me, unarmed on a foreign world.
...A pirate cannot afford to be stuck on a hostile world without a functioning weapon, Flutter. This place alone seems to house dangerous threats.
...Laser rings are reliable firearms, Flutter. I don't expect any malfunctions...but still, being stuck on Earth would be the worst time for one.
It's easy for you to say nothing bad will happen, Flutter. Our crew has been attacked by forces from Earth many times now.
"Nothing bad will happen"...a likely story from an Earth girl. Earth fleets have attacked our ship numerous times now.
I hope you're only ignorant of my situation, Flutter. I'm wary of this planet because Earth has regularly sent fleets after us.
I am an officer on a ship targeted by Earth for opposing its Harvest fleets, Flutter. Don't tell me "nothing bad" will happen if I'm unarmed...
..."Have fun." From an Earth girl, any reassurance is disingenuous. This planet has made a target out of our crew.
It's not in my best interest or my job description to "have fun," Flutter...especially on a known aggressive planet.
...I appreciate your wish for me to relax, Flutter, but it's hard to do so unarmed on a hostile world. Earth does not tolerate our crew's resistance.
..."Have fun" is something my crewmates tell me, as well, Flutter. But I am an officer of a ship resisting Earth---I'm vulnerable here.
...I am frequently busy, Flutter, yes. Leading a Dread team is a lot of work, so I'm multitasking.
...It was not my idea to come here, Flutter, so I am behind on work in addition to being generally busy.
...I am busy, Flutter, but it's none of your concern. As Dread team leader, I'm accustomed to multitasking to ease my workload.
...It's true that my work as Dread commander keeps me busy, Flutter. Being a pirate doubles that...so I'm taking advantage of lulls in the game.
...I don't have time to be playing this, Flutter. But I can manage my workload---even if I may have to sacrifice some sleep.
...I don't have time for many hobbies in general, Flutter. I do my best just to make time for exercise.
...My personal time is a low priority regardless, Flutter. Leadership leaves little time for that.
...Thank you for your concern earlier, Flutter, but my time management is not an issue. I exercise, eat, work, and sleep.
...I'm sorry if I angered you, Tomoko. I guess you're not in a good state of mind, having stripped down so much...again, you should take care of your body.
...You wished to lose your virginity, Tomoko? You shouldn't say it like that...wish instead to find someone you want to be with.
...People have been "sucked into rock patterns," Azami? I hope you're not suggesting I investigate this for you and your community.
...Azami, did you say people are disappearing at this fault? It could be Paksis crystals...your community should investigate this.

...Saki, you crashed a motorcycle, didn't you? Riding a bike alone has little to do with piloting a fighter ship in tight formations. Still, you might be better suited for the regisystem, keeping pilots stocked.
...Riding a motorcycle and piloting a Dread are very different, Saki. Though a girl who can boost morale as you can might do better in the munitions hold, seeing our pilots off.
...Saki, what did you mean when you said you died in a crash? Whatever your situation, our crewmates would welcome you in time.
...Saki. When you said you died riding your motorcycle, what is that slang for? Almost everyone on our crew comes from a bad situation---you wouldn't be alone.
...That's a strangely apt term for certain Earthlings, Saki. Zombies survive on the organs of the living---much like Earth's goals with the Harvest.
...One could say any Earthling who survives on the harvested organs of its colonists is a "zombie."
...You're looking for recruits, too, Marth? For what, I'm not sure---but I'm not interested in following a man into battle.
...I didn't know you were recruiting people as well, Marth. Whatever your goals are, I'm not taking a man's orders.
I didn't know you were looking for your own recruits, Lucina. Is there a conflict on this planet?
...Lucina. Why are you searching for recruits? I don't want to get caught up in any Earth wars.
...Marth, I was under the impression that this planet is Earth. Those also all sound like mundane inventions.
...Isn't this planet Earth, Marth? It matches the historical coordinates and description, as well as having things like "horseless carriages."
...Lucina, I was under the impression that this planet is Earth. Those also all sound like mundane inventions.
...Isn't this planet Earth, Lucina? It matches the historical coordinates and description, as well as having things like "horseless carriages."
...I understand your concerns, Lucina. I don't have time for relationships myself with the work I do leading my squadron.
Even in our most dire moments, my crewmates still date each other, Lucina. It helps some of them cope with things...I can't juggle that with my work the same way.
...Killing comes with the territory of being a pirate. But being a pilot removes some discomfort over it---you can't see the victim's face.
...Yes, I've killed people. That's easier to stomach in a Dread's cockpit than facing someone down with a laser ring.
...There are many girls in the Magno Family who are quicker to pull the trigger when piloting than on a ground raid. I'm sure you can imagine why.
...I don't enjoy killing people, but yes. Part of leading my squadron is convincing girls to get over it---which is easier in a cockpit than on the ground.
...Piloting dehumanizes the enemy, which makes it easier to kill them. Of course, we already thought men weren't human.
...Any combat crew member gets put on our next raid mission to learn to get over killing someone. Piloting makes it easier...I had to shoot a foot soldier.
...One of our hardest jobs is convincing new crew members to kill a person---"a person" meaning another woman. But it's easier in a Dread.
...One cannot serve a combat role on a pirate crew without killing. There's an emotional disconnect to it when piloting a Dread.
...Classical music keeps me focused. It's strange to think how men from Earth may have composed much of it...
...Classical music is best for both work and relaxation. I knew Earthlings composed it, but imagine my surprise when I learned it was Earth men...
...I prefer classical music, but somehow I doubt you do. Then again, Earth men wrote much of it, and I thought them beasts...
...Classical music was one of the few pieces of Earth Mejare's colonists brought with them. Of course, they didn't mention how men wrote much of it...
...That wasn't my first poem, Mitama, if you count singing. Thanks either way.
...That took me a while, Mitama, so don't expect another.
...When I see a new challenge, Mitama, I want to take it head-on.
Well, Mitama...I just don't want to accept I can't do something.
...It doesn't have to be a man's baby, does it?
...You know, we've got a choice now, Jura. We can have a girl's baby...or a man's.
You could still stand to mature a little more.
...Well, you act like an adult half the time now.
...What do you mean, Darkness? It's my uniform.
...It's just a flightsuit, Darkness.
...What do you mean, Darkness? You've got a bodysuit, too.
...It's my flight uniform, Darkness. Your undersuit is just like it.
...I don't have any idea what music is played on Earth today. I know classical music was composed here...and I enjoy that.
...Suggestions. Earthlings composed many of the classical tracks that survive even on Mejare. I don't care for much else...
Classical music is best for both relaxing and working. I know Earthlings composed much of it, as well...play that.
...You wouldn't happen to know the song "Somedays," would you? Never mind...play classical music. That's been Earth's legacy for centuries.
...You're too trusting. My one hope is that if men need to be seduced, then maybe they're not too eager to "stuff" us.
...It's surprising that men even need to be seduced. I figured on Earth, they'd be all over us...
...The silver lining here is that you need to seduce men. If they wanted to seduce us, I wouldn't trust it...
...Just thinking of one of those pulsing tubes is unnerving. At least men don't seem quick to use them.
...It's best to not get attached to any particular food source as a pirate. But I do enjoy fish...and anything is better than the pills men eat.
...Fish is a good lean source of protein when it's available to us. Men on Tarak get all their nutrition from pills... even I'm not that practical.
I enjoy eating fish when we manage to steal some. I've enjoyed all food more after trying those tasteless pellets Tarakkians eat.
It's funny you ask that. Tarakkians eat tasteless nutrition pellets, so our prisoners have never eaten better in their lives. As for me...fish.
...Yes, Tomoko? You're staring at me.
...If you have something to say to me, Tomoko, say it.
...I hope you don't think you're disguising your intentions, Tomoko. What do you want to say to me?
...Do you have a question, Tomoko? You've been watching me for some time...while avoiding eye contact.
...What is it, Tomoko? You look concerned about me.
...Is something wrong, Tomoko? You've been staring at me, and then you looked away.
...Tomoko, I don't appreciate being stared at. Either speak up, or stop avoiding eye contact.
...Yes, Tomoko? You keep avoiding my sight.
...Tomoko, why are you avoiding my line of sight and grinning to yourself?
...Are you plotting some kind of prank, Tomoko? You're looking at me and smiling.
...If you have something to funny to share with me, Tomoko, I would prefer that over trying to sneak glances at me.
...Is there something funny about me, Tomoko? I don't appreciate your constant glances.
...Tomoko, why are you avoiding my line of sight and grinning to yourself?
...Are you plotting some kind of prank, Tomoko? You're looking at me and smiling.
...If you have something to funny to share with me, Tomoko, I would prefer that over trying to sneak glances at me.
...Is there something funny about me, Tomoko? I don't appreciate your constant glances.
...Yes, Mejare is made up of all women, Tomoko. But I'm not sure what "lesbos" means.
...I understand if it's a shock for an Earth girl to picture life without men. Apparently "lesbos" is your word for it?
"Les"..."bos"? I'm not familiar with that term, Tomoko...but yes, you're correct. No men live on my homeworld.
Don't think that men aren't close by, Tomoko...we are at war with a planet of them. Does "lesbos" mean women isolated from men?
...A "prejudice against introverts." How did you come to this conclusion? No one is obligated to pay you any attention.
...Introverted girls tend not to stand up for themselves, Tomoko. That may be why you feel discriminated against.
...Is that so, Tomoko? Mejare has a prejudice against pirates---and in either case, the only solution is for girls to stand up for themselves.
...I assume you've experienced this prejudice firsthand. I understand being reserved, but there is a time and a place to act.
..."Otoh-may"? That may be Earth slang I'm not familiar with... and what's this about virtual male children?
..."Virtual boys"? I might require some more context for what an "otoh-may" game is...
...Is "otoh-may" a variety of card game? We do have virtual versions of poker and such, but..."virtual boys"?
...Tomoko, stop throwing Earth words around like "otoh-may" and "boys" without explaining them. I can't make sense of this.
...I appreciate the compliment, Tomoko, but what would you have me do? Intentionally throw hands?
Thank you, Tomoko...I suppose. Poker is meant to be a game of intelligence, you know.
...Thank you. I always appreciate it when my crewmates say I'm smart...are you telling me to sabotage myself for fairness?
...I can't change how intelligent how I am, Tomoko. But I appreciate you saying so...it's more experience than anything.
...Your room, Tomoko? Surely you know more about your own homeworld. What about the town you live in?
...You really don't leave your house at all, Tomoko? Where on this planet is your home located?
You left your house to come here, Tomoko. You must know about other places---what about your hometown?
...I'm sure your room is nice, Tomoko, but even you felt compelled to leave it for this place. What region do you live in, exactly?
...Mejare is quite familiar with humiliation, Tomoko. Girls don't stop judging each others' hip measurements once they leave Earth.
...Mejarians are very much still human girls, Tomoko. Humiliation is a part of our culture---such as for being out of shape or poor.
...Mejare's women brought humiliation with them from Earth, Tomoko. Ask any girl whose bust fails to measure up.
...Humiliation is universal among humans, Tomoko. A Mejarian girl can still be shamed for her parents' mistakes...or a scrawny build.
...Space travel did not eliminate embarrassment in our culture, Tomoko. Though with how Earthlings dress, I can see how you'd think that...
...Don't treat me like an alien, Tomoko. Mejarians feel embarrassment, despite our preference for tight clothing.
...Are you implying a Mejarian girl would not understand embarrassment? There is more to embarrassment than revealing clothing.
...My suit may put my body on display, Tomoko, but I still understand embarrassment. Earth doesn't have a monopoly on emotions.
"Magic"? If it's anything but that, then I've never seen energy manipulated like this. Obviously I'd like to know more---before I consider you a threat.
Don't toy with me after demonstrating such strange powers, "Yuelia." Either explain yourself or I'll treat you as a threat.
"Magic"...I know our protocol for unknown threats. If you refuse to explain further, I will follow it.
You've already shown yourself to wield dangerous power, Yuelia. I won't beg a potential enemy for an explanation.
Your "father"? ...Wait, men are parents of women here. That's what you mean, right? Not that it explains your transformation.
...Your "father" is your male parent, if I'm not mistaken. That does little to explain your magical powers.
...I admit I'm no expert on "fathers," but I thought they were male parents, not magical insects.
...I had to remind myself what a "father" was. But I know that an average man cannot give his daughter magical powers.
"Tanabata"? No, I haven't. Is it some kind of Earth custom?
"Tanabata"...I don't know enough about Earth languages. Is that a place, or some sort of event?
I'd be happy to hear about one of Earth's cultural events, Tomoko. Mejare might have something similar.
"Tanabata"...I haven't heard of that. Mejare maintained many of Earth's customs---does that one involve men?
...That seems to go against the spirit of the custom, Tomoko. What do you wish for yourself?
...Do you hang up a wish tag of your own, Tomoko? You should at least do that if you're going to read those of others.
...And what do people on Earth usually wish for? What about you personally?
...Do you make wishes yourself, Tomoko? Or...have you ever tried to grant one of the wishes you read?
..."Lewd artifacts"? I guess there's ancient depictions of men and women having sex on this planet...Mejare isn't old enough to have "artifacts."
Because Mejare changed so many rulers to women in its accounts of history, any of their sex lives would probably shock me, hearing about Earth's men...
This may be a pilot's flightsuit, but skintight and revealing clothing is still popular on my homeworld. As for my favorite outfit...I have a sundress.
I was wearing a pilot's flightsuit earlier, but skintight and revealing clothing is still popular on my homeworld. As for my favorite outfit...I have a sundress.
...There's no need to overthink things, Aella. Just listen to your body and relax.
...Masturbation is a perfectly natural thing, Aella. Just do whatever feels natural.
I can't believe such a large girl would need to be coached through something like this...just behave naturally, Aella. There's no "correct" behavior.
How can a girl be so out of touch with her own body? ...Aella, just do what's comfortable. Whether that's spreading out or sitting upright...
As a matter of fact, our crew has been traveling across the galaxy for the first time. We've adventured past many of Earth's other colonies.
Up until recently, no---but our crew has been on an adventure across the galaxy due to a wormhole incident. I'd never been outside the Mejarian system.
Some would call piracy a daily adventure, but our crew had never left Mejare and Tarak until recently. I've learned a lot about other human colonies in the galaxy.
Our crew has only recently ever adventured far from home. It's let me gain perspective on men and women living together on other worlds...
Your can only fit so many books onto a pirate vessel, but there's an old section of our ship from Earth times--- with a book on men and women's physiology.
Recently, our crew discovered a book on human reproduction in one of our ship's storage rooms. It's helped me understand men's physiology somewhat.
I used to read more when I was a girl...and I actually had books. But we have recently found a book showing men's anatomy, which was an interesting read.
I've just read a book on how men and women reproduce, actually. It's the reason I've wanted to see men's bodies here for myself.
...You "died," Saki? What is that supposed to mean?
...What do you mean, you "died"? Earth slang for unfortunate events, I assume?
...A pilot faces bad luck in every dogfight. And at their conclusion, I'm always glad not to have died...I'm sorry about what happened to you, Saki.
...No matter how carefully we plan a raid, or I devise a battle formation, we always encounter bad luck. It can be overcome...I'm sorry you died from it.
...That's right, Futaba. I actually had an interest in Mejare's punk scene when I was a girl, but opera helps me relax now.
...Opera is quite relaxing, Futaba. Thank you. It's actually something I've grown to like more recently...I used to be into punk.
...Do you not shower with your clubmates, Saki? My team has plenty of opportunities to see my "butthole."
My pilots see me naked whenever we shower, Saki. Forgetting a battle formation would be far more embarrassing.
...I know, Lucy. That's just the way poker can be---it's a shame, since I won't get another chance to play on Earth.
...There's only so much I could have done, Lucy. I wasn't wearing much in the first place---but I wish I could have kept pace for my only game on Earth.
...That's a better angle than I ever get in the mirror.

...So that's what my butt looks like. To other people, I mean.
...Not bad.
...So that's the butt I swing around in the halls all day. A mirror just isn't the same.

state.text: I don't have your bustline, Momo...this is how I have to compete. Not that you're lacking here, either...

I can flaunt my butt over my breasts, but the truth is, plenty of girls have both.
...Momo.

case.state: Space travel's kept improving. Even Mejare's founders needed cold sleep and old signals. And yet all we'd done since is hunker down in that system...
Mejare's settlers worked hard to found it. They traveled far---even cold slept. But though technology's only improved, we seemed to have lost that spark to keep exploring...
...Being eighteen does not suddenly make you mature, Natsuki. Besides, you look malnourished...
...For a supposed eighteen-year-old girl, Natsuki, you look underdeveloped. Have you been eating enough food?
Eighteen years old...you don't look it, Natsuki. Even ignoring height, you come off as malnourished.
...Natsuki, you're being defensive. You may be eighteen, but you clearly need to put on some weight.
How'd I get stuck with classmates on some perverted date? ...One's even a man.
...I fly all the way to Earth, and I end up on a table with three awkward classmates. Including a man.
...Why did you two bring your male classmate along? Why are you even all here together?
...Classmates? With a man among them...this is already a waste.
Great...they swarmed us with men. Are you happy now, Jura?
More men than I bargained for...wasn't hoping for more than one, out of sheer curiosity.
All men? I'm not afraid of you. Keep your sword ready, Jura.
The three men on our ship are enough for me. And they don't try to get us naked, or strip themselves.
Well, Jura, there's plenty of men's tubes to go around. Ready to collect that seed you want so badly?
I would've liked to meet an Earth girl here. But no, of course not.
Earth girls would have been alien enough. You didn't arrange this on purpose, did you, Jura?
Something bothering you, Jura? Not what you had hoped for?
Oh, good, now we're both annoyed.
Perfect. Now neither of us want to be here.
I really didn't want to see a man's tube anyway...not in a seedy place like this.
I'd call this your comeuppance, but we still need to see this game through.
Men would have been a distraction anyway. This way we can focus on learning about Earth from the women here.
Exactly what you deserve, dragging me here. Have fun.
Just one man...well, Jura, I hope you're happy with him.
Watch yourself. Jura is looking for a man to have a child with...
You'd best take care. Jura's going to be needling you with questions all game.
A man? I'll try not to ask too many questions...Jura will do that for me.
A man? Well, Jura, looks like we'll be getting the anatomy lesson you wanted.
This one man had better be impressive enough for us to come all the way here.
Try to ignore Jura, the taller girl. She can be a little...forward.
Well, Jura, this is what you wanted. Satisfied with the crowd?
Meia Gisborn. The blonde is Jura Basil Elden.
