...If you hold some sort of power over her, Zizou, then you ought to be more considerate.
...Well, I already know what Jura's opinion of my body is, at least.
...Jura's teased me about my body quite a bit, some of it complimentary. At least I know what to expect.
...I guess there's comfort in knowing Jura's usual lines---that I'm too neurotic about my breasts and need to focus less on my butt.
...Friends are hard to come by, so yes, it's a bit easier. Jura's already told me what she thinks of my "cute breasts" and "tight butt."
...That's right. You've been mentioning those creatures, as well, N. Is Cynthia saying you had something to do with these terrorists?
...Are you implicating N in those movements, Cynthia? I know I've heard him mention "Pokémon" on occasion.
So long as Jura does her job, she can be as prideful about her body as she wants. She cultivates her appearance well.
I only take issue with Jura's vanity when she neglects her piloting duties to brush her hair.
Just because I criticize Jura for vanity is not an invitation for you to join me, Caulifla. She still does her job.
Jura takes care of her body and has every right to boast, provided she does it from her Dread. Do not criticize my subordinates.
...Don't egg her on, Jura.
...You're just giving her what she wants.
...She's a machine with a syringe for an arm, Jura. Insulting people is probably all she has.
We don't have anything to prove, Jura. Look at her.
...It's alright, Jura. And no, you didn't do anything wrong...
I'm not going to yell at you for sticking up for me. But it wasn't necessary.
No, it's alright...thank you for defending me. It's nice when you show genuine concern.
It's fine, Jura...I'm not going to criticize you for showing solidarity. I wish you did it more often.
Plenty of girls have to part with things that are important to them, Haru. My Oma gave that to me, after all...you fill in the rest.
My Oma gave that to me. It's not the headpiece itself that's quite as important, Haru, but thank you.
It was my decision, Haru...no need to apologize. My Oma gave that to me, which is why Jura never sees me remove it.
That was a gift from my Oma, Haru...that's why Jura was so shocked. And leapt to my defense.
Oh, I've lived and worked with a few men at this point...but this is a chance to learn about their biology.
Well, I know a few men now...but I was hoping this place would teach me about their anatomy.
...My interest in men is purely scientific. I know they're tolerable to live around already...
...I just came here at Jura's insistence. We have a few men on board...she wants to see men naked. It could be useful.
...Over what an Oma is? I'm from Mejare...where women have children together. Omas and Famas.
Right...Earth doesn't have Omas. One of two female parents on Mejare. Now let me focus...
...Planet Mejare only has women...so an Oma is one of my female parents.
...Right. I forgot. Women form couples on Mejare, and have children together...one is called an Oma.
I would imagine the concept of women having children together is strange, especially for a man. But that's what an Oma is...on Mejare.
...I don't know what spacer tech is. It's just a decorative piece...
My headpiece...is not tech of any kind. Don't worry about it...
My headpiece is just a fashion item...what are you whispering to her, Jura?
...Jura, what are you telling her? Just drop it...my headpiece isn't tech.
Exactly. This is a competition...and you don't give the enemy an inch.
At last we agree. You don't sororitize with the enemy in a competition.
Finally you remember. I love competition...and I hate cowards in the military.
Precisely. Your job is reprehensible enough, and now here you are as my competitor.
I find it hard to believe a vulgar alcoholic is in better shape...I guess we'll find out once you lose.
With how you drink, I'd be surprised if you had anything but a gut. Once you lose, I'll know for sure.
Big talk from a small girl. We'll see what the alcohol's done to your figure in a few rounds.
No one without an ego joins the military. I'll enjoy defeating you and revealing your beer gut in the process.
Smiles are better scarce...much like drunken soldiers, no matter how fit.
Your tone isn't worth smiling over. You're certainly fit...I'll give you that.
Your muscles really are impressive...but it takes more than that to be worth a smile.
I can recognize when I was wrong...and when a girl has worked hard for her body. That doesn't earn you a smile.
...Are colonial tourists to Earth really that uncommon? Or have you not developed space travel yet in this dimension?
Do you not get visitors from other planets all the time? Maybe this Earth isn't as advanced as the one we know...
...I think any person from a spacefaring planet would believe you. Is the Earth of this dimension not capable of that?
...You're not accustomed to space travelers? Jura, this Earth might be more different from ours than we thought.
Don't make fun of me. I don't need to take this...you already insulted my build.
...You're mocking me. First my figure, and now my chest...
Wonderful? ...Stop teasing me. You already pointed out your superior muscles...
...I know good and well my chest is not wonderful. I thought patronizing me over my figure was bad enough...
Are you---serious? Girls can be forward on Mejare, but...stoicism appeals to you?
...Earth girls really do have all the bluntness of men. I can't believe you like being treated coldly.
W-what? Oh, no...if you like stoicism, then I've been encouraging you this entire time.
...You can't be serious. You like the way I'm treating you?
W-what do you mean, doing it for you? I was---I didn't mean that!
It's better I don't get a big head. You can see what that does to a girl.
I'm a leader. I can't get arrogant...it'll endanger myself and others.
An inflated ego can only be a detriment. Best to stay humble, no matter how hard you work.
I don't need an ego boost. I've already made too many mistakes to be in this situation in the first place.
You haven't been to Mejare. I'm average-looking...try getting Jura to downplay her appearance.
Why would I have a problem with it? I'm prepared to show everything else, it would seem.
Well, with a crewmate around, turning my back on the table is a bit easier...besides, you've earned this.
The goal was to get me naked, wasn't it? If I couldn't stop you, it seems fair you should see everything.
It's the least I could do, since you've pushed me this far. Maybe the embarrassment will motivate me to play better.
Mejare has little interest in the butt...so I have little shame. Breasts are the focus of our culture.
My breasts are nothing to be proud of, but I do my best to tone my backside...thank you, Connie. I appreciate that.
Here I am from a more flattering angle...thank you, Connie. My backside is usually where I get compliments.
...It isn't universal, Pyrrha, but Mejarians do tend to be well-endowed. My Oma was quite modest, as well.
...I have what you might call a "sporty" build, Pyrrha. It isn't common on my homeworld.
...Mejare has an image of feminine beauty to uphold, Pyrrha, which includes generous measurements. Some girls naturally fall by the wayside.

state.text: For a girl who claims not to "have her shit together," you're very confident you could capture me.
Earth has no reward money for me, I assure you. Mejare certainly does... but let's see you claim it.
It's just like a soldier to hang a threat above her victim's head. For your own sake, stay over there.
And I'd be enjoying the game with both of you gone. I promise you, the reward money isn't worth the conflict.
...Yes, I'd prefer the body questions, too. As you can tell, I'm not terribly shy about it.
I think your viewers would prefer questions about my body, too. As would I---since I'm constantly displaying it.
...I'm more comfortable talking about my figure, too. Surely your audience would prefer a hips-and-breasts discussion.
Body questions would be better, yes. I'd like some feedback on my stomach and waist...or my backside.
...Exotic and erotic. Is it the way I dress, or the allure of a girl unspoiled by men?
Why exactly am I so fascinating? Or...erotic? My skintight suit? My unfamiliarity with men?
Earthlings seem to find something appealing in a girl who's never been with a man...or shows her body off.
...I certainly thought Earthlings would find me exotic, but erotic? Because of my suit, or...because of men?
Busy interviewing someone else, I hope. Hmm...how do men show they're in love with a girl?
Does that mean she'll ignore me now? Well...er...if a man is in love with a girl, how would she know that?
...Well, Sei...men fall in love with women, don't they? Do they express that the same way we do?
I don't know how much experience you have, Sei, but...what are the signs a man is in love?
Sei...well, I have a different sort of question. When a man falls in love with you, how does he act? ...How should I?

case.state: Go missing? Evas are some kind of exploration craft, then?
So she was a space explorer, then...piloting an "Eva." I'm sorry to hear that.
Maybe if I had a picture of this girl...I can assure you, I'm not the reason she's missing.
Missing...there's few enough of us that I can monitor the status of all my pilots. A shame to hear that...
So she went missing...I'm sorry to hear that. Is there an "Eva" mech I can study somewhere?
Missing...hmm. If Earth has "freaky Eva mechs," it might use them against us...I'd like to see one.
...So you suspect that the Eva vessel she piloted had something to do with her disappearance? They sound fearsome...where are they?
...I see. She went missing. I considered our Vandread technology fearsome, but maybe these "Evas" are a different beast.

state.text: I barely even know how men's tubes work, and you make these obscene requests...Sei, I can't have a relationship.
Where do you get the nerve to ask me these things? As far as I know, men are still a hostile species...as are soldiers.
Not everyone is an exhibitionist, Streaming-chan. And I worry men might sprout tendrils...that's not an invitation, Sei.
Maybe you like to degrade yourself for viewers, but I do not. ...Sei, there are plenty of girls on Mejare I ignore, too.

case.state: ...Shut up. Quiet. ...Sei, don't be stupid. I can't be claustrophobic...that's just weakness.
...Quiet. Quiet! ...I'm not claustrophobic, Sei, I'm...well.
...I said I don't like them. Now shut your mouth! ...Claustrophobic? Don't be ridiculous...
...My Dread is the only tight space I like. Now be quiet! ..."Claustrophobic"? No one's ever called me that...

state.text: ...Streaming-chan? I see...she won't be finding much. It's a long flight to Mejare.
...Hm. How do you propose she actually search for them? Even as faster-than-light, Mejare is months away from here.
Are you even listening to me? ...Apparently not. Well, between the distance and imperial policy, she won't find much.
Hello? ...I see. That'll be a long shopping trip for products that are probably superior on Earth.
...Is nothing sacred to you, Streaming-chan? Are you here to make me appreciate the soldier's company?
...Ghoulish indeed. Did you bring this pathetic friend of yours to make yourself look better, Sei?
...You're disgusting. Sei, you actually call this girl your friend? She certainly makes you look better.
...I'll say this, Sei. Even for a soldier, you have more of a heart than this soulless attention-seeker.

case.state: I'm not considering it, Jura. We have nothing to gain by taking him in.
I don't think he's serious, Jura. And if he is, he'd just be a mouth to feed.
...I don't want to get involved in your relationship. But if you're comfortable describing each other's tastes, that would make a good reference.
...Your relationship is none of my business. But if you talk about yourselves openly like this, I'm sure I could learn from you---men liking tight outfits, for instance.
...I'm not going to flirt with him, if that's what you mean. I would be grateful for any information you don't mind sharing about your relationship.
...I mostly keep to myself. But we've started to all get along better.
...I plan routes and scout ahead alone a lot. But I've spent more time with the others lately.
...I'll consider relaying your request to her at my next report. If the Princeton Group is comparable to a military's strength, that might be worth our time.
...We would be happy to have an ally on Earth if your resources are adequately sized. I'll see if it's worth proposing to her.
...I've been treated with electroshock before. I'd rather not sexualize it.
..."Electrostimulation." I've already gone through that as a medical treatment, and that was enough.
...There's no need to waste time and resources to impress ignorant Earth children.
...Just take this as an example of the xenophobia bred into Earth's younger generation. We should focus on their fleets.
...She's not worth the effort, Jura. We should be striking fear into Earth's Harvest fleets, not its schoolchildren.
...Earth children are taught not to value our humanity, Jura. A show of strength won't change that.
...Thank you, Jura. You're a talented pilot, as well...you just need more leadership experience.
...You're a fine pilot, too, Jura. You just need to practice maintaining that skill when you have to lead the team.
...Jura is second-in-command on our team, and a fine pilot in her own right. As well as more adept socially.
...There's no need to praise me so much. You and the other pilots are skilled, as well...I should let you lead the team more.
Sei and I both shaving is coincidence. I can only assume the women of Planet China are covered in hair...including their backsides.
Shaving is the style on Mejare...ask Sei if you want to know about Earth. Planet China must be fully committed to pubic hair...possibly anal hair, as well.
I'm sorry if you were hoping to see blue pubic hair, Mulan, but it exists. Planet China must encourage its women to grow hair...freely.
Feel free to display the anal hair Planet China values, Mulan. I don't know Sei's situation.
My pubic hair is thick without shaving...and it's indeed blue. Do the women of Planet China not shave...anything?
I had to learn it myself. You think you're getting out of their way, but they just want you to be happy.
It's ironic, but you can be selfish by thinking you're not important. One of our prisoners made me realize that.
...She's standing over there.
..."Elegance" is Jura's favorite word.
I was a lot younger. That was the problem---I enjoyed it until I didn't.
It wasn't just a few years. By puberty, I'd outgrown it. At least that's what I told myself.
It figures I might get sick trying to learn about men...
With all the male germs on this planet, it might be inevitable.
...Is the real me that simple?
...I figured the real me had another round or two.
A man as the level-headed member of a fighting team? That hasn't been my experience...
I assume you're the cooler head in this arrangement, then? The men I fight alongside tend to be excitable.
Then you must be the more steadfast member. Usually that falls to me...with men being reckless.
The men I know are usually the reckless ones...and short, as well. So this is a new arrangement to see...
I'd like to be the arbiter of that, thank you. I'm my own person.
...I'll take your word for it that it is. It sounds like I'd get along with this girl.
I never saw myself as having much in common with others, but apparently there's an Earth girl I'm very similar to.
I feel like I've been captured on Tarak and displayed in a cage...who is this mystery girl?
Mejare has few animals...mostly in zoos. I now realize they didn't want us to see male ones.
Any animals you see on Mejare are most likely in captivity. They don't want males on display...
Far be it from Mejarian imperials to let us see male animals. Most are hoarded in captivity and hidden away...
I saw some animals in zoos as a girl...all female, of course. Show any male ones, and it might've caused suspicion.
Yes, I lead our ship's Dread fighter squadron. That means I can't compromise the team with personal flings.
Every fighter pilot on the Nirvana answers to me, in fact. Flirting with them would only undermine my authority.
...I have more than a few trainees in our pilot squadron. If I tried to date one of them, the others wouldn't take me seriously.
Yes, I do. But one of a leader's responsibilities is setting a rookie straight when she's busy ogling your backside.
Your male teammate wears a skintight suit, as well? Men don't seem like they're shaped properly for that...
I think your complaints may stem from your gender, Ryuji. Women are smooth and shapely for bodysuits...men are angular and jagged.
I would think men aren't built to wear bodysuits properly. Wouldn't your tube bunch up and get in the way?
If Futaba and I enjoy our suits, and you don't, Ryuji...it's likely because men aren't built for them. You're too inflexible.
By my estimates, men like smashing things and wearing baggy pants to hide their tubes from women's fangs.
The men I know like many things, and women aren't one of them. And their clothes tend to be spacious...
Men dress...in baggy clothing, right? And they like fighting amongst themselves, but not women.
I think I've gathered those details already. All the men I know wear baggy, loose clothing and like avoiding women to scheme amongst themselves.
I'm totally lost in this conversation...but the idea of a teenager spying on a clandestine government organization is pretty amusing.
I'll be honest...if she is, I side with the teenager over the state. Good for you, Futaba.
That's a funny thought. Listen, Futaba, if you need protection from the law, the Nirvana has room for you.
Rebelling against authority? I like you, Futaba. Keep up the good work.
Guess Earthlings have more intellectual ways of rebelling against the state than shooting lasers...
...A "Pokémon"? That did nothing to answer my question...
..."Pokémon"? A lifeform unique to Earth that colonists didn't bring with them, maybe...or is it just some fantasy icon?
Mhmhmhm...Mejare's style of dress is all about riding the line, Jessie.
My love of bodysuits should tell you how I prefer teasing, Jessie...but not everyone does.
I'm sure onlookers prefer this look, as well, Jessie. Or maybe they prefer being teased?
You're selling my outfit short, Jessie. Wanting can be better than having---I like bodysuits for a reason.
...I agree. Our crew takes care to make sure everyone can relax---I prefer time in the spa myself.
Part of the Magno Family's strength is that we put our numbers towards ensuring stress relief, not just raw productivity. We even have a spa that I enjoy.
From what I understand of Earth's history, it was full of violent factionalism. It wouldn't surprise me if that was the catalyst for colonizing other planets.
You may be on to something there. I've heard Earth was far from a unified society when colonization began---in fact, that may have been the reason for it.
That may be it, among other social divisions that spurred space colonization in the first place. These "Pokémon" may have died out in the accidents that devastated the Earth of my time.
It doesn't take much power. By the time the plating failed, we'd all be dead, anyway.
It's designed to be the last system that fails. We'd just be floating bodies by then.
...This is further back than I thought.
...The big one, right nearby? This must be ancient history.
Apparently our prisoners didn't used to smile much before they met us. The same goes for me.
Tarak does seem depressing, even on the surface. None of our prisoners have fond memories of it.
I know---it's about understanding your opponents. Like how you trust what people say.

It's a social game. Control your feelings and learn about the other players.
...You take everyone at their word.
I can always be better. So I know it's always there for me. What do you do with those feelings?
There's no such thing. That's why I like it, to always improve. If I didn't have that...well, what's your go-to?
...You know, it's kind of relaxing to talk to you. To meet new people. And to show them---who I am.
...I actually feel pretty relaxed. Talking with you, in this game. We've got nothing to hide.
I used to sooner show off in a cockpit than "show myself" to others. I think coming here proves I've grown since.
That used to be the one risk I never took. Look at me now---topless on a hostile planet.
...Lately, I've been thinking about the things I can do naked.
...I came here because I've done everything I can with clothes on. It's time I took them off.
I didn't think an Earth girl would be insisting how different they are.
...When I came here, I thought you'd all talk about how similar men and women are.
They're going to have to be.
A pirate's way of doing things isn't usually welcome.
...It should be interesting, at least.
...I'm sure I'll learn something.
..."Anymore"?
...Aren't you my age?
...You could say the same thing about this place.
You're right. It's very accepting...for all kinds of girls.
...I certainly burn off all my fat.
...Too much of a good thing, maybe.
She's not a security risk, is she, Pyoro?<hr>{pyoro}No, nothing like that. Just---{!reset}<hr>Then let her have her secrets.
{pyoro}I'm back! Now, about Miss Sanako---{!reset}<hr>Unless she's a threat, don't tell us.
It'll take some extra support.

I agree.
...But I might not be able to do it alone.
...It's who I am. Maybe one day "settling down" will be, too.
...My mother would also say to be myself, and to accept love when it comes.
...You mean, my good side.
This side looks better. It's that simple...

My mother said that, too---let someone touch my heart.
...Is there really that much in the way?

That was my mother's advice: "Sharing your heart with someone is a wonderful thing."
...Isn't this close enough?
...Maybe. But I wonder...will it be from a woman, or a man?
The question is, I could get pregnant by a man... or a woman.

{pyoro}Emergency shipments, Meia! You need them!{!reset}
You're---not the only robot who thinks so.

{pyoro}Inadequate mission preparation! Meia, you should know better by now...!{!reset}
Pyoro?
...Cold logic. Robots agree...
...I need water to be that carefree.

It really doesn't.
...But I might agree in a jacuzzi.
Well, unlike Jura, I have responsibilities...and no time for exhibitionism.
Jura was the one to drag me here. She's convinced stripping in front of strangers is going to make me go easier on her.
Friends is a strong word. Occasionally Jura surprises me and does her job, though, which is always nice.
Well, Jura actually wants to be here, and felt it proper to drag me along. She's convinced all of Earth will fall for her.

Pride is one of my bad habits. But it's a lot worse to just hate yourself.
So...go ahead and stare.
People say pride can go too far, but so can modesty. You want to take your good points---and feel good about them.
...You really are just like Jura.
Teasing? Right out of Jura's playbook. Only reason she came here, I'm sure.
Cute, was it? I'll always take support over looks.
By all means, Ami, if you want this man, you can have him.
The day I dress up for a man's sake is the day I want the captain to put me out of my misery.
If I were to ever date a man, I hope he'd have the good sense to appreciate supportive training gear.
Even Jura would hesitate to tease this many men...I hope.
Are you sure you want to tease men like this? They tend to be much stronger than women.
I paid enough attention to choose underwear that's both supportive and sensible.
...What do you mean? Do men prefer girls' backsides? Maybe they're afraid of eye contact...
...What are you saying, Alice? Men---like girls' backsides? I do squats to keep it toned, but that's...for personal reasons.
...Are you implying I can attract a man with my butt? It figures even Earth men would be afraid to look a girl in the eye...
...So men would prefer to take me from behind, you're saying? Maybe they really are dirty animals, then...
...Mejarians are hopeless romantics. Kissing and eye contact are key...are you saying showing my butt to a man is "presenting"?
...At least you're more perceptive than your demeanor suggests. Yes, it means something to me.
...Yes, it's personally meaningful. It doesn't take an Oracle to see me blushing.
...My Oma gave that to me. Did you sense that, or simply read my face?
...It must be written on my face. That, or your shadow powers include perception.
Save your threats for a girl who'll be intimidated by them. Street thugs waving metal guns around don't impress me.
The threats of a common street thug aren't worth my attention---and those pathetic male firearms aren't intimidating in the slightest.
Keep on making threats if you want---you're hardly the first thug I've dealt with, or the first fighter using those sorry male excuses for firearms.
If you think some petty street thug's threats are going to scare me, think again. And I have a better weapon than your ridiculous moving parts.
I'm a pirate, not a soldier...and I'm just here to peacefully learn about men. If that's alright with you.
It's interesting you imply you could stop me. But I'm not here to kill anyone...just to see men for myself.
Men are just a curiosity. I'm not interested in killing, Revy...not unless someone tries to kill me.
I'm not a Mejarian soldier...I know better than to treat all men as scum. Scum are women who try to intimidate others.
That makes one of us. So...you work with this "Rei" girl?
...I need to see a photograph of this girl.
I'd also like to see how, and whether this "Rei" really bears such a strong resemblance to me.
Do what you will, Veran. Just remember I'm no civilian.
You aren't the first girl to threaten me. You won't be the last.
I face death every day. You can save your petty attempts to frighten me.
I assure you, the Harvest is a more intimidating opponent than a shadowy, naked girl.
...You're right, I have. Maybe you're more perceptive than I thought.
It sounds as if you've never crawled out of the gutter...but I won't deny having been there myself.
...That's right. But being in the gutter doesn't doom you to stay there.
...I didn't expect you to have enough intuition for that. Maybe there's more to you than I realized...or it was a fluke.
...An "expert." Don't you claim not to leave your home? ...I'm most curious about how women coexist with men here.
...Are you? Most of Earth's culture I can pick up on my own...but how women can live so close to men eludes me. Do you know much about that?
...You're quite young for me to consider you an expert on anything, Tomoko...do you have experience with men?
...Aren't you a self-proclaimed shut-in? Unless you happen to be an expert on men and their anatomy, I don't see much potential in this.
I'm just tempering your expectations...I don't expect you to share my interests.
...I enjoy piloting very much, Flutter. I just don't expect others to, and would rather not impose.
...Thank you, Flutter. I just don't mean to monopolize the conversation.
...I assume you're only making polite conversation, so I don't want to exhaust the subject.
A pirate for whom? There's many reasons a girl could find herself living a life like that...
You don't seem the type to associate with pirates, Flutter...but I know they can take many forms. How did she get involved in that?
That's surprising to hear, Flutter...but I don't know the politics of your world. How does she go about her piracy?
It's difficult to generalize exactly what a pirate's life is like. What does she do, and who does she work with?
I guess that's the view one adopts when every day is a competition for resources. You're free to take other views.
If you enjoy competition, Flutter, that's your business. I do, too---but it isn't fun. I compete every day just to survive.
A pilot's life consists of competing against an enemy you hate, Flutter. It's only natural I'd feel that way.
Piracy is an ongoing competition for survival...so yes, I'm used to hating my opponents. Friendly competition exists to prepare for it.
You may too excitable for leadership, but a piloting job is certainly within your abilities.
...I don't know what you do for a living, but you might actually make a good pilot, if not a good leader.
...Self-control is a matter of practice.
...It takes practice. I was more outgoing myself once.
...I don't mean you any harm, Emi.
...I'm not about to threaten you over a childish joke.
..."Magical"? You look very charming in it, if that's what you mean.
...I'm not sure what you mean. "Magical" as in people find your outfit cute?
We don't have any transforming-outfit technology on Mejare. I don't know if it's "magical," but you're right to be proud of it.
It's impressive technology to infuse your suit with "magical" energy. It's probably not the only advancement Earth has over us.
...It's too reckless to accept powers like yours on a whim. I don't know about their side effects, and I'm away from the crew.
...I'd have to learn more about Kwami energy before I commit to taking some.
...We've needed a lot of good luck.
I like skill over luck. But we've needed a lot either way.
They're powered by the same core that our ship has. It's like a living thing. That's why we've adapted, too.
They're just following programs. But their power source can pick up on emotional auras, and change its mind like a person...so can ours.
I hope you'll agree the swimming helped.
...Exercise pays off.
...From one foreign visitor to another, thank you. Earthlings can be xenophobic.
...Well. Regardless of Earthlings' hospitality, at least women from foreign planets can be considerate to one another.
...Alien or not, we're both outsiders on this planet. Thank you for being cordial.
...And I was told Saiyans were savages. That's polite of you...we should watch out for each other here.
Whatever...
Just make sure no one touches it...
...It's fine...
...It's no issue. Really.
Just let it sit over there...
I said it's fine. Let's keep going.
Stop drawing attention to it and deal.
I don't want them asking questions. Just keep playing.

..."Stay Kool." That's what I do best.
...So you prefer dressing as a girl? This men's uniform looks a lot more functional.
...I remember I loved getting ice cream as a girl. I'd order all different flavors and then bite right into it.

So this is what men wear to get married?
...To be honest, it was hard to picture men in that kind of relationship at all.
...Do men like how summer lets you look at girls in bathing suits? Maybe the other way around, even.
...How big of a holiday is Valentine's on Earth, if it's mostly male-female?
You have a girlfriend, right? How seriously do men and women take Valentine's here?
I'm not sure a girl made of lightbulbs should be going near the water...for anyone's sake.
...Should "Pandoria" be swimming? I don't know if she's a robot, or something else...and I don't know who'd be in more danger.
...Mejare doesn't have much room for a hobby like motor racing.
...Racing on motorbikes would be hard to find the space for back home.
...Is your partner a...walking Christmas light?
...Is "Pandoria" a robot? One with inbuilt---Christmas lights.
...What are you insinuating? I'm only focusing my attention on who lost the round.
...There are numerous interesting things about you, even beyond being a man...but you shouldn't flatter yourself.
...What is that supposed to mean, Dust? I told you that you look unusual, even for a man...
...Your sense of fashion and excess body hair are worth looking over, Dust, but don't get the wrong idea about my attention.
It's...been a little awkward, staring at you. It's that crystal in your chest...I had an accident like that, in my skull.
I guess a crystal in your heart is fine, just not your head. But it also wasn't the same material with me...
Why are you blindfolded? Don't you want to see the cards?
Why are you wearing a blindfold? Are you really that confident?
...Are you playing on a bet? Take your blindfold off and play seriously.
Your outfit is one thing, but to be wearing a blindfold? What's wrong with you?
What is that "Pod" you keep giving orders to? What does it do?
...Are you going to explain what your "Pod" is doing over there, or are we all supposed to ignore it?
This is a good time to learn about Earth technology. What exactly is the function of that "Pod" drone?
...I'm curious about that "Pod" of yours. I guess you wanted us to ask about that, since you keep talking to it.
That "Pod" drone you keep giving commands to is a lot like Pyoro, our own robot assistant...though he has more to say for himself.
Now are you taking off that ridiculous blindfold? Or...tactical visor.
So are you forfeiting, or are you finally deciding to let yourself see?
Attached to that blindfold? Either give up the game or take off that thing...your move.
Please tell me you're not so attached to that thing that you're finished off now.
Deja vu indeed...unless it's April Fool's today. Mejare's cars are much more advanced.
AE86? Good, ~player~ is just goofing off...so I can, too. There's no useful engineering in an ancient Earth car...
..."AE86." I deal in Dreads and spacecraft, so a twentieth-century Earth car isn't exactly a technological marvel.
I wonder if this "Toyota" group was responsible for any of Mejare's automobile engineering... I'm not impressed with this.
...Coming off of a fusion ship powered by the Paksis Pragma, an internal combustion engine fails to impress.
You're...a man? Not like one I've ever seen.
Why are you speaking through a translator? Is that some archaic Earth language?
...Earth languages besides the common tongue are a mystery to me. Even Tarakkian code is not something I've ever concerned myself with.
...Facial markings? Like Rabat's people. I'll keep that in mind, Earth-man.
I never thought I'd meet a man shorter than Hibiki...but you might be the one.
Who let this...child in here?
Men really do come in all shapes and sizes. You might as well be a woman.
Who are you? You look like a child. Get out.
I'm no expert on men, but you look like a prepubescent one...never mind the cat ears. Children aren't allowed here.
We shouldn't be playing with this child here. This is wrong...
Never thought I'd meet a man with my fashion sense.
I'm told you were frozen for decades. Hibiki was that way, too...
I'm told you used be small and weak, but were scientifically altered. Hibiki could certainly benefit from that...not that he'd ever accept.
I'm told you used be small and weak, but were scientifically altered. Seems unbecoming of a man to take the easy way out.
If everyone on this America planet is built like you, I'd hate to see the women.
Are you really a captain? You seem built more to take orders than give them.
You don't need to strip for me to tell you're fit. They'd worship you on Tarak.
And I thought Hibiki was outgoing...
Well...you're certainly enthusiastic.
We're all right here. You don't have to shout.
Is "captain" an actual designation, or just what you call yourself?
I heard there's a female version of you. What kept her away?
And I thought Bart's outfits could be garish.
You dress more garishly than Bart. I wonder how you'd look bald.
...Can't you take this seriously, ~player~?
~player~, you're better than this. Pick a real character.
You put Shaggy Blanco on a table with me? Do you really hate me that much?
I wish I could understand what you're saying. Maybe then I'd get something out of this joke.
At least you started working out. You're still all unkempt.
White's not a popular color among Mejarians...you can imagine why.
Not sure how to take this. You picked me...but apparently I'm only worthy of playing with Shaggy Blanco.
Thought I wouldn't have lines to a joke character? You underestimate me, ~player~.
So, you solve mysteries? Duero's the only man I know who's smart enough for that.
So, you solve mysteries? The Paksis is one big glowing mystery...
You might be handsomer if you grew your hair out. Duero makes it work.
...I've seen enough men to know you're not human.
What exactly...are you?
So gay is the term Earthlings use? Sounds sort of derisive.
They told me you're an agent, but an agent of what, I'm still not sure. Maybe you could elaborate...and take off your weapon.
Don't think I don't see that weapon. I'm trying to be less wary of men...but an armed "agent" puts me on edge.
It's my understanding you're an agent. Well, I'm a pirate...and I didn't come armed, so maybe you should remove your weapon.
An "agent" of a man with a weapon at his hip is making this an uncomfortable experience already.
For a man claiming to be a soldier, you have a very casual attitude. Who or what have you fought?
Maybe you could put me at ease by explaining what you do. You don't have the eyes of a man who's been under fire.
I know very few men, but they're primarily soldiers---and none of them so laid-back as you. Have you seen combat?
Have you actually seen combat? You have a soldier's poise, but not his gaze...maybe I don't know men well enough.
You look dead-serious...and you're built sturdily. It's not unlike our ship's male doctor, Duero.
Stern...flowing hair...tall and strong. You remind me of Duero, the male doctor on our ship. The only doctor.
I never liked how men grew to be bigger and stronger than women...at least you take yourself seriously. You're like Duero, our ship's doctor...a man.
...There's a man on our ship---our doctor, Duero. He's got a similarly large build, and is stoic like you, too.
Based on my prior impressions of men, I'll guess by tearing your clothes off, returning to a primal state.
Mejarians have long considered nudity to be men's bestial natural state, so I assume you strip quite readily.
...With your hands? Up until recently, I wasn't sure men wore clothes at all.
...By all means, Kamina, enlighten me. Mejare views men as beasts who barely wear clothes in the first place.
...I'll try to ignore your apparent feelings towards me. There's a man in my squadron learning to pilot...maybe you could teach him.
...So. Is it true you're a mech pilot? One of our male prisoners is learning, and he might benefit from a male instructor.
What kind of mech do you pilot, exactly? I'm having a hard enough time teaching the one man in my squadron.
...Kamina. If it's true you pilot a mech, there's a novice pilot in my squadron...a man. You might be able to help him.
Bombastic...and wearing little clothing. Since you're so adamant about being a man, do you have experience with women?
You seem willing to speak on this subject, so...can you give an Earth man's experience regarding women, Kamina?
Hmm...maybe you could tell me what Earth men think of women, Kamina. After all, you're very proud of being a man...
It's clear you take pride in your gender. If that includes any experience with women, I'd like to hear an Earth man's perspective...
...Who are you? You have a hungry look in your eye...
...I've always regarded men as simple...but you look a little too complex.
...I've learned that men aren't really animals...but something about you reminds me of one.
...You have an analytic look in your eye. That's more complex than I've come to view the average man...
...What are you staring at? I don't appreciate a man looking me over, especially one with calculating eyes.

state.text: Am I supposed to ignore that bizarre costumed man you keep summoning? Who is he?

case.state: As if I needed another reason to distrust you, now you're summoning strange costumed figures...! Who's that behind you?
Is Killer Queen who you call the mute man in costume behind you? What's he doing here?
I might be more inclined to trust you, Kira, if you explained the identity of the masked man standing behind you.
...Really, ~player~? You picked Kool-Aid Man?
...Really? Over 100 characters and you pick Kool-Aid Man?
I've seen men. You're Kool-Aid monster.
...Have some respect for yourself, ~player~. Kool-Aid Man?
Unless it's April Fool's Day, you shouldn't be picking this character.
If this is what Earthlings find attractive, I'm glad the colonists left.
I'm not sure how to feel about being picked by the same player who'd choose Kool-Aid Man.
You must really hate me to stick me on a table with this idiot, ~player~.
I hear you're good with a sword. Maybe you could talk to Jura...if you seemed capable of talking.
I see you value words about as much as I do.
...Is this some primitive men's language?
So you can speak. What was that all about?
So you were just making fun of me...
Grunting and screaming around women is what I'd expect from a Tarakkian.
Why are you masking your face? It's something a Tarakkian man might do around women, frozen in terror.
I thought Earth men would have the courage to look women in the eye, but it seems the Tarakkian way runs deep.
If you're so ashamed to be here that you'd hide your face, you should leave before you lower my opinion of men any further.
Your frame is very slight for a man...but I've seen smaller ones. You're not afraid to make eye contact with women, are you?
Maybe I just lack the experience, but...are you a man or a woman?
Men and women have always looked pretty distinct to me...and then there's you.
So, you live underground? Sounds claustrophobic...
You were created in a lab? So was I, technically...
So, you were made in a lab...like every woman on Mejare, and every man on Tarak.
...Well, I've never seen men as the symbols of cleanliness, but I support it all the same. Women have outdone you there.
Mister Clean...you men aren't fooling anyone. Women make cleanliness a species identity.
My picture of men as a girl was dirty, savage animals. You're certainly a step in the right direction---more like women.
It's strange how some men shave their heads...our navigator does, too. It's the least men could do to be as clean as women.
I'll be honest. You don't look like much of a man.
I thought men were supposed to be tall and strong. Of course, Hibiki proves that wrong...
Why do you have wings? I thought men were human, but maybe not.

You look pretty young for a man.
...And winged.
A "Street Fighter"...I've been in street fights. Nothing to brag about.
"Eternal Fighting Champion"? You shouldn't rest on your laurels.
I came to see a man here...you're certainly a lot of man.
Ryuji, right? Normally I'd be curious about your athletic training...but with a man, I'd rather not.
I was interested when I heard an athletic trainer would be joining us...but it's just a man.
Is it true you conduct athletic training? Admirable...but I'm not comfortable doing that with a man.
You should know I'm into athletics myself...but you're a man, so it's best we left it at that.
You solve mysteries? Duero's the only man I know who's smart enough for that.
You solve mysteries? The Paksis is one big glowing mystery...
You solve mysteries? You look like you can barely get yourself out of bed.
Man or woman, unkempt appearances don't impress me.
...You're an "alchemist"? I knew men weren't as advanced, but to subscribe to ancient pseudoscience...
The fact that "alchemy" is still considered science on Earth is evidence enough that it's too far gone to save.
I've read about ancient Earth "alchemists" haphazardly mixing chemicals in their basements. It doesn't lead to spacecrafts.
...Who are you? I'm wary enough of men, and meeting one who claims to practice "alchemy" nonsense doesn't help.
So, you help that girl fight vampires? I work with a few men...out of necessity.
I wonder what the blood colony's people must look like. Probably blushing all the time.
Vampires suck blood, huh...there's probably an Earth colony for blood out there somewhere.
These "vampires" of yours sound fearsome. The Harvest probably wants blood from somewhere, too...
You seem immature...but then, Hibiki makes that work for himself.
..."N." A codename? It's strange that a man would dress with such personal flair but hide his true identity.
...You wear so many personal decorations, but you won't share your full name with us? Men are a strange race...
Simply calling yourself "N"...men are nothing if not efficient. Or if it's a codename, why decorate yourself and stand out?
...Highly decorated dress...a short name...quiet. You're not like the other men I know...they wouldn't hide their identities.
...A fur coat... and a tail. I was taught men were animals, but I thought I knew better at this point...
...How bizarre. A man who's just as bestial as I was taught they were...are you really human?
...On my homeworld, girls are raised to view men as savage beasts dressed in rags. I was not expecting to see the very image of that on Earth.
...What are you? Some wolf-man hybrid from an Earth genetic facility? Just when I thought men weren't the animals Mejare said they were...
...When I was told there'd be a male adventurer here, I expected someone more... muscular.
Don't men tend to be taller and more muscular than women? Civilians are one thing, but I was told I'd meet a warrior.
...Is this what passes for warrior men on Earth? I'm used to them towering over me on ground raids.
...I wonder if Tarakkian soldiers have given me a false impression of men's size. You're scrawny for a "warrior."
...A device for holding cards? It could probably be used as a bludgeon, and that's if it isn't hiding something more lethal.
..."Chazz," was it? I hope you don't think you're fooling anyone with such an overdesigned card-holder.
If that ridiculous contraption is your idea of concealing a weapon, men are even less subtle than I thought.
I have a hard time believing the hardened, practical male species I'm used to would wear a device to hold playing cards. That's a weapon.
...You're the leader of a criminal organization, right? I'm an officer in a Mejarian pirate group---our main targets are military bases. What about you?
I'm told you lead a syndicate on this planet known as "Team Skull." I'm part of the "Magno Family"---we typically raid army stockpiles. What do you do?
I should've expected Earth's criminal element to complement me here. A man, and a syndicate leader, is interesting...what does "Team Skull" target?
A man leading a criminal group...you're certainly not as aged as our leader. Who are the main targets of "Team Skull"?

state.text: It's just like a man to bring such a conspicuous weapon---what are you doing with explosives? You'll kill us all if you fire!
What kind of incompetent security does this establishment have, letting a man bring a rocket launcher inside? Are you trying to kill all of us?
Why do you have an explosives launcher in such close quarters? Are you insane? Or do men have no sense of self-preservation?
What's the meaning of this, casually slinging rockets over your back? Don't think insane recklessness will intimidate me!

case.state: You're a soldier, right? We're currently holding several male soldiers prisoner aboard our ship...you seem more relaxed than any of them.
...You were introduced as a "Grand Caster." I'm not familiar with that title---is it unique to Earth culture, or just men's?
...You keep referring to yourself as the "Supreme Leader." To be fair, I'm accustomed to seeing young male children as Earth's leaders...
...What exactly are you the "Supreme Leader" of? You wouldn't be the first young boy in a position of power on Earth...
...I guess calling me, or any Mejarian, "gay" wouldn't be incorrect. In fact, it's our entire culture's lifestyle...
...A haunted plush doll that calls others "gay." Mejare wouldn't even have a word for same-sex romance... that's just romance to us.
...I'm afraid I don't have a "dick" for you to suck. I see this "gay" insult is more directed at men...but it would apply to Mejarians.
...Do Earth children really play with such a grotesque doll? Mejarian girls' toys are all beautiful dolls...or model imperial ships.
...If Mejare ever decided to manufacture a "man" doll to teach girls the horrors of the male species, I imagine you're what it would look like.
...Hm. Is this the evil alien Earth children are taught to hate from a young age? You could be repurposed to show Mejarian girls what men look like.
...I'm surprised a boxer would show up to strip poker in his actual ring attire. But the thought process behind men's decisions still eludes me...
You aren't wearing much...not that I would expect a boxer's outfit to be elaborate. Why you're not wearing street clothes is another male mystery.
...If this is what you wear during bouts, then it's interesting how men aren't as sheepish about going bare-chested...
...I guess men don't have breasts to worry about, so boxers wouldn't wear a top. As a woman, it's a constant concern...
Boxers on Mejare obviously wear bras. Now that I think about it, our male doctor doesn't wear a shirt, either...
...You started stripping before the first hand was dealt. Is this a man's intellect, or your own perversion?
...You have the overly-aggressive temperament I used to expect of men. So aggressive you're only going by a title...
Why are you playing a social game if you despise everyone here? You haven't even shared your name.
...You're a fellow space traveler? I guess it's nice to meet a man in a non-hostile situation.
I'm glad someone else here has experience in space travel, even if it's a man. Our crew's previous encounters with them have quickly devolved into conflict.
I hope you don't think waving a pistol around is intimidating. Is it too much to expect a man to respect his own weapon?
With your complete lack of trigger discipline, you're more likely to kill yourself than any of us. Is this your attempt to intimidate us?
Tch...small dogs bark the loudest. If you were the killer you professed to be, your gun would be holstered, and you'd feel no need to voice it.
...You started stripping before the first hand was dealt. Is this a man's intellect, or your own perversion?
Men's bodies are so different from women's that I never expected to see a man wearing a suit like mine. You do have a slimmer frame than most men I've seen, though.
A man wearing a skintight suit...all the ones I've seen opt for baggy coats or fatigues. You're built a lot slimmer than most of them---maybe that's why you can wear it.
You're Deimos, aren't you? You sounded confused when you arrived here, and your head is bandaged. You might want to seek medical attention.
You look like you've taken a head injury. You seemed disoriented when you came over, as well---are you sure you're alright?
I see traces of a head wound on you, and you were stumbling earlier. You should see a doctor if you haven't.
I understand you lead some sort of resistance group in another sector. Our crew is essentially serving the same purpose for the surrounding planets.
Outside of refugees marooned on old stations, the only other fighters we've met are planet's militaries. You lead an independent resistance, don't you?
...You're a painter, aren't you? Our chief engineer showed me a painting our male doctor gave to her. It had never occurred to me that men could be artistic.
I remember discovering from our doctor that men dabble in art, like you do. It made them seem a lot more human.
You're rich because of your family's company, as I understand. What does the Princeton Group produce?
I take it your family's fortune is very large. Could you describe what your company does, exactly?
If men and women coexist in your system, then you've probably had relationships with them at your age. Is that right?
It's normal for men to form relationships with women in your sector, isn't it? If you don't mind, I'd like to know more about your experiences.
It sounds like your sector's civilizations have actually maintained contact. It even sounds like some of those aren't human civilizations. Is that true?
Are you actually in contact with alien life forms? The way you've mentioned "attacks," like from wild animals...it doesn't sound like just humans fighting.
Are humans not the only life in your sector? Names like the "Zerg"...they sound like alien species.
From what I know of our doctor, he's painted subjects like the flow of blood. What does your work tend to focus on?
Do you prefer a certain subject for your paintings? I've seen our doctor paint things that interest him, like blood inside a vein.
That creature that's buzzing around you---Plagg. Is that some sort of robotic assistant? Our ship has an old one called Pyoro---with the same personality.
Is that black creature a personal robot, Adrien? Our ship's helper Pyoro gives us his own sort of backtalk.
You look just like a male bandit we found at an abandoned outpost. Not to mention you have the same deceitful tone of voice.
...I should've known I'd find a man just like Rabat in a place like this. You're even dressed the same. I'm not interested in any offers you have.
As if I didn't have enough reason to keep an eye on any men playing. You bear an uncanny resemblance to a male bandit who's tried to swindle our crew.
...As I understand it, you're worshipped as a god. Do your followers know you're playing a strip game here?
...The "God of Love," right? I assume you have followers you're ignoring by being here.
You're---a man, aren't you? Why are you dressed in women's clothing? An attempt to fit in with them?
You---I was told you're a man. The way you're dressed and decorated is something only women do, as far as I know. Is that different on Earth?
...So, there's mechanical guns still in use on this planet. I thought Tarak lacked the resources for energy weapons, but maybe men just like the noise.
My homeworld's sister planet Tarak is full of men who use guns like yours, with solid ammunition. I guess I figured Earth was rich enough to use laser weapons.
...Mettaton, do you recall a time before you were sentient? Were you exposed to some kind of red energy core in the assembly process?
...For a robot, you seem remarkably human. Do you know how your creators achieved this, or if some kind of red energy was involved?
...I think I remember our prisoners saying men start to go bald as they get older. Apparently some have a hard time coping with it.
...Who are you? You've been ranting about nosehair since I arrived. Is this what the idea of going bald does to men?
...Is it typical for a man to marry several women on Earth? On Mejare, we form couples---the egg-splicing process is complex enough with two people.
One man with multiple wives...I guess if you can impregnate several girls at once, forming couples like Mejarians do would be inefficient.
You pilot a mech, don't you? A man recently joined my squadron with a Van-type. Men seem to pride themselves on their melee designs, even on other worlds.
It seems like even Earth men prefer designing mech-types over Dread fighters. Your "Sentinel" model sounds like it has the same melee emphasis our male pilot's Vanguard does.
I usually expect men to be bigger and taller than women, or at least act like they are. That's how my male pilot deals with his size.
The man in my squadron is even smaller than you are. He makes up for that by being loudmouthed.
...Of the three men we have on board, our pilot is short and loud, one is tall and quiet, and one is tall and loud. I guess our pilot made me think men couldn't be small and shy.
What exactly are you measuring when you say you're collecting data on us playing? Are there actual energy signatures from our emotions?
You said you were collecting data on people interacting, right? Does that mean you're measuring some kind of emotional energy?
If you'd like me to trust you more than a bandit, maybe you can explain what you do for a living.
I haven't seen much of what men do for legitimate work. Maybe I'd be more trusting if you proved you're not a con artist.
...Has your sector maintained any contact with Earth? It sounds like it's far removed from it, even compared to Mejare's system.
I'd think Koprulu is in its own nebula if it's full of alien life. Have you heard anything about what conditions are like on Earth?
I assume you're part of Earth's military if you're piloting this Sentinel. Are you seeing combat with them?
Have your Sentinels actually been deployed somewhere? I have to imagine mechs are strictly for Earth's military.

state.text: Some big, lumbering, hairy beast with strange abilities is exactly how my homeworld always described men to me. Who knows what diseases you might be carrying.
Oversized, loud, and hairy---and inexplicable. If you've got any dangerous germs, then you're the spitting image of my planet's propaganda about men.

case.state: Short, scrawny men must be more common than I thought. The man on my Dread team is just like you, except he wouldn't put up with me calling him that.
When I was a girl, I was always taught that men were beasts that tower over women. But I could toss you around, just like the man in my squadron.
Are there a lot of undersized men? The male mech pilot we brought on board is about your size.
Do you have any experience piloting small fighter crafts? I've had to train a man that joined my squadron with a mech.
The man on my Dread team can be a hassle. If you fight with your resistance troops, then maybe you've done some small-craft piloting of your own.
Does "Fist of the Nosehair" extend to any other body parts? You've got plenty of hair.
...You really are covered in body hair. Can you string those ropes out of anything else?
...Since you're a bit older than our prisoners, I'd like to ask. That flesh-rod men have---does age affect it at all?
...It's hard for me to tell a man's exact age. Does that tube-organ of yours change as you get older, like how women's breasts sag?
You seem more proud of this "Japan" region of Earth than the whole planet. What makes it so unique?
Can you tell me more about "Japan"? From what I understand, it's just a small part of your homeworld.
...Men probably strip down around each other all the time, right? Especially crewmates.
This shouldn't bother a man, right? If you serve on the same ship, you probably see each other nude.
Death's been following our crew for a while now. You're not how I pictured it.
...The way death hangs over our ship lately, it's embarrassing to imagine you there.
I have a reputation for dodging, too. Speed past the enemy's attack and blow them away. There's no sense playing by their rules.
One clean hit can cripple a Dread. We put everything into power and just dodge attacks. That must sound familiar.
Isn't this what the toilet looks like in the men's quarters? I hope it's not talking to them.
...The bathroom in the men's section has an old frontier-era toilet. I haven't been inside. But if it talks, that explains a lot.
I guess Mejare had to get its image of men from somewhere. The only question is what germs you're carrying.
You're probably how the average girl on Mejare would picture a man. Hairy and top-heavy, and just barely humanoid.
We could actually use more bomb shipments, but giving one sentience is both cruel and dangerous.
We're running low on bombs after months of fighting. Keeping a conscious one in the munitions hold is a bad idea, though.
"Drawing more cards" is something my male pilot would come up with. He can never hide how he's feeling.
The whole point of poker is controlling yourself. I think Gascogne caught Hibiki trying to draw a sixth card once.
...You're an agent of Earth's government, and it's already dealing with some kind of---biological fallout. Is that right?
...Your missions. "Bio-organic disasters," or fallout in the environment---I'm surprised Earth has those problems already.
You sound like you don't get much time off of work. Do you worry about what might happen to Earth if these "incidents" keep cropping up?
All these environmental "incidents" sound like a growing problem. Earth's surface might be damaged forever if they're not contained.
Our quartermaster is a fan of old card games from Earth. Poker has made it to Mejare, but "Uno" may not have survived the frontier era.
I'm sure you enjoy "Uno," but it may just be a fad from this era. I've never seen Gascogne play it.
Your life in Neo Yokio doesn't sound too different from Mejare. I guess men have their own ways of keeping up appearances.
It's strange to hear a man discuss parties and fashion brands. My homeworld had an upper crust, too.
Stealing only from criminals sounds like how Magno's Family justifies ourselves. We're taking back what our homeworld stole from us.
"If Mejare won't help us, then we'll help ourselves to Mejare." That's our crew's attitude to piracy. It sounds like you steal with the same mindset.
From the thieves I know, they're quick to sell out their partners. Have you been on either side of that?
I'd expect a bandit to betray his partners. I'd also expect him to have been betrayed. What about you?
I guess you'd rather not talk about your work. But it's nice to see people on Earth keeping the planet healthy. That wasn't my assumption.
...You'd rather relax tonight, right? Well, I'm glad there's Earthlings who maintain the planet instead of poison it. I really wasn't sure.
We used to consider men "bio-organic weapons." They were piles of germs---one touch, and you'd get sick.
"Bio-organic weapons" is a good description of how we used to treat men. We hosed down our prisoners, plus anyone who touched them.
Have you found time for relationships? I can't see many girls willing to support the kind of work you do.
Most civilian girls I knew would be scared to let their partner work such dangerous jobs. Have you found one?
What does your training regimen look like? You build up a lot of muscle mass compared to us.
How do men usually exercise? I'd think a lot more strength training than we do.
For a minute, I was worried the whole planet smelled this bad. But it's just you, from across the room.
We always used to spray antiseptic when we raided Tarak. You're about what I would've guessed men smelled like.

So men call each other "whores," too.

....Sakura! Is your body just as disguised as Saki's was? Or even your entire group's?
I like what she's wearing. It's tight-cut in places, but she can still move around for combat.
What she has now is just fine, Jura. It's like a mix of our flightsuits and your combat dress.
...You two are classmates? ...Is this some kind of date? Between---male and female?
Classmates? ...Well, Mejarian girls date in school, too...men and women must do it on Earth.
Interesting location for classmates to date each other. That is what you're doing, right? ...Men and women?
A young man and woman, from the same school...not what I'd choose for a date, but then, I wouldn't date a man.
...You two are classmates? Men and women in school together...unthinkable.
Classmates? Futaba certainly seems like the booksmart type...I have a hard time picturing men in school at all.
I can't believe men and women could function in school together...and that they'd play strip poker together afterwards.
You're classmates, and you'd play this together? It'd be awkward enough just attending school with men...
...Sayori, are sure you want to hang around this girl? She...seems off.
I'd be wary if this girl is your friend, Sayori. It's my job to spot threats...
If this girl is who you'd call a friend, Sayori...then I'd say you should work on your character judgment. She isn't trustworthy.
I lived on the streets for a time...I know when a girl is manipulating others for her purposes. Monika isn't your friend, Sayori.
Hello, Misty. It's nice to see you again... apparently this is an outfit you wore as a girl? I lost all my old dresses and skirts...
If I had to bring something I wore as a girl here, it'd have to be my old school uniform...I guess you spent your time outdoors?
Hello again, Misty. I see you wore athletic outfits even as a girl---believe it or not, I used to wear sweaters and skirts.
I hope you've been well, Misty. I see you're reconnecting with your youth---my parents certainly didn't dress me in shorts and overalls.
Hello again, Elesa. I trust you're well---that's a nicer look than last time. Slim, efficient, and simple.
Is that really you, Elesa? You change your look as much as the average Mejarian---I prefer this one's simplicity.
...Elesa? I almost didn't recognize you with a different hair color---and outfit. This looks much sleeker and more practical.
Hello, Elesa. I see you've opted for a more practical side of fashion---it's better to move around like this, isn't it?
Hello again, Nami. I'm glad you've adopted that short hairstyle---it's more befitting of a pirate.
Is that you, Nami? You almost look younger since I last saw you...but I approve of your haircut.
Hello, Nami. As you might imagine, I recommend that any fighting woman cuts her hair short...though yours was beautiful either way.
I see you've taken after my haircut since we last met, Nami. It's quite practical---and it even seems to have made you look younger.
Not you again. What is this new fascination with appearing "normal"? It doesn't fit that garish Christmas outfit.
...If you're attempting to pass as "normal," Tharja, your old outfit was less conspicuous.
...You're that manic girl from last time. You won't deceive me into thinking you're "normal," especially dressed as a reindeer.
...Tharja? You still have that same obsessive look in your eye. And those clothes wouldn't even be "normal" on my planet.
...L'Arachel. You said you're a "Harvest Festival Princess," right? Do you realize Earth is harvesting organs from its colonists?

state.text: ...A "Harvest Festival Princess"? L'Arachel, do you know where Earth's harvested organs come from? Or is this a trap---?
L'Arachel, you're dressed...for a Harvest festival? This is a trap, isn't it? I knew I shouldn't have returned here---!

case.state: A scientist...is the princess of a Harvest festival? How twisted are Earthlings that you'd celebrate us being slaughtered---!
Emi...? What have you done to yourself? When we last met, you were upbeat and in good health...don't go down this path.

state.text: ...Is that you, Emi? I hope this isn't some attempt to prove yourself...I once made the same mistake.
...Emi, have you started dressing and acting this way to impress others? I once did the same thing...I'm not proud of those days.

case.state: ...Emi, if this is some rebellious phase you're going through, I'd advise against it. I was like you once, and I only survived because of my size.
...Emi, you shouldn't be acting like this. A girl your size won't last in streetfights and gangs---take it from my own experience.
Miss Misato, that's...very stark makeup. It almost looks like how Mejare depicts men---ghastly skeletons of death.

state.text: ...Minus their size, that makeup looks much like Mejare's images of men. Taut features stretched over fearsome skeletons...
...Miss Misato, this makeup is for Halloween? It looks akin to a sacrifice ritual---my homeworld always showed men as barbaric skeletons.

case.state: ...Is that you, Miss Misato? You were quite beautiful before, but... is this whole planet a death cult? Mejare always shows men performing sacrifices...
Oh, it's you, Miss Jessie. I hardly recognized you in such an impressive dress...I'd have expected you to just put on a Christmas hat.
Do most Earth girls dress up so elaborately for Christmas, Miss Jessie? Mejare celebrates it, as well...with hats.
...I see Earth takes its Christmas celebrations very seriously. Especially since you dressed so casually when I last met you.
I can only imagine the looks I'd get if I wore such a flashy outfit for Mejarian Christmas. Is it an Earth custom to dress up to this degree?
...An outdated model, now a ghost...I didn't think your situation would be so literal.
...Hello, "Megu." I was actually curious to meet Megumin again, but I guess I'll have to settle for your crude image of her.
...Is that you, Aella? I see your weaponry has progressed since we last met... though kinetic guns are still not on par with laser equivalents.
Hello, Pinkie. I see you're celebrating Earth's Easter...is it typical for girls to dress as rabbits in observance of this?
It's hard for me to know what's personal and what's cultural on Earth holidays...do girls usually dress as rabbits for Easter? Or...just skimpy?
...Is that you, Leonie? I guess you've graduated since our last game. How is that man Jeralt doing?
...Leonie? It looks like you've become a proper officer. Are you still fighting alongside that man Jeralt?
Your outfit looks great for combat, by the way. It's tight-cut in places, but you can still move around.
Form-fitting but practical---I'd always choose to fight in something like that. What you have is sort of an old-fashioned version of my flightsuit.
Here we go again. I just don't understand.
You can't run away from your problems, Florina...I've tried.
I appreciate girls that stand their ground against their fears...
Running away doesn't solve anything...your fears can always run faster.
Oh, for God's sake. I have far more reason to fear men, and I flew all the way here to face them...
Wha---how could anyone be so---are you serious?
What a disgusting girl, offering so bluntly...wait, you're letting her?
Unbelievable that someone could be so lecherous...wait, what? Don't let her touch you!
Wha---Jura, you don't even know this girl! Don't let her near you! Doesn't this place have rules about that?
Earth was devastated many years ago, so it started using its colonies as organ farms. Mejare is the uterus colony...so there's no men.
We've come to know a few men, actually...but Earth's organ-harvesting is why Mejare is nothing but women.
Mejare is just one of Earth's many colonies. It was intentionally settled as women-only for Earth to harvest reproductive organs.
Jura wanted to come here because we don't know much about men. Earth harvests uteri from Mejare, so there's no need for them.
This is how Jura treats everyone. She's quite proud of herself...and to be fair, no disasters have struck because of her.
I'll start reprimanding Jura when she starts endangering others during combat. For now it's just an annoyance.
I'm the squadron leader, yes, but Jura is second-in-command. Besides, she tends to get more serious when on missions...
Jura's second-in-command. She usually does her job...she just tends to get distracted with this sort of thing during downtime.
...Revy seems the type to act on that, Jura.
...Are you sure you want this woman touching you, Jura? I don't want to have to pry her off you.
I don't think Revy responds well to being teased, Jura. Fair warning.
...This isn't going to end without some physicality.
You take orders from this man, Rinkah? ...I guess this is a clash of cultures. No man is commanding me.
Hmhmhm...I'm sorry. It's just that...I would never take orders from a man.
Corrin's your commanding officer, Rinkah? I've fought beside men, but taking orders...no, thanks.
I knew Earth would bring some culture shock, but watching a woman take orders from a man is...well, laughable to a Mejarian.
So you two are classmates? I'd say you're not wearing the same uniform...but that may just be a cultural clash.
Shouldn't schoolmates be wearing identical uniforms? ...Maybe that's just a Mejarian custom.
I see classmates on Earth don't wear identical uniforms. That must be yet another Mejarian indoctrination practice.
I always had to wear a uniform to school on Mejare. If you two are classmates, I guess that's not a requirement on Earth.
Ah, so you two are comrades? I imagine Corrin is the officer, given her more professional look.
It's always good to see two strong women working together. Corrin's wearing armor, so I imagine she's your commanding officer.
Is Corrin your commander, Rinkah? You're speaking like she is, and she's more dressed for the part.
It's nice to see that, even on Earth, women fight together. And apparently the officers wear armor there, too...
I see you brought a friend along for moral support. Either that, or Lyn dragged you here for some sort of exposure therapy.
So...whose initial idea was it to come here? Either you're trying to be more confident, or Lyn is trying to make you that way.
Shame can be crippling, so I can see why you came here. Unless, of course, Lyn just dragged you herself.
I've never seen such a timid girl...I'd expect living around men to make you tough. Did you bring her here, Lyn, or did she bring you?
You two...are sisters? I...I had no idea Earth families were so sexually outgoing.
I was an only child...but I'm fairly certain Mejarian sisters wouldn't play this game together.
Sisters? ...So this is how Earth handles familial relationships.
I understand you grew up together as sisters, but...do you really want to strip naked in public together? Is this normal on Earth?
...What exactly is your relationship? Something related to magic, or just romance?
I see one of you dragged the other here...probably Zizou dragging Sola. Do you two have...a relationship?
Are you two a couple? You certainly seem like opposites...but many Mejarian couples are like that.
I see Earth women are also capable of forming companionships with each other. Good to see, even if you seem very different.
...Sisters? I knew soldiers lacked all common decency, but to drag your siblings into this...
A military woman...and her younger sister. As if I needed confirmation soldiers were depraved.
Soldier women always seem to show me new lows. Bringing their young sisters to strip poker, for instance.
You two are sisters? What kind of disgusting---well, a military woman fits the bill.
Jura, this girl is clearly unhinged. Don't antagonize her.
Jura, we don't know what this girl is capable of---either magically or mentally. Leave her alone.
Don't tease this girl about her obsessions, Jura. Can't you tell she won't take it as a joke?
...Jura, we don't know the extent of this girl's magic. We do know that she's mentally ill, and not afraid to use it.
...Mei, Mei, and Meia. This has to be some stupid prank on the part of this establishment...
...Are there any other "Meis" I should know about? This has to be some sort of joke.
...So, both of you are named Mei. I'll let you figure that out, and count myself lucky to have an "a" to set myself apart.
Hello to both of you...the two Meis. Playing with one similarly-named girl is confusing enough---I can't imagine how you must feel.
...Mei, Mei, and Meia. This has to be some stupid prank on the part of this establishment...
...Are there any other "Meis" I should know about? This has to be some sort of joke.
...So, both of you are named Mei. I'll let you figure that out, and count myself lucky to have an "a" to set myself apart.
Hello to both of you...the two Meis. Playing with one similarly-named girl is confusing enough---I can't imagine how you must feel.
...I've heard that men and women can be siblings on this planet. Are you two sister and..."brother"? Your faces look alike.
...Jolyne, is that man your..."brother," is the word? A male sibling...you and Jotaro have similar bone structure in your faces.
...Jolyne, do you know this man? You seem more surprised than unsettled by the energy he gives off...
...For some reason, I feel the same strange presence from both Jolyne and Kira...a man might be intimidating, but why her? ...Jolyne, do you know this man?
...No matter how diseased this planet is, it doesn't give you the right to siphon away our lives to sustain your own. Tell your leaders we'll always resist the Harvest.
...Whatever turned you into these corpses, colonists have a right to their own lives. And we'll fight your planet's forces until you realize our humanity.
...Now I'm just wondering when you'll get your own bucket.
...Will you be dumping water on your head, too? So we can drop this charade.
I have every right to be paranoid around you two now...
To think I was beginning to consider trusting you two...
I was a celebrity as a girl, too. But even my family was never hiding the rot quite so literally.
Seeing an idol try to hide her diseased body for the cameras makes me feel better about my family's contracts.
If your bodies are this damaged, have you not even received organ harvests? I hope you both realize those are taken from living colonists.
I'd expect Earthlings with fresh organs would have bodies in much better condition. Even if you're not the ones getting them, they're a product of slaughtered colonists.
...Are you going to rub off your body makeup at some point? I'm surprised you haven't already.
...Now that the secret's out about your idol group, I'd rather see what your body really looks like. You don't seem shy about it.
...I thought Marinette was Ladybug.
...So what you're saying is, Marinette made her public debut before Samus?
...What's "1981"? Sounds old...Marinette doesn't look old, especially not older than Samus.
Should you be talking about Samus and Marinette like this? I'm totally lost...

state.text: ...I wish I could get into the spirit as much as everyone else on the ship.
...The whole crew loves Christmas. It's the one time I actually feel alone.
Barnette's been a lot busier lately. I'm surprised she even came down here with you.
Barnette must have her own interest in this place if she took time off from Reg.

case.state: You ought to actually come in the water if you're going to wear that.
Why wear a swimsuit if you aren't going to swim? Don't just sit at the edge all ~background.time~.
...We're both taking things a little easier, but don't forget about the mission completely. Is that clear?
...Jura. Things seem safe for now, but our mission here is still very serious. Don't lose sight of that.
...With Barnette?
...You want us to fight?
Darkness...?
Uh...
...Am I supposed to feel bad about that?
It's not like I'm ashamed of it.
I'm sure she's been preparing this for days now.
Jura has prepared something for us.
...I wouldn't fill it.
It's too roomy...up top.
Magno's Family consists of deserters and displaced civilians, Yusei. Mostly the latter.
Magno's Family was formed by deserters, Yusei, and it recruits from refugees.

state.text: You can't help but want to look your best. Sleep is the one time you should focus on comfort.
I hope you're actually comfortable in that. You'll burn out if you're always focused on looking perfect.

case.state: ...You feel it, don't you? That faint trace of the Paksis...under cover of night.
...Jura. That aura, like the Paksis...everywhere, but nowhere. You should be able to sense it, too...
...That's not far off from the truth.
You could describe our raids like that as-is...
...She's surprisingly clean, given that.
...With that in mind, she looks pretty good.
All of us carry sidearms.
All pilots come armed to away missions.
Jura...
Momo...
...Jura, you can feel it here, can't you? The slightest trace of the Paksis.
...Jura, do you feel that? The pressure in the air. It's faint, but---it reminds me of the Paksis.
I figure you've got quite the show planned for us to~background.time~. You've got your looks and an audience.
You must be having the time of your life, playing a game where everyone's eyes crawl all over you.
...When we get home, I'm going to order some diagnostics run on the Dreads. I'm worried there might be some long-term damage building up.
With all the new enemies we've been fighting lately, there might be a lot of wear on the Dreads' internals. We should get them tested.
...You're right, with what you said. I think I like the idea of blowing Earthlings away as a team.
...Thanks for what you said last time. I wonder what kind of team we'd make as a couple of pinup models.
It's time for your big reveal, right? You always fly under a few layers of shielding.
It's just like you to play defense. A barrier, a diffusion shield, hanging back---now it's your moment.
...Jura, is there something you don't like about your body?
...Is there anything you don't like about yourself? Physically, I mean.
Maybe if she shows us this top-secret weapon she has. The "Keyblade."
