Showing your weapons is a good sign of trust. She's still keeping that "Keyblade" a secret.
That's correct. Our commander, B.C., named it. Why?
...You seem rather distressed over the name. Take it up with our commander.
That's correct. Are you interested in its specs, or just the name? Our commander came up with it.
Yes...it's a fusion ship from male and female vessels. B.C., our commander, named it...I offered "the Sonnet."
Earthlings really are clueless about their own colonies...or maybe it's because you're a man. We're not aliens.
Is this xenophobia or ignorance, N? Mejare was settled by Earth women. Jura and I are humans.
Ignorance of your own planet's colonies... typical of an Earthling, and a man. We're humans like you.
...Up until recently, we were taught men were aliens. I can only assume Earthlings are taught such about their fellow humans on Mejare.
...Jura, I haven't seen you in the gym lately. Considering you want to show off your nude body like this, I hope you're finding the time.
You were quite eager to come here when I haven't seen you exercise lately. Don't sit around scheming and eating Barnette's cooking when you should be staying fit.
...Jura, you usually join me in the gym for a bit when I'm on the treadmill. I haven't seen you recently---was this why?
...There are too many conflicts of interest for me to pursue romance. It's just part of being an officer...I'm sure you understand, Erufuda.
...I've explained this numerous times to Jura, but I'm in an awkward place for romance in terms of the chain of command. It's not feasible...
...There are few crew members who hold equal authority with me. You had a high status in your world, correct, Erufuda? Then you'd understand.
...Miss Jessie, if you're not serious about your advances on ~player~, you seem to be irritating Tharja.
...Miss Jessie, you should leave ~player~ alone. Tharja is obsessed with them and clearly mentally ill.
...Tharja, Jessie is an older woman who's just flirting. There's no need to guard ~player~ with this much jealousy.
...Tharja, Jessie has a child who's around your age. Why do you feel so threatened when she addresses ~player~?
...So, how long have you two been dating? I think you'd have to trust each other to be playing a game like this.
If you're comfortable talking about each other, I guess you've been dating for a while now. Is that right?
...You're right, Jura, she does. Maybe that's what Parfet sounded like back in school.
...I guess you've spoken to Parfet more, haven't you? I hear it now, too---a little younger-sounding.
...Our crew has gotten compliments from the men we find.
...Men seem impressed with us wherever we go.
...She must have a good reason.
It's not a bad thing to control your emotions.
You do a better job with me than most of the crew. Some people are never satisfied.
What are you complaining for? I actually spend time with you now and then.
I do brush my hair. It just sticks up like this---it always has.
I've tried fighting with it. Even when it's cut short, it's still spiky. You saw me when I joined the crew.

Jura?
...OK. We might learn something.
Jura, you don't have to...actually, let's see what she finds.
...She's a lot nicer than either of us.
...She's got a kindness we both lack.
If she's so serious, you can just ask her directly...
No need to gossip when it seems she'd give a straight answer.

Meia Gisborn, Chief Pilot of the Magno's Family outfit. I understand you're a representative of the "Knights of Favonius."
...Jura is ranked just below me.
We seem to hold the highest ranks here---in Magno's Family and in the "Knights of Favonius." Meia Gisborn, Chief Pilot...and Jura Basil Elden, second-in-command.
You work as a model? You and Jura here should talk.
You work as a model? Isn't that you've always wanted, Jura?
It seems Earth girls are capable of being vain, too, Jura...and models. Have fun with this girl.
This "academy" of yours sounds like a school...Mejarian schools are just government propaganda.
So, you go to school with men? Must be a pain getting them to sit still during a lecture.
I'm told you're into government. Mejare's is in need of reform, to put it bluntly.
I'm told you're into art. If you want that life-sized portrait, Jura, here's your chance.
This "academy" of yours sounds like a school. I dropped out of school...
I'm told you're into art. I know Duero painted Parfet something once, so maybe you two should talk.
You have a roommate at this school of yours? I'd never be comfortable without my single room.
You work as a model? So does Jura here. Fire away.
You work as a model? This is your chance, Jura. Make connections.
You go to school with men? Sounds distracting.
You're a student...I dropped out of school. Bad times.
I hope this "high school" of yours is a little less indoctrinating than Mejare's.
You're a "witcher"? What do you think, Jura? Was it for owning an anatomy book?
You're a "witcher"? Mejarians who associate with men get called witches...like us.
The word "witch" gets us a little touchy sometimes...I apologize.
The same person, both male and female...that shreds any doubts I had about men and women being the same species.
I wonder what Hibiki would look like as a woman...probably taller, honestly.
Male and female...you two would make perfect test subjects for Tarakkian scientists.
The same person, one born on Mejare and the other on Tarak.
I'll be honest...you both look like women, and I'm not sure which one is prettier.
You look like Paiway's first attempt at makeup.
So much makeup...I don't wear any. Just gets in the way.
See what too much makeup leads to, Jura? You shouldn't concern yourself with it.
...Do I have to be involved in this? I didn't even lose...and I don't want the ship seeing this.
The focus is on Jura. Don't rope me into this...I don't want my pilots seeing me here.
It's Jura's turn. Just take two pictures of her and be done with it...she won't care if the ship sees her here.
Can't you just photograph Jura? This could reach the ship...
We're both fighter pilots on the Nirvana, a fusion ship. I'm commander; Jura is second-in-command.
We're part of the fighter Dread team of the Nirvana, a ship created by the fusion of male and female machinery.
We're pilots for the Nirvana, a ship created in an energy fusion accident. Which reminds me...I have scheduling to do.
I'm the leader of our Dread squadron on the fusion ship Nirvana. Jura is second-in-command...as you can see by her attitude.
I'd be surprised if Jura parted with her boots too quickly...the only thing she loves more is her dress.
I doubt it. Jura has plenty of small things, Sei...she's just getting started.
I wouldn't bet on that, Sei. You should be able to see all her jewelry left...
Jura loves her own body, Barnette, her dress, and her boots, in that order...so they've probably got a while to go.
Tease me? Yes. But this place provides a particularly good avenue for it.
...Tease me and call me boring? This is more than usual, but yes, she does.
...You'll have to be more specific, Sei. If you mean calling me a sourpuss, yes, and even more so today.
A strip poker game is the perfect opportunity for Jura to call me both perverted and boring, if that's what you mean.
No, she just has absolutely no shame...and a supreme confidence in her body.
It's less that she wants to strip and more that she's convinced she's the most beautiful girl in the galaxy.
No, she doesn't normally strip in public...but as you can see, she clearly has zero qualms with people admiring her.

state.text: ...I think she just sees this as an opportunity to get more girls to ogle her, Sei.

case.state: Captain? I'm the squadron leader...our captain is an elderly woman named Magno Vivan.
...I'm not the captain, I'm the Dread leader. The Nirvana's captain is older than any of us.
The Nirvana's captain is a wise old woman called Magno Vivan. I'm just the squadron officer.
I'm just the Dread team leader. It'll be a long time before I'm our captain's age...
Cute name similarities aside, Jura, this doesn't seem like the kind of girl who laughs things off.
I think everyone will remember the difference, Jura. Unless you start threatening people.
...Jura, please try to evaluate someone's character before flirting with her.
Height, hair color, and general demeanor should be enough to tell you two apart, Jura.
Don't antagonize her, Jura. I can respect a girl who understands the value of silence.
You could do to learn from me or her when it comes to occasionally being quiet.
You can't learn anything from talking, Jura. Kyoko's being smart, listening in on us...
She does have my temperament. Don't take that as an insult, Kyoko...more girls should listen to others.
That's an elegant dress...your outfit is like Ezra's, and your sword like Jura's here.
You dress like Ezra...you kind of look like her, too. But the sword is distinctly Jura.
You look pretty good with that sword. Jura, you should take lessons from this girl.
As long as you've got that sword, maybe you could show my crewmate some techniques. She's been slacking lately.
This is a card game. Why'd you come armed with...whatever that thing is?
You look pretty good with that sword. Jura, take instructions from this girl so you can actually put that rapier to use.
Fascinating. That sword looks like it's made from the lasers our rings use.
I don't think people will be confused. This girl seems a lot more well-known on this planet.
One letter can make all the difference...just like one mistake.
If you actually got us confused, I'd have Duero check your eyes before you posed a danger to the team.
I trust my second-in-command to track the subtle differences between Mei and I.
...Another of me. I'm still not taking a day off.
Two Meias? Look at that, Jura. Which do you prefer?
Playing with more than one of me is sweet. Have you extended the same love to Jura here?
I'm glad you like me enough to play with more than one of me, ~player~. Do you like Jura, too?
Two of me? Give Jura some attention, too, ~player~. She's not a bad person.
Wha---don't bring up Misty. It's not like she'll understand.
You---I---Misty and I are not an item. I just give her advice.
You know perfectly well Misty's into men, Jura...and also that she's too young.
Why do you try to twist my relationship with Misty into love? She just...needs guidance.
You just want attention...
I wanted a challenge, and I get you.
...Insufferable.
For God's sake...
Is it Moon's turn again? Perfect, no reason to care...
Walking Mejarian propaganda, this girl...look what men have done to her.
I know a male doctor who'd like to inspect you for diseases, Moon...and the limits of female physiology.
You wear quite a bit for a girl so eager to strip. At least that gives me work time...
...I'm glad you're here, Misato. You paint a more flattering picture of an Earth woman with experience with men.
You should know that Moon fits the Mejarian stereotype of a woman who sympathizes with men, Misato. You're a much more respectable example.
It's nice to see, in Misato, an Earth woman who's had sex with men and hasn't become a shambling wreck. Moon is the shambling wreck.
This is quite the mixed message about men. You seem well-adjusted, Misato, but Moon might represent the result of prolonged male contact.
...Navi, do you know this girl? You're all excited...does she live on Planet Hyrule, as well?
...Is there something about Nayru we should know, Navi? You're acting as if she has some authority on Planet Hyrule...
Nayru is from Planet Hyrule, too, then? I see girls can vary dramatically there...you're quite excited, Navi.
Two girls from Planet Hyrule, then? And not very similar...apparently Nayru holds considerable authority over Navi.
You're a goddess? Don't be so vain.
You're a goddess because you live in the sky? There's a lot more to the universe than that.
A "goddess"? I'm sorry if I ever called you vain, Jura. This is a new one.
You have some competition for extravagant dress, Jura. And vanity, apparently.
I feel your pain. I command a short, overconfident man myself.
Well, this is one way to grow closer to your colleagues. I sure wouldn't want any crewmates here.
Surely a goddess wouldn't need a man to help her.
You study human culture? What exactly are you?
You study human culture? I could probably learn from you...
You study human culture? Duero has an anatomy book you might be interested in reading...
"Pearl"? Jura's already a big fan of yours.
And you call me chilly, Jura. At least I show my face.
You look like that outfit has never come off.
You can show your face, Raven...I know being open with people can be hard.
Clearly I need to show less emotion, then.
You're right. I could really improve my stoicism by watching her.
A concession? I thought you were going to tease me all night.
I'm sure she has her reasons. Stoicism is important for a leader...
You're certainly acting more cheerful, Raven. Maybe I should follow suit...
Something about this game lightened you up in a hurry. That was supposedly why I came here...
Well, Jura, if you had doubts stripping can improve a girl's spirits...if it worked for Raven, there's hope for me.

state.text: Something about stripping has brought out a lighter side of you. Now everyone will expect that of me.

case.state: I'm not sure I'd want to date someone who'd agree to it in a seedy place like this.
Unless she's heading to Mejare soon, I can't see that relationship working out.
You seem far more interested, Jura. She is blonde, after all.
Maybe you could flirt with her and bring her back. Barnette could use some target practice.
Maybe if she agreed to join the crew...but what from I hear, she hunts pirates.
That's quite the outfit. You may have competition, Jura...but then, you like that.
I've heard Earth girls dress like you to attract men. Mejarians do it to attract each other...
Well, you're certainly devoted to matching colors. I wear what I have.
You're...a little pale. Are you feeling alright?
So pale...muscular, but...you look sickly.
And you call me pale. This woman's marble-white.
...Is there no sun on your planet? I'm...so sorry.
That's a vivid hair color...look, Jura, another one.
You're a fiery one...she's how I picture your and Barnette's daughters, Jura.
My crewmates and I all have different hair colors...you've certainly got the energy befitting yellow.
Genetic engineering on Mejare has resulted in some pretty outlandish hair colors...your yellow betrays an intense personality.
You work in a team of girls? Well...seems Earth and Mejare aren't that different after all. You've even got the fire of Jura here.
It's good to see a girl who can carry herself, apparently...you've certainly got the spirit for it.
I hope you realize the kindness I'm doing you by dressing this way, ~player~. That other Meia is wearing my favorite bodysuit.
I decorated myself like this for you, ~player~...just so you know. That bodysuit is much more comfortable---and sleek.
Did you have to invite a normally-dressed clone of me, ~player~? It's just making me miss my bodysuit even more.
...~player~, do you have something to tell me, picking both of my costumes? For the record, I prefer suits.
Wouldn't you agree a bodysuit is a better look for me, ~player~? It's practical---and it reveals my figure without showing skin.
If your idea of a perfect Valentine's Day is spending time with me in two different outfits, ~player~...that's really flattering.
That Cupid costume is ridiculous enough in front of a mirror. ~player~, you're embarrassing me.
...Well, ~player~? Do you prefer me in a bodysuit or a ridiculous Cupid outfit?
Cupid Meia? ...~player~, are you trying to engineer some sort of clone-threesome with me?
Mirrors didn't do this justice. Seeing me in that Cupid outfit from every angle...how do you like me better, ~player~?
That Monster Girl outfit is certainly revealing. You should know, ~player~...I'd prefer a partner who likes me in my suit.
...Are you trying to decide which outfit you like better, ~player~? I am not dressing up like that all the time.
I'm not sure how to feel, ~player~, knowing that you don't think Valentine's Day is romantic enough with only one of me.
...Two of me, and we're both in Cupid outfits? I can only help you so much in finding love, ~player~.
Normally I'd like you liked me by choosing a clone, ~player~...but I think you just want a Cupid's help.
You do realize this is just a Valentine's costume, ~player~? Picking more Cupids won't magically bestow you with love.
I hope you're not expecting us Cupids to find love for you, ~player~. Unless...you're saying you want me around.
...Are you done insulting us? You weren't even brave enough to fight when you were armed---and stay away from Jura.
I'm sick of you running your mouth. Insult me if you want, but don't you dare involve my second-in-command.
Leave Jura out of this, Revy. Your quarrel is with me---but, of course, you're a coward who picks on those weaker than her.
Don't you dare lay a hand on my pilots, Revy. I guess you're too cowardly to fight me.
Is it true you're a swordswoman? Jura, this girl might make a good practice partner for you.
Jura, have you been practicing with your rapier lately? Apparently this girl has sword experience---you should spar with her later.
Two Juras? Well, you've certainly dolled yourself up to earn this.
I guess all that teasing really did the trick, Jura. ~player~ loves you enough to put another one.
Good. Twice the vanity, half the responsibility.
I don't make any effort to look beautiful, so I see why ~player~ would want two of you instead...
...Is that you, Emi? It looks like we both gave our best efforts dressing up for today. Would others ever expect you to wear that?
Oh, hello, Emi. I guess I'm not the only girl who thinks Valentine's Day is worth dressing up for. Were your friends shocked to see you like that?
You're, uh...a little pale. Are you feeling alright? And you're not wearing much...
So pale...muscular, but...you look sickly, despite how little you're wearing. Trouble breathing?
And you call me pale. This woman's marble-white. And she doesn't really have the wardrobe for this game...
...Is there no sun on your planet? You're certainly dressed for it.
That's a vivid hair color...it matches yours, Jura. But I can't say the arm does.
You're energetic...how'd you lose your arm?
My crewmates and I all have different hair colors...none of us have mechanical arms.
Genetic engineering on Mejare has resulted in outlandish hair colors...maybe we could regrow your arm.
I'd say I'm sorry, but...that mechanical arm looks pretty useful.
It's good to see a girl who can carry herself...and maybe lift herself, too.
...What do you think, Jura? Should we have our arms replaced with robotics?
...This girl talks a lot like you, Jura. She's not afraid to be "seen" if it means getting what she wants.
...I can see you living like this girl if we weren't pirates, Jura. Charming others with your body, collecting "elegant" things.
You look cute in that outfit, Nagisa. Mejare has maid cafés like that, too.
It's been a while since I saw a girl dressed in a maid café outfit. They exist on Mejare, too...in scattered locations.
...I can't stay stoic when a sweet girl like you dresses up. I visited a few maid cafés on my homeworld.
As if we didn't know it was Valentine's Day, Nagisa comes dressed like that...Mejare's maid cafés were packed around this time, too.
I can't believe I landed here in the middle of a gang war. Which one of your teams actually holds the advantage?
You two sure do a lot of barking. Are your gangs locked in a stalemate, or is one side actually winning?

...If you're linked to a giant encyclopedia, and it even knows about our crew.
...What does it say about me?

So there's information out there about our crew.
...Do the pilots have descriptions?
...So that's what it is. I never bothered trying to learn any of it.
...Oh, right. What they encrypt their messages in. Good catch, Jura...
...Huh. I can only make out some of them...the ones we use.

I never had any sisters growing up.
...Do they do this sort of thing?
...Are sisters this close with each other? I was---an only child.
...Did something happen between you and a man, Nagisa? I figured Earth girls would be comfortable around them.
...Are you worried about men? I thought you lived together with them on this planet.
I'm not sure how to feel. This is easier, but I wanted to see a man's body for myself.
I was hoping to play with a man, actually. Our ship already has secondhand rumors floating around.
When it comes to men, you seem especially shy. I guess I figured Earth girls were all used to them.
I guess growing up around men doesn't mean you'll be confident around them. It seems to bother you, too.
I pictured Earth girls stripping around men the same way we'd do with each other. Maybe some shyness is just instinct.
...That's your male parent, right? Are men usually like that with their daughters?
..."Dad" means the man in your family, right? I haven't really pictured them as parents.
We'd still compete with each other. I did everything I could to stand out on the Dread team.
Even on a team, there's competition. I wanted to be our best pilot from the day I joined.
We've just met each other. Friendships take time and effort.
That's not something we can just decide. Friendships have to grow.
That's a good attitude. It's the one I've always had, and I've learned a lot about myself from it.
...That's always been my approach to things. You'll learn who you really are.
There's only life there because we terraformed them, Nagisa.
It's not in the way you think, Nagisa. They're all colonies terraformed by Earth people.
...Where I'm from, we do get excited. But it's not always about your body---it's about the trust you have to let others see it.
...Don't you trust us by now? For a lot of girls I know, that's what this really means. You trust them enough to show yourself.
That's fine. Even if we didn't strip at all, there's a lot to learn from the Earth of this time.
It would've been worth visiting this planet, in this time, with or without uniforms.
...What are your plans for when it's over?
...What'll you do when school ends?
...Are you saying Earth is prudish with this sort of thing?
So the culture here sees this as pretty risqué?
...Why try to mislead us?
What's the point of hiding that? Especially in a game like this.
...You have to be grateful for what you have, or maybe what's come in its place.
...Even if it seems like you've lost everything, that leaves room for something new.
You've seemed more traditional all game.
Traditional's what we've come to expect from you.
You're...a little thin on clothes to be playing this, don't you think?
Are you making fun of me? You've barely got anything on.
I've heard of Valentine's Day...but that's for love, not indecency.
Shouldn't you have come to a strip poker game...clothed?
That's about how much Barnette wears with her apron.
That's a cute costume, Estelle. Mejare has Halloween, too, though we're taught that no monster is as frightening as men.
On Mejare, "witches" usually refers to man-sympathizers...but we do have Halloween. You look nice, Estelle.
Hello, Estelle. I'm happy to see Halloween is mostly the same on Earth---girls dressing in cute costumes.
Oh, it's you again, Estelle. I see Earth's dress-up custom for Halloween is no different than Mejare's---we retained a lot of Earth holidays.
I see you've...died since we last met, Weiss. My apologies...what happened at your wedding?
...Weiss, have you---died? That's a grim reminder of fate---were you marrying a man? Did he kill you?
...Well, now. It's good to know women can keep their forms after death...I assume you died at your wedding?
...Weiss? You---you died at your wedding? I knew trusting men to that extreme was dangerous---!
It's good to see you again, Estelle. I'd heard this planet has warm summers---that looks like the kind of outfit I might wear myself.
Is that you, Estelle? I used to enjoy Mejare's summers quite a bit, though they were more mild than Earth's. I even had a hat just like that one.
...Weiss, did you say you're here for a tan? My homeworld tends to prefer fairer skin as a beauty standard.
It's nice to see you again, Weiss. You seem more experienced than last time---and you have a new outfit to show that.
Hello again, Weiss. That's a different dress than when we last met---the colors are closer to what I would wear.
Hello, Weiss. I hope your family is well...is that a different dress? It looks darker and more practical, like something I'd wear.

...Spooky? If you meant to dress up for Valentine's Day, a nurse is more of a Halloween outfit.
...But I guess you can't escape Halloween.
...You're the same ghost from last time. "Spooky." You must always be associated with Halloween, even on Valentine's Day.
...Bernadetta? It's good to see you again, especially this time of year. Is Earth Christmas a gift-giving holiday like on Mejare?
Oh, it's you, Bernadetta. Seeing Earth girls celebrate Christmas reminds me of home---do you give each other gifts here?
...Is that you, Bernadetta? I don't really like get-togethers, but Christmas is nostalgic for me. Do you exchange gifts on this planet, too?
That's an elaborate outfit... what's Earth's view of Easter? On Mejare, it represents our founders' divine voyage.
I'm curious just what Easter means on Earth. On Mejare, it's the day an angel led us off Earth to escape men.
Easter on Mejare is the day the angel Gynos led us to our new homeworld. What does it mean to Earthlings?
I didn't know Earthlings celebrated Easter. Mejare's Easter is the day we left to found the colony---led by an angel.
That's an unorthodox look for Valentine's...maybe you feel more comfortable encouraging others' love than finding yours.
That's an interesting choice of outfit, Ochako. I guess a hero would rather cheer others' love than risk her own heart.
Dressing as someone who encourages others to find love...we're of the same mind, Ochako. Both reluctant.
A Cupid makes others fall in love---just like a Valentine's cheerleader. I struggle with my own feelings, too, Ochako.
I understand black cats are a symbol of misfortune here. Mejare's equivalent is men.
A black cat. Mejare usually uses a man's silhouette to show bad luck---to the surprise of no one here, I'm sure.
I didn't know Earth had such a hatred of black cats. Mejare would have you believe our misfortune comes from men.
Black cats for Halloween, rabbits for Easter...Mejare barely has any animals. We blame bad luck on men.
It's good to see someone who shares my fashion sense...on most days.
Bodysuits can get uncomfortable, wouldn't you agree? I hear you normally wear one.
You pilot a mech? So does Hibiki...and he's learning. But he always dresses the same, unlike you.
So, what's planet Korea like? Never heard of it...is this how people dress there?
You're a pilot, too? Mechs, Dreads, they're all fascinating...even though you're not dressed for the part today.
Easter has nothing to do with rabbits on Mejare. What's so significant about them on this planet that you'd dress as one?
On Mejare, Easter is the day our founders' divine journey from Earth began. Here, you...celebrate rabbits?
...I take it the rabbit is some sacred animal to Earthlings? Why would you dress as one on Easter?
Why are you dressed as a rabbit for Easter? Mejarian Easter is very much about Mejare---so I'm not sure what Earth honors.
I've heard passersby call you "Dahlia." Is this more deception on your part, Ini?
I'd compliment you on the dress, but I'm curious why some workers here think your name is "Dahlia"...Ini.
That's a nice dress for a girl who deals in deception. Is this "Dahlia" I keep hearing about your alter ego?
I happen to like sundresses and parasols...it's a shame I share a fashion sense with you. Is "Ini" your real name, or "Dahlia"?
...Is that you, Moon? So skin-bleaching procedures exist on Earth...not that it's helped your personality.
Bleached skin...are pale girls seen as more promiscuous on Earth? That's how you want us to treat you, after all...
Ugh...not you again. You can bleach your skin and dye your hair, but your lack of self-respect is still sickening.
...Moon? What unnatural procedure did you submit yourself to to bleach your skin? You're not even acting different...
...Hello, Juri. I'm surprised a vagrant thug bothered to dress for summer as she searched for victims.
Juri...I don't suppose you've mellowed out since we last met. Even if you've dressed for the season.
You again...your original outfit would probably have kept you cool in summer. Do you have your original attitude?
Of all the girls I had to meet again... seasonal dress never struck me as one of your priorities. Not over starting fights.
I see wedding dresses aren't much different on Earth. But... you usually marry men, right?
If you ask me, Earth girls should take Mejare's lead and marry each other. Men are superfluous with today's technology.
Sometimes I've wondered about getting married... but no girl would marry a pirate. I guess your fiancé is a man?
A gown...Mejare's wedding dresses are a bit sleeker, but the real difference is the other girl at the altar.
You again...the horrible aura you give off is even stronger now. You feel connected to this place somehow...
Monika? Dressed up for Valentine's Day, and giving off even worse vibes than usual. Like we're all pawns to you...
Even dressed up for Valentine's, you make a pit in my stomach. How can a schoolgirl give off such murderous energy?
You again? Today? The look in your eyes is even worse than before---why do I get the feeling it's tied to this place?
Not again...somehow, your aura is even worse today. Overt murderousness rather than passive.
Not you again. Our last game made me feel nauseous...maybe the summer breeze will help.
You? I was hoping for a relaxing summer's day, and I find the girl whose very presence unnerves me...
...Not the ominous schoolgirl again. She never hurt anyone, and yet just being near her claws at my stomach.
...You can dress in casual summer wear all you want, Monika. I know you're still up to something...our last game made me nauseous.
Nugi-chan? You must work for this bar year-round...do you serve ice water?
Hello again, Nugi-chan. I see you work summers here, as well---I'll take some ice water next hand.
...If you wouldn't mind continuing to serve drinks, I'd like a glass of water. Does the Inventory make for stable employment?
Is that you, Nugi-chan? You really do work for this establishment...ice water, please.
Rinkah, you look... ghastly. This is how a Mejarian might dress up to show girls what men look like.
What's the meaning of this horrifying fire spirit makeup? Like men in my planet's propaganda...!
...How long did it take you to create this costume? You're a walking fireball---not unlike Mejare's pictures of men.
...Rinkah? My God, you look horrific. I didn't know the "Flame Tribe" matched Mejare's depictions of men...!
...That's about how Mejare would have you picture men. Hellish, fiery ghouls. Is Halloween that important here?
...Is that you, Rinkah? Flame Tribe, indeed...cover yourself in germs, and you'll match how Mejare depicts men.
I see you've taken the Mejarian approach to armor this Halloween: cover the shoulders, and leave your body exposed.
I'd claim that armoring only your shoulders is ineffective, but Mejare is guilty of that, too. Is it purely for Halloween?
I doubt pure shoulder armor will protect you from the horrors of Halloween. And you're a ground warrior, not a pilot.
Metal shoulder armor seems like little more than excess weight. But then, this is just a Halloween costume, right?
My crewmates and I all have different hair colors...our outfits tend to vary, too.
Genetic engineering on Mejare has resulted in some pretty outlandish hair colors...you've got some strange outfits yourselves.
You work in a team of girls? Well...seems Earth and Mejare aren't that different after all. Besides those bizarre outfits.
It's good to see a girl who can carry herself, apparently. And dress herself in different ways.
Did you get dressed up for this? I know a few Mejarians that are obsessed with fashion...
Oh, it's you, L'Arachel. I see not even a holy woman is above spending a day at the beach...while still armed.
Hello, L'Arachel. Even in casual swimwear, you bring a weapon along...not unlike me when we encountered an island planet.
Maybe we're more alike than I thought, L'Arachel. I've kept my weapon on me even as we've gone for swims, too.
It's nice to see you again, L'Arachel. You must not be fully committed to beach leisure if you've brought your staff.
Shouldn't a "magical girl" fighter know how to swim? Unless that inner tube is just for relaxation.
Are you proclaiming your love of cheeseburgers, or can you not swim? I'd expect that from a "magical girl."
Hello, Sayaka. I'm surprised to see you with an inner tube---I can teach you to swim if you would like.
...Do you not know how to swim, Sayaka? It's a great full-body exercise---a fighter like you could benefit from it.
Hello again, Sheena. I have a blue swimsuit that's just like that one...though I don't fill it quite as well.
That one-piece swimsuit looks just like the one I have for Mejare's summers. We've encountered a few planets with beaches...
You look very nice in that swimsuit, Sheena. I dress for summer in a one-piece of my own, but you wear it better.
I have one swimsuit to my name, and it's a blue one-piece...it looks like yours. Of course, I don't have to stuff my breasts into it like that.
So, you're wealthy enough to vary your attire? I grew up wealthy...didn't last.
My crewmates and I all have different hair colors, too...none of us have white, but maybe money does that to you. As well as letting you change outfits.
Genetic engineering on Mejare has resulted in some pretty outlandish hair colors...seems you could afford a wardrobe change, too.
I should have expected a wealthy girl to change her wardrobe...I would, too, if I owned anything.
You work in a team of girls? And your outfit is different...we don't really have uniforms, either.
It's good to see a girl who can carry herself. And has the finances to vary her outfit.
Hello again, Raven. I agree with the new outfit color, but a fighting woman shouldn't let her hair grow.
Is that you, Raven? It's good to meet you again...but I see you're getting sloppy. You ought to keep your hair short like me.
White is a good color, Raven...but why haven't you cut your hair? A warrior can't have it getting in her eyes.
You keep brushing your hair out of your eyes, Raven. I understand wanting to look beautiful, but it can't limit your ability to fight.
Hello, Zizou. I hope your business of being a goddess is going well...you seem to have the free time for a day at the beach.
I wasn't expecting to see a magical goddess at the beach. I trust you've been hard at work.
Oh, it's you, Zizou. That's quite the casual outfit for a goddess, even at the beach. Have you developed any new magic?
Shouldn't a goddess of magic be too busy for a day at the beach? You look like you're enjoying yourself.
You're awfully dressed-up for this game. Seems pointless when your clothes will come off anyway.
Is that the kind of outfit that attracts men? If so, Jura will have an easy time finding one.
Makeup...don't see the point. Jura certainly does, but I've never seen eye-to-eye with her.
All dolled-up...just another form of dishonesty.
Hello, Emi. It's good to see you again---are lemons an important cultural symbol on Earth this time of year?
Oh, it's you, Emi. It's springtime where you live on Earth, right? Or is there some other significance for the lemon?
...Is that you, Bernadetta? You look much older than last time---are you serving as an officer now?
...Bernadetta? You look like you've graduated since we last met---and you've grown a few inches, as well.
Mavis...? You're that girl with vampire powers. If you're still learning about humanity, many girls on our ship wear Halloween costumes like yours. You're---filling it out nicely.
Oh, it's you, Mavis. Are you just here to celebrate Halloween this time? Some of my crewmates wear costumes like that, with their figures just---spilling out.
It's good to see you again, Mavis. I see you've learned about human holidays---I have crewmates who stuff themselves into a few slings for Halloween.
...You're Yunyun, right? You wanted us to be your friends. I don't know if Halloween is a social holiday on Earth like it is on Mejare.
...You're the girl who was part of the "Crimson Demons." If you're still looking to socialize, I guess Halloween is a good opportunity...it is on Mejare, at least.
Oh, it's you, Estelle. I see you're dressed as Santa Claus---she's a popular Christmas character on Mejare, too.
So, Earth celebrates Christmas with Santa Claus, too. Our captain likes to dress up as her around this time, as well.
...Emi? Hello again---I guess you're dressed this way for Valentine's Day. I actually wore the same kind of racy outfit one year.
I'm glad you're keeping well, Emi---I see Earth girls have racy Valentine's outfits of their own. Maybe I should've worn that Cupid costume.
...You're that girl who was training under "Captain Jeralt," aren't you? If we weren't in low orbit, I would've tried to enjoy summer during my pilot training.
...Leonie? It is you---I'm glad you can find some time for the beach, even with your training. I haven't been on Mejare's surface for summer in a long time.
You're that girl who trained Earth animals for a living. Didn't you say your "Hoenn" region was tropical? I would've figured you'd be used to the heat.
I don't think I'd celebrate summer if Mejare weren't so temperate. Don't you come from a tropical region on Earth?
I hope you've been doing well since we last met, Laevatein. I probably should've changed out of my suit myself.
...Laevatein? It's good to see you again. I guess it doesn't make sense to wear a full bodysuit out in the heat.
Oh, it's you---Sheena, the assassin. I've seen other girls wear that sort of bunny costume on Earth---I guess to entertain the patrons?
...I assume that bunny outfit isn't typically what assassins wear. I think I've seen waitresses in it around here---is that Earth's way of exploiting them?
It's nice to see you again, Pyrrha. I used to take summers for granted when I lived on Mejare's surface.
...Hello again, Pyrrha. Do you usually head out to enjoy the summer? It reminds me of Mejare's seasons, back when I wasn't living in orbit.
..."Wikipe-tan," right? The girl advertising Earth's encyclopedia. Do you know anything about current threats to this planet's environment?
...I see you're still advertising for that encyclopedia project even in the heat. Maybe you know something about the history of Earth's climate, or any threats to it?
You're that "Aether" researcher, Y'shtola. Do you know if Earth applies any climate control---maybe using those crystals?
It's you again...Y'shtola. Do those "Aether" crystals you study have any use in terraforming planets? Or even controlling Earth's heat?
You again...the proud murderer. Are you back to finish the job this season?
Somehow I don't think summer has made you any less murderous. What are you still doing here?
Is that you, Dawn? In the witch's costume? Our engineer's doing fine---hopefully you are.
Even dressed as a witch, you still sound like Parfet. But she was a robot last Halloween.
...It's you. I guess waving around a knife wasn't enough when you said you wanted to murder us all last time?
...You. So you weren't satisfied threatening to kill us all with just a knife. Now you're in full costume with a pitchfork?
...You're the girl who wrote for encyclopedias. You're dressed for Halloween, right? What are the most celebrated holidays on Earth?
So Earth has Halloween, too...just like Christmas. Have you written any articles on Earth's biggest holidays? Maybe there's others we share.
...It's you again. "Senko the Helpful Fox." Are you taking time off of your pampering to celebrate Halloween?
Oh, it's you, Senko. Is this part of your pampering work to dress up and dye your hair, or are you just celebrating the night?
I take it Earth's oceans are just as populated as the land. You're dressed like one of the predators, right?
You're the girl who makes computer games, right? Aoba. If Earth's Halloween is anything like Mejare's, it might inspire a few characters.

Oh, it's you, Aoba. Have you been working on new computer games?
...If they feature monsters, I guess Halloween would fit. Mejare celebrates it the same way.
Petra, right? The princess from "Brigid." My world has Halloween, too---is it a custom all over Earth?
Oh, it's you, Petra. Even if Earth is split into kingdoms like Brigid and Fódlan, it's nice to see that holidays like Halloween are still celebrated all across the planet.
Yuna, right? Those ghosts are unmistakable. I remember wanting to trade my uniform for a punk-rocker's look when I was in school.
It'd be hard to forget the girl who had two ghosts accompanying her. Those Halloween outfits remind me of the punk bands I listened to as a girl.
Hello again, Lux. If you're still in exile, at least you have time to celebrate holidays. Halloween is one Mejare carried over.
You're the girl who could control light, aren't you? Halloween is a Mejare holiday, too. I hope this means you've returned to Demacia---or at least doing well.

state.text: I wouldn't expect a shy schoolgirl to be here. What are you doing in this kind of place?
...I don't mean to be rude, but you seem kind of coddled. How did you end up playing a game like this?

case.state: You're better settled in now, aren't you? I don't get much practice talking to civilians.
I hope you're starting to feel more confident. I'm not used to giving girls all day to prepare themselves.
It sounds like you spent a lot of time with your parents. Do you treat each other well?
The way you talk about them, you seem close to your parents. Is that right?
It must have been hard falling ill in school. I was always running around, playing sports and fighting other girls.
Ill health is one problem I've never had. Even as a girl, I was full of energy, always getting dirty.
The "Big Dango Family" is a plush line, right? The kind of thing they make pillows out of.
One of our bridge operators has a whole collection of plush dolls and costumes. That's what the "Big Dango Family" is, right?
...Have you spent time dating anyone, Nagisa? Male or female.
Friendships are one thing. Have you had a girlfriend in school? Or a---boyfriend.
...Nagisa. You may be embarrassed, but I'd never laugh at someone for showing their true self.
It takes a lot of courage for someone to show who they really are. If you're worried we'll make fun of you...I won't.
Some girls on the crew say I have no sense of humor. The way I see it, if you tell too many jokes, people will start to take them seriously.
Sometimes girls tell me to lighten up and crack jokes. But I feel like if I do that, they'll start to want them all the time.
...I hate the image this is giving me of Earth grafting our body parts onto theirs. It's like the skin hasn't been laid on.
I know this about computers, but...the thought of Earth stitching bodies together like this is chilling.
If the biggest problem facing Earth's archives is street criminals, that's better than Mejare's imperial censorship.
It'd be rich of me to say Earth lets its encyclopedias get vandalized when Mejare censors theirs.
My mother once said we have to terraform with the planet's volcanoes in mind. Eruptions just seemed like a bad thing.
I remember asking my mother once why we didn't terraform Mejare's volcanoes away. She said something about disturbing the tectonics.
This planet probably would need agents to deal with all the rotting corpses shambling around.
"Zombie" must be the world for what Earthlings become after too much organ replacement.
...It's been a long time since I dressed up. Red's not my color, but it looks really striking on you.
...Are you dressed up for this game? I haven't worn anything that expensive since I was a girl. It's---eye-catching.
...That's the outfit of a succubus? I saw girls wear things like that all the time---at punk shows and in gangs.

Those look more like street clothes than "succubus" clothes.
...Well, "street" clothes.
...If you put on a jacket, you'd look a lot like how I used to dress. That, and some tears on the pants.
...Your outfit doesn't feel "casual" to me. It reminds me---of my old look.
Our history began when Earth finally developed space travel. I can't imagine what might happen if time travel comes next.
People call space the final frontier, but a "timegate" might make even that obsolete.
I don't think anyone on our ship owns a suit. I guess no one joins a pirate crew to be dress formal.
For all the fashion girls explore on our crew, I've never seen a suit. Maybe it reminds them too much of "proper" life.
I think our little nurse might wear pajamas like that. She has all sorts of plush frogs.
Our ship's nurse is a little girl who loves frogs. There might be some on her pajamas like you have.
...Before meeting you, I would've thought "alchemy" was something only for Halloween.
Halloween is for ghosts and curses and that sort of thing. I would've put "alchemy" in that category if not for you.
...What do you mean, you were "reborn"? Is this another part of your "alchemy"?
You say you were "reborn"---I guess through your alchemy. What actually happened?
I know the feeling of extra "control." When the Paksis transformed our Dreads, it was more like I was piloting with my mind than my hands.
Our new Dreads came with new controls. Every maneuver felt like it came easier after that. Is that sort of what you're going through?
...That's a cute costume, Ringo. Maybe I should wear something that makes me play a character, too.
If I wanted to really embrace Halloween, I'd dress as something that required me to role play, like you. Something funny and affectionate.
I think I've played "Tetris" before. It's that computer game where you stack blocks, right? It was fast with a lot to keep track of.
I never really played computer games, but "Tetris" sounds familiar. It sped up as you stacked blocks, I think. I like that simple intensity.
...Is this how you dress when a suitor visits your dungeon? Extra revealing, with a knife in hand?
You look like you're ready to go to bed with someone---and then kill them. Do you wear this for the "Dungeon of Death"?
...Is "Gengar" some ghost of ships lost at sea?
"Gengar" must be a Pokémon. Is it a ghost haunting the ocean where you're from?
You've hiked across your whole homeland, right? It looks like it's made your legs strong.
Your pantyhose hugs your thighs pretty nicely. You should be proud of all that muscle you've built up traveling.
...Is that you, Kumatora? Right---you said you had a waitress job. Are you working here now?
...Oh, it's you, Kumatora. You worked at "Club Titiboo" before, didn't you? Is this your new job?
...Why would you bother to keep up the facade with ~player~ if you're going as far as to dress up for ~player.ifMale(him|her)~?
...That's a cute costume. You seem to be wearing it for ~player~, but you're still acting like you don't care about ~player.ifMale(him|her)~.
...This is really just some game the two of you play, isn't it? You dress up and make fun of ~player.ifMale(him|her)~, but you both like it.
...I don't really understand, but all this dress-up and teasing with ~player~ must be---foreplay or something.
I heard there was a lot of Sun worship on Earth. You could say it's like natural terraforming.

Oh, you're dressed up like livestock.
...I'd rather Earth didn't start thinking about people that way.
You still seem pretty alert. I have an old sundress like yours, but I'd never wear it for combat.
...I guess I should be grateful for a goddess who dresses like ordinary people. Maybe their followers would be more reasonable.
"Classic" Arle...it's weird, but this is the best I've ever looked. I should take some pride in that...
...I used to do some Christmas performances. It was in a little Santa dress like that, smiling up on stage for everyone...
You don't need to come here with the excuse of performing for us. It's alright to just enjoy the summertime.
...Can't you use alchemy to make your body float somehow?
...I've seen bunny suits used as sex symbols, but I never understood the connection. Maybe it makes more sense on Earth.
It makes sense that people celebrate Christmas so much here. It's lasted until my time. Has it changed meaning over all the centuries you've lived?
...I was close to your size the last time I had a school uniform.
You look a lot more intimidating now than you did in your nightgown. You might have an easier time against challengers.
...Is this video game-related? It's hard to imagine you working.
There's no seasons on a fleet ship, so none of the bands I liked had a "summer" look. It's cute.
It's been a long time since I wore a school uniform. I tore it up, actually---to look more like a punk.
Is this your new look? After a while, it's actually harder to stay so messy. It was for me, at least.
Your powers aren't something to be ashamed of. Dressing to embrace it is a good look for you.
Everyone here must have to adapt to the seasons a lot more. But then, that's easier than adapting to space.
You're dressed a lot more like a Mejarian, Estelle. Did our fashion sense rub off on you?
People play in the oceans here for summer, don't they? You would need something to breathe with...
Hiking around your homeland, and dressing for the seasons...you must appreciate how beautiful this planet is. All the nature it has to offer...
...Santa Claus is a man on Earth, right? Is that why you're not dressed as---him? Our Christmas seems similar otherwise.
...You don't just train creatures to fight, but to bake with you? What aren't they used for?
...You look a bit like me when I was fourteen, trying to copy the punk bands I liked. A bit too clean to sell it.
All of Earth's biggest performers dress up for Christmas, too...it's shocking to think Tarak doesn't celebrate it.
If you take requests..."What a Wonderful World."
That swimsuit looks nice. I thought of being a soldier and a pirate as pretty similar, but I guess you get vacations.
I like you better like this than your clown makeup. Maybe you're not surprised to hear that.
...Do you perform as an idol, Kyou? You have the confidence for it.
...Do you actually eat a lot of tomatoes? I try not to overdo it.
...If you're off-duty, you should just introduce yourself normally.
...There's no reason to call yourself "Magma Grunt" if you're not in uniform.
You've made yourself look really pretty for this game. Maybe I should've tried that instead of just dressing as usual...
So you've been trained to take blood donations? Our crew all has to give some every so often in case people get hurt.
Working in an office would bore me to death. Even if I didn't end up a pilot, I probably would've been an Imperial soldier...
...You have a lot of outfits if you can afford to dress as a waitress just for fun.
I have to experience the ocean for myself. I'm sure it's nothing like a pool, or the bit of water on Mejare. You know, don't you?
Bunny suits have always annoyed me...they draw so much attention to your chest. I can't---fill it.
That's---not a bunny suit. It's reversed. I thought I'd seen everything with how skimpy girls can get...
...Did you get all these outfits as gifts from the men you've seduced?
...I thought vampires couldn't stand the Sun, but you're not all that covered. I didn't read those stories very much.
...You remind me of our trainee, blushing and stumbling over your words. It seems to get men's attention, but it also annoys them half the time.
...Even the non-humans enjoy Christmas. I should probably join our celebrations some more.
Rabbits must make good pets on Earth. You train one, and I've seen a lot more girls dress as them than back home.
If I understand, you're from another world---one where your Pokémon can't transform. A Vandread is sort of a "mega evolution"...
I've only ever swum in pools. With all this planet's water, you probably know what it's like in the ocean.
I'm not sure why you're embarrassed. You're in good shape, and that swimsuit is a nice fit.
It feels like changing with the seasons is a lost idea on Mejare. Here, even the ghosts keep up with it.
...What would you say is the most beautiful thing about the summer here? Something you've written about.
...Are you actually serving us chicken? I'd like some after the game. It's a good lean meat.
This must be your performance dress. It's a lot gaudier than the one I had, and a bunch of adults always helped me put it on.
...I don't see a lot of "coolness" in the way people look anymore. It'd have to come from what they do in action.
...Have you been seeing combat lately? Your look reminds me of our commander.
Swimming would be great exercise, but our ship doesn't have a pool. You've probably swum all through rivers and seas.

So this is your older style?
...Was it a personal choice, or is long hair more popular here?
...It's not encouraging to see Earthlings go wild when an idol starts acting violent.
...I know you're playing a character, but it reminds me of how spoiled I used to sound.
It seems like you're handling all your performances well. And they all seem distinct from each other...
You've really embraced all sorts of roles, haven't you?
I've never worn one of those suits, but adults used to talk about my "bunny-ears" bangs. They've stuck up like this ever since I was a girl.
Girls on our crew have lots of good memories with Christmas. Mostly their parents showering them with gifts. We try to recreate it each year...
I guess Earth gets cold enough that summer gives everyone an excuse to show off their bodies. That kind of thing never stops on Mejare.
...This might be your older look, but I assume penises are something that go as far back as people do.
You'd think the beach would be relaxing enough on its own, but I know people like that always want more service.
I already have trouble sleeping sometimes. I should ask if the spa has any spare eye masks.
I'm sure you're trying your best, but you're not the "Reaper" that our crew is worried about.
...It's hard to know what I'd think of myself from another dimension, or how I'd turn out in the first place. She might be a totally different person...
There's something impressive about being able to relax from such a stressful job. I'm not so good at it myself.
Being a superhero is the kind of job I wouldn't expect to have breaks---just like being a pirate. I hope your teammates are keeping watch.
I hope you're not going to exercise in that outfit. The best you could do is give us a nice view on your stretches.
...This isn't the first time you've changed parts of your own race, is it? Earth has a reputation for replacing organs.
...Is Starlight Celebration what Earthlings used to say? Even our captain remembers it as Christmas.
...Have you started working here? You're dressed for it. And you seem familiar with different universes making contact.
...Summer here is pretty enough that you should be able to enjoy yourself, even without anyone else.

state.text: You're dressed a bit like a Fama---someone who takes care of children. I think you'd fit that role well.

case.state: ...So you're threatening everyone now. It's hard not to keep relating to men when we're both targets.
...For people to play in the ocean here, it must still be pretty healthy. The air, as well...I wonder how long it all lasts.
Not only does Earth have seasons, but they're different in different places, right? Summer's probably not bad if your homeland is cold.
I actually have a hat just like yours...and one sundress. They're some of my only other clothes...
A donut in the summer heat. I don't suppose you'll crumble to pieces if you go for a swim.
Even if I still had any of my school uniforms, I'm not sure I'd get much nostalgia. Maybe if I'd played card games with friends...
I guess there was a card game club at your school? You probably look back on it fondly...
We have a reputation back home, but as a member of Magno's Family, we don't mean you any harm.
If you're worried about us, Magno's Family doesn't target civilians. We recruit them.
I'm a junior officer for our own crew. This is an away mission for us. For you, it seems more like leave.
Our crew's in a conflict of our own. Even this kind of counts. You don't seem too concerned about taking time off...
...What are your troops like? How much do you have to train them---or just keep them calm?
With my pilots, the most important thing is keeping them all focused. We have to attack as a team. Is that how you lead, too?
When it comes to combat...there's soldiers, and there's fighters. Maybe you know what I mean.
Some girls just follow their orders, and some would be out there even without any. Is that your experience?

The other Chief Pilot, Valore, has a complexion like you. Dark skin with red hair.
...But not the tail or the fangs.
The girl who shares my rank is a redhead with dark skin, like you. She says it used to be rare on Earth...she didn't mention having scales.
Most of the punk bands I liked growing up would never dress for any holidays. Halloween costumes would've been too kitschy.
I guess you're not so anti-establishment that you can't wear a silly Halloween outfit. Mejare's scene wouldn't stand for that.
Halloween seems more popular here than on Mejare. Do your poems take a lot of inspiration from it?
Ghosts and monsters must make for good poems. Maybe fear itself does. I get the sense Earth likes Halloween.
Sirens are a really female monster---luring you in with beauty. The men always make us aggressive, with claws and fangs...
Men from Tarak paint us like vicious monsters. If they knew women better, they'd draw us as sirens.
Can you really communicate with animals? That's a side of telepathy we've never seen...
Your bird...can you really hear its thoughts?
You don't seem like the type to agree to wear something you didn't want to.
I'm surprised you actually honored whatever bet made you dress like this.
They say the most dangerous girls look like everyone else.
Some people look like who they are, and some do their best to hide it. You have to rely on more than your eyes.
My mother told me that Earth was special because it changed seasons, and the water changed with them. Are you the "goddess" of whatever season we're in?
I heard you're the water goddess, but here you're the "winter goddess." So does it include ice and clouds? My mother talked about that sort of thing---water changing.
I know how you feel, always being in uniform. You're lucky to have civilian clothes to change into.
Winter clothes are one thing, but I hardly have street clothes. You seem to appreciate the break, at least.
I'm not sure how the whole "Santa" story is different on Earth. We don't talk about her helpers very much.
Back home, Santa mostly just appears and tosses gifts out to everyone. She has the elves, I guess...but it seems like a bigger focus here.
...When Christmas comes, I tend to think about the people who've died over the year.
The year's end is a time to reflect. People come and go in your life...sometimes for good.
Snow is a big image of Christmastime here, isn't it? Real snow.
All the snow and ice Earth must celebrate Christmas with is actually real. I hadn't thought about that.
...What is a "moose lion"? That's not one of the Earth animals I've ever heard about.
You look like you're dressed as a "reindeer," not a "moose lion," whatever that is. I admit I've never seen either.
Most girls our age don't seem as mature as you, even when they're stuck as pirates.
You're calm for a civilian schoolgirl. You've hardly raised your voice.
...Are you here trying to get out more, before your "life begins"?
I used to hear older girls dream about graduation...being "adults." Is this your chance to cut loose before that?
By the time I was dating-age, I was out of school. But it's supposed to happen a lot there...
A lot of girls have talked about dating classmates. Maybe if I'd stayed in school that long...
Don't take this the wrong way, but...you remind me of my mother.
...It's a little weird, watching you. It's just---you're a lot like my mother.
Whether it's her "father," or her lover, it seems like every girl on Earth has a man who's important to her.
It's hard to imagine how constant men are in girls' lives here. You probably don't even think about it.
Is pure white meant to make us think of pure love? I feel like relationships are never that simple.
No color to distract you from your feelings, I guess. It's a pretty naive way to look at love.
I should probably learn how to cook better---just for myself. I know for a fact men like it.
No one hates a partner who can cook. That goes double for men. I only know basic things myself...
...Can you tell us about Valentine's Day here? The way men have celebrated with you through the years.
...You're a bit older, so I hope you don't mind. Do men usually approach you on Valentine's Day?
...Under her priestess's robes, our captain always has a smile, too.
Our captain's religious, too. And it seems you both have a goofy side.
This "Pokémon" you're dressed as can start fires, right? I hope you've trained it away from any forests.
...How do you keep your "Scorch Bunny" from burning the environment?
A lot of Earth's celebrations seem to involve animals. They're just a given here...
Earth is so full of wildlife, you make it your whole culture, don't you?

state.text: ...Our bodies are pretty different, but you still know how to use your sex appeal. I've never been as comfortable with it...
I've always thought of my body as a weapon, or a weakness. I'm no bat, but...it's impressive how easily you can charm people.

case.state:
Is a hero the kind of role you love the most?
...I had a hard time being so "clean."
Idols are kind of like heroes of the stage. After a while, I started to chafe at the image. Maybe you appreciate it more.
I'll have to join you in the water later. Even our jacuzzi can't compare.
I agree with you---this game is a whole lot better just for where we're playing.
...Do they really call women "maneaters" here? That's our reputation back home---starting with the liver.
...On Tarak, they say we paralyze men and eat their organs. I thought "maneaters" was their invention.
...You're dressed for a date. A moonlit terrace, or some high-class restaurant. At this point, it's just...a fantasy.
An evening dinner date...it's hard to even imagine that kind of thing now.
This might sound strange, but...do you find yourself zipping that down much?
If you wear a tight piece for long enough, it starts to feel like part of your body.
...I'm sorry if this is sensitive, but are you blind? Your eyes are milky, but you're still reacting like you can see us.
...You've been making eye contact with us as if you can see, but you have the eyes of a blind girl. I hope it's fine to ask what's wrong.
Your instruments aren't just for music, right? They're weapons. Apparently your clothes are the same way.
I've heard your "band" is more like an army. Even your uniform has some kind of power sewn into it.

{pyoro}Pyoro~! Scans detect that Nonon's uniform was of alien origin! A hostile life form?{!reset}
..."Life Fibers." It must be literal.

{pyoro}Meia! That Goku uniform of hers had biological signals all over! Could it be the "Life Fibers"?{!reset}
So it's not just technology.
A full mesh like that looks really comfortable to fight in. It's too bad you need the extra pieces to make it actual clothing.
An all-over fishnet must be the perfect thing to wear to this game. I bet it's not bad for fighting, either. You'd just have to handle "being seen."
Our male doctor would be fascinated by someone who can harness energy to heal. They say technology is just controlled magic.
You call your "aether" healing magic, but every kind of technology starts that way. Our doctor---he'd be very curious about you.
...I don't know the goals of "Nudist Beach," but Magno's Family is not seeking any conflict. Maybe a strip game is your domain?
If "Nudist Beach" is worried about its turf, our crew is here for peaceful exchange.

{pyoro}Pyoro~! Scans detect the presence of a hostile alien life form in the environment!{!reset}
..."Life Fibers." Apparently they're Nonon's enemy.

{pyoro}Meia! I've found signals of xenogenic parasites! Could it be the "Life Fibers"?{!reset}
The enemy of "Nudist Beach."
I remember girls just older than me were starting to show school pride. It makes sense you'd do that for the seasons...
...I guess Earth gets cold, and you support your class like this? I was a bit too young for that kind of "school spirit."
Earth people are a lot more comfortable with their history to dress up as an era before their time.
I've heard of Earth's "Reniassance Era," but I think it was before even this one. So the people here know their past well enough to dress like it...
I have to imagine it's common to visit the beach on Earth, especially if you were already doing it in this time.
Earth has so many beaches, they're probably popular...and for a lot of its history, it seems.
You're pretty scrawny. Swimming might be a good serious thing to balance out the "amusement" in your life.
People say I could use a sense of humor. You could probably use some exercise. Why not try swimming?
They say girls are full of secrets. Earthlings even more so. It's like you could hide something even under a swimsuit.
I figure summer on Earth is a time to be more open about your bodies. But it's not safe to make any kind of assumption...
It's my understanding that the Fire Nation is your enemy. Are you on an infiltration mission?
If I'm not mistaken, you're posing as your enemy. Scouting, or sabotage...?
...Swimming is full-body exercise.
...Doing laps burns calories.
I'll let you relax for a while, but you can't just tease me with the idea of racing the Ultimate Swimmer.
...Here for a warmup? I'd like to see just how fast the Ultimate Swimmer can be.
Going to bed is a chance to wear loose clothes...
If you're wearing tight clothes all day, you might as well let your body breathe at night.
The gravity here is the same that we achieve on our ships. How does it feel to you?
...What do you think of Earth's gravity?
The girls I used to run with never trusted a hoodie. Too easy to hide a knife...or a scar.
Even thugs on Mejare like showing off, so we never trusted one in a hoodie. Anything could be under it---or anyone.
...Normally I wouldn't bother you about your condition, but how do you intend to strip?
...Some of the girls in my command have suffered arm amputations. I won't press the issue...but how will you strip?
...I don't suppose you can strip with your legs. That's my only concern with your condition...

...This was congenital? I'm sorry...pilots can suffer debilitating injuries.
...How will you remove your clothes?
...Your goal is to take men as food, I hear. Feed on their energy...
..."Succubi" are supposed to eat men. Aren't they? Suck out their essence...

...Pyoro, I want you to run diagnostics on this robot.
{pyoro}Roger! Is she a security threat?{!reset}
I can...sense feeling from her.

{pyoro}Pyoro~! This is the android you want scanned?{!reset}
I think I heard her mention conscious experience.
...Maybe I just felt it.
...Are you dressed as a monster from some Earth fable?
...Is this costume a creature you heard about growing up here?
If you've been worried about your hair, mine never behaves, either.
I think we've earned the right to see your hair. It can't be any messier than mine.
We have a game to complete, so get yourself under control. You can scare people later.
It's fine to dress up and scare people, but this game can't go on forever. Resist the urge.
Pyoro, do your databanks have any intel on "Red Mages"?<hr>{pyoro}A user of both white and black magic!{!reset}<hr>...Wouldn't that make gray?

Oh, Pyoro...
{pyoro}Cultural reference found! Red Mages are said to combine black and white magic.{!reset}
That sounds like a Gray Mage...
Y-you...t-this place's distortions are stronger in your spot...is that not a costume...?
W-what does---a fallen angel feel like? I thought you were dressing up, but there's an energy reacting to you...ungh.

Our intel is that you're a healer--wielding some power known as "Psynergy."
...Sometimes sleep alone is enough.
Sleep does a lot to heal us. I understand that your "Psynergy" does, as well...
I wonder if blindness helps you get to sleep---or has the opposite effect.
We control the ship's lights to help manage our sleep. I'm not sure how blindness affects your sense of time...
I hope you're spending Christmas with your family as much as your friends.

I'm sure your "Amusement Club" has something planned for Christmas.
...Don't forget about your family.
You're dressed very pretty, but...your mask. Is that for a custom here, or the weather?
Back home, we don't wear masks on Valentine's Day. Is it because Earth gets cold around this time?
Meia Gisborn, Chief Pilot of the Magno's Family outfit. I'm not familiar with the rank indicated by the "Knights of Favonius" uniforms.
Meia Gisborn, Chief Pilot. Magno's Family. Are you dressed to match your rank in the "Knights of Favonius"?
It's rare for us to meet someone with such a normal job. I'm not sure I ever could've put up with that kind of life...
From soldiers and refugees to...office workers. Even if not for our crew, I feel like I'd have always belonged in the former group.
Is this costume of a "Pokémon" that's special to you? One you perform with?
You're a performer, aren't you? Is that costume special-made? Or maybe the "Pokémon" is special...
To die as a schoolgirl...at least you died pretty. Now and forever...
...I guess some girls would die to stay young and cute forever.
I probably would've been better off with marijuana...and so would the girls I beat.

No one ever started a fight high.
...That's why I always went for liquor.
...You fit a bunnysuit more than most girls. You keep hopping around.
...You're about as excitable as a rabbit.
If this costume is a disguise of yours...just why have you infiltrated this place?
We've shared our mission with you. I'm curious why yours needs you to wear a bunnysuit.
If the humans of your time have all vanished...is the same true of rabbits?
...Are the rabbits on Earth all "Carbons," too?

Bunnies are supposed to breed quickly.
...You don't have any children, do you?

When they showed us bunnies back home, they talked about their breeding.
...Are you a mother yourself?
...What makes you extra demonic? Your horns and tail ought to be enough...
...We can believe you're a demon. You've got a tail and horns. You're saying you're more demonic than usual?
You're part of a "forest people"...and you've led them out in combat? In a regional war...
Is it right to say you're the "Kokiri's" leader? And that even your forest is involved in conflict...
...Do you have a problem with snoring, Miss Yuzuki? Your mask...

It's nice to meet you, Miss Yuzuki.
...Do you have trouble breathing at night?
...What are summers like in your woods?
I'd say you're dressed for the beach, but I haven't experienced summers in a forest...
...It's silly to wear a shirt with the same face you're already making.
...I don't know why you need your shirt to be as excited as you are.
...Pyoro, what's your analysis of that robot?<hr>{pyoro}Some sort of combined entertainer-security unit... with special aquatic protocol!
{pyoro}Warning! I detect the capacity for violence in that "Chica" unit!{!reset}<hr>It seems more concerned with pool parties...
...It's nice to play this game with someone a little older. And it's nice that hasn't made you shy away from summer.
It's good for our mission to not play with just a bunch of girls. Even more so when that woman is still proud of her body...
We've heard that bugs were a big problem in Earth's summers...
...In school, we learned that Earth had hot summers, and people had to combat insects...

state.text:
...Other girls talk about playing computer games sometimes, but I never had any interest.
...They're supposed to make you gain weight.
I'm sorry, but I can't really relate to playing computer games growing up. I'd hate to stay inside...and risk putting on weight.

case.state: Water's how a lot of Magno's Family likes to relax. Are your "Knights of Favonius" here for the same reason?
We're representing Magno's Family. If the "Knights of Favonius" love the water, too, then our crews have something in common.
Our trainee likes those kinds of designs you have on...ones modeled after cute characters.
If that's some mascot design on your clothes, our trainee likes that kind of thing, too...
If you're able to relax like this, you must have some control over your arm...
I hope we can all enjoy the summer together here. It seems like your mutation's under control.

state.text: This "Doctor Eggman" you're fighting...he uses robotic drones as soldiers, right? Powered by...animal-people.
The Harvester fleets we've been fighting use unmanned machines. Your "Doctor Eggman" uses the same technology, right? Or at least...unmanned by humans.

case.state: The spiritual seems to have made you lose sense of the physical...
As an occultist...maybe your spirit's strong, but your body is lacking.
...I'm sorry if this is sensitive, but are you blind? Your eyes are milky, but you're still reacting like you can see us.
...You've been making eye contact with us as if you can see, but you have the eyes of a blind girl. I hope it's fine to ask what's wrong.
...Ghosts stay in one place, don't they? A home, even a bedroom they're tied to...
If ghosts really haunt places...then they don't move around much, do they?
