...I was told an alien life form would be joining us, but you look no different from a human woman.
...Over time, Mejare and Tarak have seen the opposite sex as alien life. Is that the case with "Saiyans"? You look perfectly human.
...I was expecting this "Saiyan" to look more like the alien life they claim you to be. We've never discovered aliens ourselves.
...Are you really an alien? If you differ from a human woman at all...well, this would be the game to inspect your anatomy.
Sorry to be insulting, but you look rather unevenly-proportioned. You should exercise more.
What's with that look you're giving everyone? This is just a game.
I'm trying not to comment on your body...Mejarians tend to be judgmental enough.
Something about you seems off. I'd suggest you relax.
A test subject...that's how Earth sees its colonies.
I see you've got my affinity for words.
Portals sound useful...even faster-than-light still takes a while.
Girls shouldn't be afraid to speak their minds.
Hearing you loud and clear.
...Other girls talk about playing computer games sometimes, but I never had any interest.
...I'm sorry, but I can't really relate to playing computer games growing up. I was always outside.
...What am I looking at? Are you human? You look like...some sort of robot.
You beep whenever you move. Are you some sort of robot? More advanced than what we have...
Er...what are you, exactly? Is that a mechanical suit, or...are you a machine?
Are you...a machine? Our most advanced robot is Pyoro, since he can talk...you're on another level.
What a diminutive girl...it's almost as if you're deliberately trying to act vulnerable. Our young nurse is a better specimen.
You're old enough to be here, right? I wouldn't play this with our young nurse, and she might be bigger than you.
We have an eleven-year-old nurse on the Nirvana who dwarfs you in both size and personality. Some woman you are...
..."Chihiro"? That's it. You're about the size of our child nurse, and even she's more assertive.
You look like you're in great shape. I respect that in a girl...very much.
Not to be too forward, but...your legs are so muscular. What's your training routine?
Wow...whatever you do to exercise, I'd like to learn it. You look fantastic.
You're a lot of woman, and in a good way. Could I get your frame with enough training?
Your build is impressive...and I wouldn't say to that to any strange woman.
You said you were a "Street Fighter," right? I guess that would get you into shape.
You said something about street fighting? I've been in street fights. I'd rather not go back to that, but if you like it...
You said you're a street fighter? That's a harsh life...I lived on the streets when I was younger.
Street fighting isn't the kind of thing I'd glorify, but if it makes you happy...just take care of yourself.
You're a "witcher"? A Mejarian judge called Jura a witch...for possession of an anatomy book.
You're a "witcher"? Mejarians who associate with men get called witches...
The word "witch" gets us a little touchy sometimes...I apologize.
Wh-what's the meaning of this? Why are you lugging an axe around? Disarm yourself!
...Stay away from me. No girl carrying an axe is of sound mind.
Are we supposed to ignore the bloody axe beside you? I'm armed, even if I don't look like it.
I knew Earth girls were capable of being ruthless killers, but I expected something more subtle than carrying an axe around.
I heard that suitcase you were carrying is some kind of mechanical firearm. Women shouldn't use those in the first place.
Wasn't that briefcase some kind of weapon? You're a fool to make it that obvious...mechanical guns aren't for women anyway.
It serves you right to have to turn over that suitcase-weapon I saw. A woman's firearm is inconspicuous.
If you were smart, you'd have a smaller, concealed weapon than that suitcase they took. Kinetic firearms are for men.
You're a..."princess"?
What's a princess? Some kind of leadership position?
A princess...is that like the Grand Ma?
You're royalty? I don't like it when people assume they're better than others.
I hear there's a male version of you. I'd hate to see the male version of me.
Mejare calls women witches for sympathizing with men. Personal technology is quite standard there...so I don't see why you're called one.
I was told you're capable of magic, but you seem much more comfortable with technology. Maybe that's your culture's name for it...
For a supposed "witch," you hardly seem different than a wealthy Mejarian woman, with all that personal technology.
I should've expected I'd become the subject of some wealthy woman's sexual research. Your technology hardly seems "magical," though...
Mejare has hovering chairs, personal tablets, and emotion cubes, plus robots. I fail to see how technology makes you a "witch."
It's good to see someone who shares my fashion sense...
These bodysuits can get uncomfortable, wouldn't you agree?
You pilot a mech? So does Hibiki...and he's learning.
So, what's planet Korea like? I've never heard of it.
You're a pilot, too? Mechs, Dreads, they're all fascinating.
You're a..."princess"? You look like you're about to cast off that dress and go running.
What's a princess? Some kind of leadership position? You seem more like a dressed-up athlete.
A princess...is that like the Grand Ma? She's certainly not as athletic as you look.
You're royalty? I don't like it when people assume they're better than others...though you might have an athletic edge on me.
So, you solve mysteries...with some men? Men don't seem smart enough for that.
So, you solve mysteries? The Paksis is one big glowing mystery.
I'm told you get captured a lot. Allies are important to have...but a girl should be strong on her own.
You look like you've got my temperament. Did someone elbow you into doing this, too?
You go to school with men? They don't seem able to focus for long enough...and you don't seem happy to be here.
You're a student...I'm a dropout. Let's leave it at that...since you seem annoyed regardless.
You're barely bigger than Paiway. Children aren't allowed here...and you seem miserable about it, anyway.
"Dark Magician Girl"? That's some sort of title, right?
Don't you have some sort of first name? "Dark Magician Girl" is too long to say in the heat of battle.
Dark Magician Girl? Children aren't allowed here.
..."Default-chan." I do everything I can to gain the crew's recognition, and this girl's entire existence is the bare minimum.
Just what does "desu" mean, anyway? It must be from some archaic Earth language...the same way this girl is archaic.
You may be the walking antithesis of a Mejarian. A girl who's made no effort to look beautiful, and is completely subservient to men.
...~player~, why are you wasting my time with this girl? I don't know what desu means.
...I always have my subordinates make eye contact when I speak to them. If it were you, I might let it pass.
...Are you alright, Muffins? You seem to have your mind elsewhere...as well as one eye.
...Muffins, you should look girls in the eye when they speak to you. I shouldn't have to tell you th---oh. Excuse me.
Your name is "Muffins," right? I heard a worker here refer to you as "Derpy." ...Was he insulting your lazy eye?
You're a pirate? They certainly dress much differently on Earth...
I'm a pirate, too...small universe we live in.
An Earth pirate? Well...the outfit is certainly different, and apparently the manner.
You're a..."princess"? For nobility, you don't seem too informed...
What's a princess? Some kind of leadership position? Then why are you here?
A princess...is that like the Grand Ma? She'd never lower herself to games like this...
You're royalty? I don't like it when people assume they're better than others...though I guess you're lowering yourself by playing this.
Even for an Earth girl, that looks like pretty old-fashioned dress. Your manners are similarly classical...
I could have sworn I saw you at another table than this one...I guess I was just mistaken.
How'd you lose that bit of your finger? You seem rather demure to be in combat...
You don't seem very assertive. I wouldn't think this game would attract a shy girl like you...
It's good to see a young girl so dedicated to fitness. That would already make you a good pilot---and g-forces can't rush blood to your legs.
You're Emi, right? I enjoy running myself...and I always look for fitness in new recruits. Most girls would use disability as an excuse.
...You'd make a good trainee on my squadron. Having a passion for fitness sets a good example, especially in the face of disability.
...Have you considered being a pilot, Emi? Not only do you keep fit, but you don't have the issue of blood rushing to your legs in combat.
...I'm not impressed with this introduction to "elves." You should take better care of yourself.
...I assume "pudgy" is not the natural build of elven girls. How did you let yourself get in such a sorry condition?
...You must understand that Mejarian culture values slenderness. Maybe elves are different...or you're just undisciplined.
What a grotesque figure. Excess fat everywhere...are all elves like this, Erufuda?
Is it true you're part of a magic-using family? I don't subscribe to notions of royalty, but I can see why they'd hold power.
A noble...Mejare has imperial leaders, but I'm not in their favor anymore. And you can use magic?
Pirates aren't the type to recognize nobility. Still, I'm curious about the "magic" I've heard your family can use.
I hear you descend from a line of women with magical powers. It wouldn't surprise me that nobles hogged that for themselves---nor Earthlings.
This "magic" of yours sounds pretty interesting. Can it be taught?
I'm told you're immortal. Is that in the sense of never aging, or never dying at all?
If you really can wield magic, I'd be honored to learn it...it sounds useful.
The Paksis has proven to me that powers beyond human ability exist...so I'm willing to believe you might have some.
I was told you were a spacefarer, as well...and a pilot. It's good to see a woman who understands my situation.
Is it true you're a space pilot? So am I...I'd love to discuss formations or maneuvers after the game is over.
Someone said you're a pilot. I never expected to meet a woman like that here...what's your ship like?
I heard you're a space pilot. I command a Dread squadron myself...what is it that you do?
Someone told me you're a space pilot. I've really fallen in love with piloting myself, though I only have a few years' experience...
I'm told you were cryogenically frozen for some time...that's also true of Misty, a young girl I know from Pluto.
Is it true you were in cryosleep for a number of years? So was a man I know...he looks younger than me, but he's over a hundred years old.
Someone mentioned you were in cryosleep for some time. It sounds uncomfortable...maybe you don't want to talk about it.
You were cryogenically frozen, right? Several of my crewmates were, as well...technically making them older than any of us.
...You're aware you need clothing to play this game, right?
Did you just come here from a finished game? You've got almost nothing on...
And they say Mejarians dress revealingly. You barely dress at all.
If you meant to come dressed in a cat costume, it seems to be missing a few pieces.
Not to be rude, but I still can't comprehend this. Are you shaving...the rest of it?
...Is the bottom fur next? Did you really come here naked?
To meet a cat-woman hybrid here, and that she's not even wearing anything...I assume what's around your groin is fur, too.
You've only lost once before, but I think I know what's coming next. If it, too, is fur...
You certainly paint of different picture of Earthlings than the one I'm used to...
You seem awfully shy to be playing a game like this. Or is that your motivation for doing so?
How'd a shy girl like you end up in this place? Do you even know how to play poker?
You said you rode in on a "pegasus"? Mejare has few animals, but I've never even heard of that one.
You'll have to acquaint me with what exactly a lawyer does...otherwise your boasts mean little.
You seem very proud of your family name, Franziska...but I'm afraid I'm not familiar with your profession.
Our commander, B.C., uses a whip...is that related to this "attorney" business you keep boasting about?
Is there a reason you seem to hold yourself above the rest of us? Granted, I've never met an "attorney."
You remind me of Parfet, though you seem a little more outgoing...but just as unkempt.
You remind me of Parfet. She wears glasses, too...and she sometimes neglects hygiene.
You're like if Parfet and Paiway had a child together...and didn't teach her how to clean herself.
You've got Paiway's build..and Parfet's glasses. Are you old enough to be here? You should have cleaned yourself, regardless.
You look a little unkempt. Girls need to take pride in their bodies as well as their minds...Parfet gets like that, too.
So, tell me about these "Phantom Thieves." What is it you do?
These "Phantom Thieves" of yours sound like pirates. What do you steal, exactly?
Parfet is into computers. You said you were, too, right? Something about "Phantom Thieves"?
You're from planet "San Fransokyo"? Just rolls right off the tongue...I'm sure Parfet would like working with you, if you do engineering.
You do something in engineering, right? You and Parfet would hit it off...once she learns to pronounce "San Fransokyo."
Good to see someone who shares my fashion sense...sort of.
These bodysuits can get uncomfortable...although you seem quite comfortable in yours.
Hard to take someone seriously when they won't show their face...at least the rest seems comfortable for you.
I always appreciate being able to look a girl in the eye. The rest of our styles match, at least.
Mejare doesn't have many animals...and I wish it didn't have spiders.
...I'm sure you're well aware of your condition. There's been burns among our crew, and we haven't shunned them.
...You don't seem comfortable with your burns. Some of my pilots have suffered similar injuries...
...Some of my pilots have been burned...I won't press how you got yours.
...I'm sorry about your burns. There's no need to address them further...but know I've seen similar injuries on crewmates.
You look like Paiway's first attempt at makeup.
So much makeup...I don't wear any. Just gets in the way.
So much makeup...Jura is always trying to convince me to try some.
Good, you're wearing enough makeup for both of us. Saves me the trouble.
A schoolgirl? You're dressed conservatively...either that means you're modest, or you've got something to hide.
For a young student playing strip poker, you're surprisingly bundled-up in that sweater. Heavy dress always makes me think girls are hiding something...
Haru, right? Nice to meet you...you seem kind enough. Of course, that heavy outfit might hide another side of you...
You seem rather mature for a schoolgirl...but anyone who plays strip poker is probably hiding something, as your dress implies.
"Magic," huh...I'd have my doubts, but the Paksis feels like magic sometimes.
Do you really use magic, or just sufficiently advanced technology?
So, you're a witch. We got called witches on Mejare, but that was for suggesting men were human.
So...you went to school with men? Surprised they can sit still long enough...but magic sounds like a good motivator.
A boarding school? Everyone is educated by the state on Mejare...but not about magic.
A boarding school? I dropped out of school...though Mejare's didn't teach magic.
Is that headband some sort of designation? Not to be rude.
So, you're a "ninja"? Sounds like the telepathic people Hibiki was stuck with.
You're awfully quiet. Not that I take issue with that...
So these "ninjas" have their own society? What separates you from a typical human?
"HK416"...a codename to match your stoicism. I was told you're some sort of expert on men's kinetic weapons.
It seems girls of my temperament aren't unique to Mejare. Though you're a men's weapons expert rather than a pilot...
It's good to meet another serious girl...but I don't share your interest in men's mechanical guns.
Mejare has long dismissed men's kinetic weaponry in favor of laser rings. Serious women should seek command roles.
A stoic, serious girl like you...you're better suited for piloting or command than a fascination with men's guns.
You look like a military type, based on those weapons. Guess you can't trust a soldier to leave them behind, even here.
You've got a sweet expression for all those weapons you're carrying. It's unsettling.
Is there a reason you brought weapons here? What kind of place is this?
You're a military woman? You've got the uncomfortably sweet expression of one, for sure.
...Are you intentionally stumbling over your words? I have a hard time believing anyone is this stupid.
...I have a crewmate, Dita, who's something of a ditz. I know what a believable ditz looks like, Ini...
...This performance you're putting on is a bit much. And girls who feign stupidity are hiding something.
...I don't think anyone here will judge you for playing this, Ini. There's no need to act ignorant.
I'm told you're into art. Duero seems that way, too, even if he only shows it to Parfet.
You're a student...I'm a dropout. Take that how you will.
You go to school with men? Besides Duero, I can't picture a man sitting still.
You're into art, you said? Artists are good to have around...they tend not to kill people.
So...those ears are real? I wasn't aware Earth had...subspecies of woman.
Let me get this straight. You're a "Therian"...and that makes you some kind of rabbit hybrid. No such thing on Mejare...
Those aren't seriously...real? Your ears, I mean. Mejare doesn't have rabbit-girls...
Those ears are something else. Rabbits are rare on Mejare...and rabbit-girls don't exist.
What a nurturing girl...you remind me of my crewmate Ezra, who squints the same way. She just had a baby.
So cheerful...good Fama material. I have a crewmate who just had a baby, and she's got the same squinting, caring eyes.
You seem like a sweet girl. You have the same squint and cheeriness of Ezra, a crewmate of mine who recently had a baby.
Caring, considerate, and constantly squinting...it's like Ezra's here with me. She's a crewmate of mine who just had a child...
What a flirtatious woman...and on the older side. I don't suppose you have experience with men?
...I should be able to learn a lot about men's sexuality from you. Be it from your age or your flirtatiousness...
An older woman on this planet must have dated men before. I might have some questions about them for you...
I expected to see girls my age here, but I guess older women makes more sense. You'll make a better resource on men, anyway.
So, you're...a "clown"? You shouldn't put yourself down like that...unless it's some kind of profession?
What exactly does a "clown" do for a living? Are you some kind of public entertainer?
So, clowns...entertain people? All the entertainment on Mejare tends to focus on the evils of men.
I heard you were a "clown," which sounds a little degrading. You don't seem too broken up about it, though.
..."Vest trick"? That doesn't sound like it's going to make me laugh.
...If your jokes couldn't make me laugh, Joey, I'm not sure a "vest trick" will.
...Is your "vest trick" still an effort to make me laugh, or are you just trying to entertain now?
It might be best if you tried to make others laugh instead, Joey. ...In fact, it might be vest.
...Is your next act to slip on the peel? Even I've seen that.
...So you're done trying to make me laugh. Unless you're about to slip on the discarded peel.
...Good. As a warning, slipping on the peel won't make me laugh, either.
I feel like an immovable object next to a woman whose whole existence is humor. ...You're not about to slip on the peel, are you?
Let's see how this goes...it's the magician's turn again.
...I'm watching this latest act, Joey. Let's see what you can do.
...Well, Joey? Don't keep the audience waiting.
Let's see your ultimate act, Joey. Unless there's something bigger planned for when you lose again.
I'm told you spent some time in prison. So have I...so you have my sympathy.
I've been in prison, too...not just for piracy, but also starting fights on the street.
Another former prisoner? Well...any girl with a distaste for authority can't be all bad.
You certainly have the eyes of a girl who's been jailed. I was a street thug once, so far be it from me to judge you.
What's that mute mechanical...helper behind you? Some sort of personal robot assistant?
...Is Stone Free the name of that robot assistant behind you? It's a lot bigger than Pyoro...
The Nirvana has its own robot assistant named Pyoro. How exactly do you keep summoning yours?
For an ex-convict, it must have been difficult to acquire that personal robot assistant of yours, Jolyne...I'm impressed.
...Is it true you're a "mutant"? Forgive my ignorance, but you look quite human to me.
For a supposed mutant, you look very human. Maybe it's an Earth custom I'm missing...
I was told you're a mutant. Considering your very human appearance, I think that warrants an explanation.
Would you mind explaining what they meant when they said you're a "mutant"? Is that just a term for some subset of Earthlings?
Bad start. But you have plenty to lose, I'm sure.
Something tells me you came to this game prepared.
What's first on what I'm sure is a long list?
You're certainly not one to go right for large items...so I'm not expecting much.
It begins. Expect a long journey to nudity, everyone.
Going to remove some clothes this time?
Why you bothered with your rapier is beyond me. You want to be naked.
I'm actually a little curious how much clothing you've prepared for this...
Fashion is definitely your first love. I'm curious how you plan to pace this out...
Get it together, Jura. Unless you're just losing on purpose...
At least try to win. Don't paint a picture of us as ditzy exhibitionists.
Where's your focus? I make you play poker with me and Gascogne so you'll sharpen your tactical skills...
Come on, Jura. Don't roll over and die. You're smarter than this.
I know you like showing off your body, but at least make them earn it.
I expected better from you...this is getting sad.
I'm glad you put a little more effort into piloting than into this...not that I'm satisfied with your piloting.
This is pathetic...cards or piloting, I taught you better than this.
Please tell me you're losing on purpose. I'd like to maintain some respect for your intelligence, if not your modesty.
The moment you've been waiting for. Well, give our friends a good show.
I've given up all hope regarding your skill. Just get to stripping.
First you drag me here, then you make sure to disappoint me...
...Just get it over with.
Honestly. You're just being coy to save face.
Don't give me that. You're broken up about losing---you just pretend not to care.
Good attitude. Just stop trying so you can claim losing doesn't bother you.
If this game is all luck, shouldn't we be a little more even? Or are you just trying to save face?
There's nothing subtle about this girl...from her threats to her outfit.
What an indecent girl...and worse, outright menacing.
At least you're not wearing enough to drag out your idle threats.
Is this how Earth girls begin games? Threatening everyone at the table?
Such a barbarous girl...like Mejarian soldiers. I guess it isn't men's influence...
This never ends. I can only assume this is what getting too close to men does to a girl.
So much dirty talk...do men just turn you into sex fiends? Should I stay away from them?
I wanted to believe Earth girls could be well-adjusted growing up around men, but you're confirming all my stereotypes.
Sex-crazed, violent, and completely unsubtle. You're the image of what they said trying to live with men would do to us.
An older woman? You might be able to tell me about Earth family life...I've routinely been told I look old myself.
Most of the girls in here look a lot younger than you...if it makes you feel better, girls think I'm older than I am.
It's surprising to see a middle-aged woman here. I just turned 20...though rookie pilots usually place me a few years older than that.
This isn't the kind of game I pictured an older woman playing. Then again, I get judged as older than I am...must be my temperament.
You dress just like Dita, with that exposed midriff.
You save the world? ...Alright then.
You save the world? Earth doesn't need saving, as far as I'm concerned.
What was that transformation you did earlier? That was impressive...you had a full suit on!
Didn't you come here with a pink suit on? How'd you take it off so quickly? All I saw was light...
Did you...transform earlier? What was that all about? I'm curious...
Weren't you wearing a suit like mine just before? ...Besides the pink. How did you transform out of it?
Who are you? You're speaking as if none of us can hear you---and to someone we can't see.
...Who are you always addressing, Kizuna? Clearly it's none of us, what with your commentary.
...Kizuna, was it? You seem to be talking to someone...just no one at this table. And with plenty of comments about us.
Vaguely luminescent...and speaking to someone we can't see. You're not giving me many reasons to trust you, Kizuna.
Someone said you're with a woman...who's the Oma going to be?
Someone said you're with a woman...have the two of you gotten pregnant yet?
You're dating a girl, right? I guess Mejare's cultural practices originated somewhere on Earth.
I heard you have a female partner. I'm glad to see Mejare's culture represented here---though I guess Earth girls invented it.
Someone said you're with a woman...Rebekah and Ezra recently had their baby.
Is it true you have a female partner? I didn't know Earth girls did that, as well, but Mejare had to get it from somewhere.
Someone said you're with a woman...Jura and Barnette sure get along.
Someone said you're with a woman...I guess Mejare got its inspiration from some Earth girls.
Someone said you're with a woman...I should see if Valore is taken.
You're a..."vampire"? You look human to me.
Do these "vampires" really suck blood? Right out of the Harvest's playbook...
So, vampires suck blood. Earth probably has a blood colony out there somewhere...poor souls.
So, you're a detective? Mejare has detectives...but they mostly investigate enemies of the state.
So, you're a detective? Anyone who focuses on discovering secrets is probably hiding a few themselves.
This academy of yours sounds like a school. Are men any good in school?
This academy of yours sounds like a school. More nuanced than Mejare's, I hope.
You seem about as expressive as I ever get.
You look like Paiway dressed up as a fairy. Are you old enough to be here?
I think I read about fairies as a girl. They protected Mejarian children from marauding packs of men.
A fairy? Earth never fails to surprise me with its species variety.
...Are you really a fairy? I'd need to see something spectacular for you to match the stories I've heard.
Are you and ~player~...in some sort of relationship, Kyu? If I had a partner, I wouldn't be playing strip poker.
Kyu, you're always addressing ~player~. Are you two...close? In some strange romantic way?
I assume ~player~ is your partner, Kyu? Public strip poker is a strange means of expressing love...but then, I don't know Earth culture.
You and ~player~ already seem to know each other, Kyu. I can't say you dress similarly...but I assume you're partners.
You raid tombs? All of Earth is ancient history to Mejare, not just dead queens.
Well, you certainly look fit, which is good to see in a girl.
Tombs, you said? Not for me...too cramped.
I had heard rumors about Earth's aversion to sexuality. A holy Mejarian would not mind exposing herself...or other girls.
...It's strange how a "holy woman" would take issue with sexuality, as you seem to. On Mejare, the female form is worshipped...
Earth's idea of "holiness" seems much more conservative than Mejare's. A woman's naked body is one of our most sacred images.
A religious leader from Earth...I'm not sure what you worship here. We find nothing unholy about girls' bodies, but you seem to.
What are you waving that thing around for? Guns aren't children's playthings!
Put the gun down, would you? What are you so afraid of?
...An acerbic woman waving a racketous mechanical gun around. Just how I pictured Earth girls.
I can understand wanting to be armed in a seedy place like this, but you're taking this too far. And don't wave it around!
I must say, Launch, this blue-haired version of you is much more...tolerable.
You're certainly more pleasant like this. I'll try to make sure you don't sneeze again.
That blonde version of you was crass and rude. You're much more polite...though it's to the point of being demure.
I can't say I support girls being total pushovers, but I'll take this polite version of you over the crude blonde one.
Do you have someone to support you? This switching can't be good for your mental health...or physical.
Your blonde version seems liable to get you killed. Do you have friends? Colleagues? Are you alright?
I'd hate to see you wander around with your...condition. Are you sure you're safe, always switching as you do?
Earth girls are full of surprises...do you want to live on the Nirvana, just to have some support?
Bless you---oh, no. Don't tell me...
Not this again. The blonde version?
God bless you---oh, damn it. She's changed back...
Bless---damn it, that was Launch. Here we go again...
Mejare could do with more vegetation... we've had to terraform for every inch of it. This girl has the luxury of dressing in it...
...Is there a certain culture of nature on Earth? To wear foliage as clothing like that...Mejare struggles to grow crops.
...That's a very natural outfit. A far cry from Mejare's synthetic suits...maybe Earth has more greenery than we do.
..."Leafy." Very direct...is there a faction of Earth dedicated to preserving its plant life? Mejare could use that...
Interesting gun, but I'm not sure why you felt the need to bring it.
I wasn't going to say anything...but that one eye is rather distracting.
I guess girls come in all shapes and eye counts on Earth...or are you not from Earth?
No depth perception? You'd make a poor pilot.
...What kind of freak genetic hybrids are they developing on this planet? Are you an animal or a woman?
...So the extent of Earth's genetic and organ experimentation reaches animal-woman hybrids. Your name is..."Leggy"?
You're...not an animal, nor a woman. Is this the result of Earthlings experimenting on our harvested organs?
I...thought we knew what Earth's agenda was in harvesting its colonies' organs, but...producing lamb-girls was not among that.
You're some kind of hunter, right? I guess a pirate isn't far off from that.
So, what's this planet Pandora like? More verdant than Mejare, I hope.
Planet Pandora, was it? I think I knew a girl named Pandora once...
It's my understanding you're a witch. How well can you control this magic of yours? You don't seem comfortable at all.
Lotte, was it? If you're really a witch, I hope you're using that intelligently...you look uneasy already.
If you're really a witch, that sounds awfully destructive. Are you sure you can control yourself? You look nervous.
You look more like a nervous schoolgirl than anyone capable of controlling "magic." Some confidence would be reassuring.
That's an elegant dress...your outfit is like Ezra's, a bridge operator on our ship.
You dress like Ezra...you kind of look like her, too.
You look pretty good with that sword. Maybe you could give Jura some private lessons...or another dress, at least.
Barnette's got green hair, too...but that's with the help of Mejarian genetic engineering.
Green hair isn't that strange on Mejare. One of my pilots has it. What about Earth?
Is your hair naturally green? That'd be impressive for an Earth girl...
You said you come from the plains? Sounds nice...Mejare's not very verdant, and Tarak's even worse.
You come from the plains, you said? My parents took me to the plains when I was a little girl...it was fun to run around.
The plains, you said you lived in? Somehow I doubt the Earth I know has any green left...
You don't have the figure I'd expect of a girl playing strip poker. Shorter girls respond better to exercise, you know.
You need to take better care of yourself. A girl your age should not be chubby---especially when it's easier at your height.
I'm told you dropped out of school. So did I---all the more reason you should keep yourself fit. Girls will try to take advantage of you.
It'd be rare to see such a chubby girl on my homeworld. We value a slender figure---exercise is good for health and beauty.
Is that a camera? Paiway, our child nurse, is always skulking around with hers...so this is nothing new.
A camera? Are you really going to photograph us all? ...Whatever.
Are you trying to blackmail us with that camera? I've been in the media for far worse than this.
I hope you don't think you're going to embarrass me with that camera. I'm not exactly from here, anyway.
This is a card game. Why'd you come armed with...whatever that thing is?
You look pretty good with that sword. Maybe you could give Jura some instruction.
Fascinating. That sword looks like it's made from the lasers our rings use.
You...what are you? Where are your eyes? Can you even see the cards?
Are you some kind of apparition? Smacks of the Paksis's work.
I wasn't going to comment on the floating, but...you're floating. What are you, exactly?
...I hope you don't think the floating and lack of eyes is normal to us. Or maybe it is on Earth...
Funnily enough, I'm here to learn about supposedly "normal" people, too. Mejare is quite the outlier for not having men.
Other than your fangs, you seem like a normal girl to me. I'm investigating Earth girls' behavior myself...
...If you're here to inspect human behavior, Mavis, I may not be the best candidate. Apparently the women of Mejare are unusual.
It seems we have similar goals, Mavis. Mejarians aren't normal, either, apparently...so I'm here to learn what is.
Someone said you gave up on school. So did I...
You look like you get a lot of exercise. That's always good to see in a girl.
You said something about a killer? Earth's no stranger to killing, as far as I'm concerned.
One look at your outfit tells me we'll be here a while.
Our names are pretty close, Mei. Whose do you think is better?
You work in climate science? Tarak could use a woman like you...if women didn't terrify them.
You work in climate science? Maybe you could convince Mejare to allocate its resources better.
So, what's planet China like? Never heard of it.
You...freeze people? Misty was in cryogenic sleep, but...your way sounds dangerous.
You've got to slim down. A woman has to stay fit.
Congratulations, ~player~. These used to be my rarest lines, but there are more obscure situations now than having a clone of me.
More than one Meia? You must really like me, ~player~.
More than one of me? Honestly, ~player~, that's a little flattering.
I see Earth has also perfected cloning technology.
I'm glad you appreciate me enough to play with more than one of me.
More than one Meia? That's...a little cute, ~player~.
More than one of me? Considering my responsibilities, that would really help.
Would you look at that, ~player~'s figured out the offline version. And apparently is very fond of me.
More than one Meia? How flattering. Be sure to try out Jura, too.
I never thought I'd say these lines. I'm glad you like me so much, ~player~. That's sweet.
Two Meias? Give Jura some attention, too, ~player~. ...But thank you.
Hmhmhmhm. I never thought someone would like me this much, ~player~...
...At the moment, our crew's only doctor is a man. Your presence aboard would surely put a lot of girls at ease...
A lot of our crew members still have a hard time letting a man inspect them. We could use any female doctor, especially a good one...
What exactly is the meaning of this muggle word you keep using? In reference to us, usually...
Based on your tone, I assume muggle is some kind of insult. The least you could do is explain what it means.
Whatever "muggle" is supposed to insult, Merula, I think it's lost on us without an explanation.
"Muggle"...you keep using that word. I'm not from Earth, so maybe you could explain its meaning.
...What's a lawyer?
You work in law? Mejare has one law...obey the Grand Ma.
There are no law practitioners on Mejare. Only the state judges, and how badly they punish you for associating with men.
One look at your outfit tells me we won't be here long.
Are you counting each bandage as one layer? If not, this'll be over soon.
...I really wasn't counting on seeing nudity this quickly. At least it's a woman.
...Did I just walk in on a game that's nearly over?
We've encountered another Earth child with esper-like powers, but he didn't demonstrate control over electricity. How many of you are there?
...So Earth has more esper children than the one we saw. Is this your ultimate goal? To create an army of superhumans?
...Another Earth child with ESP...or so you claim. I see your goal is to become a race of superhumans and justify your xenophobia...
...I'm starting to see Earth's true plans. All its children are being experimented upon to produce a generation of espers...sickening.
I'm told you hold some authority in a military organization. I hope you're using that responsibly.
A military woman? Excuse me for not being impressed.
You don't seem quite as repulsive as the woman soldiers I've come to know.
Military...nothing worse than having a soldier around. Try not to kill anyone.
These "Evas" I've heard of actually seem like impressive technology.
You said something about "Evas" before? My Dread sounds a lot more reliable...but still, they sound fearsome.
These "Evas" sound like they're not to be trifled with. It's a good thing the Earth I know doesn't have any.
I have to wonder how our Vandreads would fare against these secretive "Evangelion" mechs Earth has...I hear they're much larger.
"Evangelions"...what is Earth under threat of that you need specialized mechs to combat it?
I don't doubt the need for special technology to combat a threat---we do the same with our Paksis. But what do the Evas fight?
...Miss Misato. If you command these Evangelion mechs, then what are they meant to defend against? It must be fearsome, as well...
Tarak and Mejare developed their Vanguards and Dreads to combat each other...what did you design the Eva mechs to fight?
It's poker, not pokermon.
You train pokuh---what?
These Pokemon sound interesting...Mejare doesn't have many animals.
You capture animals for your own amusement...sounds a little cruel, but Mejare treats men that way.
These Pokemon nipping at your heels sounds like Pyoro when he's making his rounds.
I know a woman named Misty...well, a girl named Misty.
I know a girl named Misty...she's from Pluto.
"Misty"...we have a young girl from Pluto on our crew who's named Misty, as well. She's the only one who has experience with men...
Are Earth girls taught about men from a young age? We have a Plutonian girl named Misty on our crew, and she knows how to cook for them...
Somehow I've become the "Big Sister" of a girl named Misty on our crew. We picked her up from Pluto...and she knows men better than we do.
...I don't suppose you know how to woo men? We have a "Misty" from Pluto who does, despite only being fourteen.
They said you're a student...but something about you seems intense. Like you know more than you let on...
I'm told you're a student. The uniform matches...but something in your eyes doesn't.
I know this is rude, but...something seems off about you. What did you say you did? You're a student?
For a supposed student, there's something about the way you carry yourself that makes me wary...like you're one step ahead of us.
The energy you give off is still perplexing. It's as if nothing can faze you---but only because you're here.
I don't know what it is about you that makes my skin crawl... but I can't ignore it. It's like you're one with this place.
A pilot needs to be able to sense danger quickly---and you're still triggering that instinct. It's as if this place is doing it to you...
...What are you? I get the feeling you'd be harmless on Mejare, yet standing right here...I can't describe it.
What exactly is your fascination with ~player~? Do you know them from somewhere?
Is there a reason you're fixated on ~player~? What's the meaning of this constant attention?
Whatever your ulterior motives are, you're making it awfully clear you only care about ~player~.
I don't know why this girl is fixated on you, ~player~, but I would be wary of her.
...Are you feeling alright, Moon? You're acting very overeager.
...You want to strip? More so than the rest of us? Like a rookie with an inflated ego...
...Moon. What's this shouting and eagerness all about?
You're eager to be here...I don't like girls who seek constant attention.
...You can't be serious.
...Excuse me? Are you really so impatient you can't take this seriously?
...Can't you take this seriously? Can't you pretend to do so?
...I wasn't expecting my stereotypes of oversexed Earth girls to be confirmed. Play seriously.
You just want attention...
I wanted a challenge, and I get you.
...Insufferable.
For God's sake...
Is it Moon's turn again? Perfect, no reason to care...
Walking Mejarian propaganda, this girl...look what men have done to her.
I know a male doctor who'd like to inspect you for diseases, Moon...and the limits of female physiology.
You wear quite a bit for a girl so eager to strip. At least that gives me work time...
So, you feast on men's energy, or something to that effect? Way to confirm what Tarakkians already think.
You're certainly shapely. Is that how a "succubus" lures men into her traps?
Is all that really necessary? And are those real wings? I heard you say you were a succubus...
You might actually give Jura some competition with that figure. She's hunting for men herself...
I can't claim to be an expert in distinguishing male and female...but you seem very feminine, Ping. What are you doing?
..."Ping," was it? From Planet China? I thought you were a man...but you seem more like a woman putting on a performance.
...Is this a cultural tradition on Earth? Women imitating men? You're so clearly deepening your voice.
Men imitating women have fooled me...but women imitating men isn't very convincing, Ping.
I've been making an effort to distinguish the sexes better, "Ping"...and imitating men is not flattering for a woman.
I didn't expect to meet a pirate from this planet. Do you hide your headquarters in low orbit, as well?
An Earth pirate...with a crew of her own, as I understand. We hide our base in the asteroids surrounding Mejare---what about you?
I see Earth pirates can dress just like Mejarian ones. If you haven't considered it, this planet's moon might make a good base of operations.
This planet has a big moon. Our band of pirates hides off-surface---what about your own crew?
Why are you always addressing ~player~? Do you know them from somewhere?
I was under the impression we were all strangers...but you seem very fixated on ~player~.
~player~, do you know Natsuki? She's always addressing you like you're close.
On and on about ~player~. If you two have personal issues to resolve, Natsuki, this isn't the setting for it.
...Where's your body, exactly? You look like the Paksis energy core of our ship...
You look like a miniature Paksis. Any relation?
You look like the Paksis sprouted wings and shrunk.
Are you big enough to hold the cards? Some sort of alien, I suppose...your body looks like our Paksis core.
I was told you're some sort of Oracle? I'm not sure I believe in fate...what can you predict?
...If you're truly an Oracle, I'm curious what you see in my future.
An "Oracle"...well, you're certainly tranquil enough for that. If you can forgive my skepticism, I'd like to know what you see for me.
I've always subscribed to the notion that fate is what we make for ourselves...but I've never met a so-called Oracle. What do you see for me?
I can appreciate musical talent in a girl...my Fama had a nice singing voice.
Do you plan to play that harp? I...very much appreciate music, ever since my Fama used to sing to me...
My Fama always sang to me when I was young...but I didn't inherit that talent. Girls who have it are always a pleasure.
If you could share your harp's sound with us...I'd like that. I loved when my Fama sang to me as a girl...
I see you've got my affinity for words.
Hearing you loud and clear.
Girls shouldn't be afraid to speak their minds.
At least your hair is expressive.
A maid? I had a maid growing up...I wish we had paid her more.
Being a maid is looked down upon on Mejare...just a stepping stone to finding the Oma of your children.
Mejare looks down on maids...Mejare looks down on a lot of professions.
Mejare looks down on maids...but they're held in higher regard than pirates.
What's with the honorifics? Strange language you must speak at home...
What's with the honorifics? Maybe Mejare could do with that kind of politeness...
...Is this the result of some cruel Earth experiment? You have extra arms grafted onto you.
...My God. Earth would turn a girl loose into the streets after grafting extra limbs onto her? I'd probably be shouting, too...
...I should've expected to see girls who have been experimented on and cast aside by Earth's uncaring government. Are you alright, Orendi?
Constantly shouting, with two extra arms...I can only imagine what other victims of Earth's failed organ transplants may be wandering about. Are you in pain, Orendi?
You're a goddess? Don't be so vain.
You're a goddess because you live in the sky? There's a lot more to the universe than that.
Jura would probably describe herself as a "goddess"...
I thought Jura dressed extravagantly...now we have a goddess.
An engineer, and a user of "magic"? Hm...if there's any truth to that, I'm sure our ship engineer Parfet would love to meet you.
The crew has an engineer of our own---Parfet. But she doesn't claim to use any "magic"...
This "magic" of yours seems at odds with the logical nature of engineering. But I'm just a pilot...maybe you and Parfet could talk.
If only our own engineer, Parfet, had access to this "magic" of yours. Not that I trust it in the first place...
So, you work for an old woman too.
I hear an old woman is your superior, too...and that she's not as kind as the captain.
Old women can be difficult to work for sometimes, wouldn't you agree?
So you do unsavory work for this old woman you know? I work for an old woman, too...she approached me.
You're from some kind of ninja village, was it? And what's a ninja, for that matter?
These "ninjas" of yours sound a lot like the telepathic people Hibiki got stuck with...
Not to be rude, but what's the significance of your facial markings?
Facial markings...I think Rabat's people have some, too. Not that I trust them.
You're a..."princess"? With a brooch and everything...you look the part.
What's a princess? Some kind of leadership position? The crown leads me in that direction...
A princess...is that like the Grand Ma? That's who rules Mejare...
You're royalty? I don't like it when people assume they're better than others...the title doesn't make the woman.
You study human culture? What exactly are you?
You study human culture? I could probably learn from you...
You study human culture? Duero has an anatomy book you might be interested in reading...
Jura's a big fan of pearls...or really anything that shines.
You're a teacher, right? I always find myself having to coach new Dread pilots, so I wouldn't mind advice.
Mejare's teachers are all state-employed and deliver anti-men propaganda. But as squadron commander, I've had to teach rookies myself...
A teacher...I remember liking my teachers in school before I dropped out. I never thought I'd be teaching girls piloting.
So what is it that you teach on Earth? Mejare teaches about the horrors of men...and I teach how to pilot Dreads.
...The classic Penny? Is this your way of calling me outdated, ~player~?
So, you're a teacher? ...Wait, no. You're not...you're just the classic Penny, risen from the grave.
I'm told you're the classic version of Penny, but if you ask me, you're simply the child version.
"Penny Classic." The newer Penny looks more mature, ~player~...you shouldn't be stuck in the past.
Pink hair...and pink skin. What kind of experiments is Earth conducting to do this to you?
Whatever experimentation Earth conducted on our harvested organs to give you pink skin, it also seems to have given you boundless energy...
I wouldn't put it past Earth's Harvest to try and create pink-skinned, excitable breeds of girls...but it wouldn't have been my first guess.
Such endless enthusiasm...if I were the pink-skinned product of strange Earth experimentation, I'd be even more morose.
...You're tall for a woman. You might give Gascogne a run for her money...
So, what's this "America" planet known for? Tall women?
You report the news? I was on the news as a little girl...wish I wasn't.
You're a reporter? It's been a while since I had a positive media appearance.
You're a student, right? And what does this Academy you attend teach you about?
My school experiences...weren't the best. But I'm curious what you've been learning in this Academy of yours.
You're certainly shy...that's normally what I expect from students. What is it you've been taught, exactly?
A student? I dropped out of school...I had to learn piloting the hard way. What's taught in "Beacon Academy"?
You don't quite seem dressed for the occasion here. Unless you'd rather just get it over with.
Do you just like challenging yourself, based on how little you're wearing? I just rushed over in what I usually wear.
At least you seem to like the attention. Based on your outfit, you're going to attract a lot of it.
You've got enough energy for both of us. Neither of us is wearing very much, though...
Well, Mika, you said you were going to win this game. How far can you stretch that outfit?
I didn't plan out how to make my flightsuit last...you're here to win, apparently, so let's see yours.
I hope your grand strategy isn't to amaze us into losing. I already don't see much clothing left on you.
I'd heard Earth girls dressed conservatively...I did not expect to find one wearing even less than me. Unless you're hiding a master plan.
You seem to be out of options. Or...is your plan to have Nadeshiko tag in for you?
I think I may have figured out your plan. Once your meager clothing is gone, your partner will take over.
For being so confident at first, you're already down to nothing, it seems. Is Nadeshiko here to take over?
I see what you were planning now. You and your partner must do everything together---so she'll fill in from this point.
I'm interested in what a fashion designer might have to say about my suit...though I'd prefer the opinion of the newer Rarity.
I've always interpreted fashion as meaningless fluff. What's a designer's opinion on my bodysuit? ...Even if you're the old Rarity.
Fashion...a pastime for the rich and privileged. Still, I'm curious what a professional thinks of my bodysuit...an outdated version of a professional, anyway.
It seems even fashion designers can go out of fashion. Eclipsed by a newer version of yourself...still, what's your opinion on my suit?
And Jura calls me chilly...
You look like that outfit has never come off.
You can show your face, Raven...I know being open with people can be hard.
People say I never smile...are you the same way?
You're certainly acting more cheerful, Raven. Maybe I should follow suit...
Something about this game lightened you up in a hurry. That was supposedly why I came here...
Jura told me this place would put me in a better mood...well, it's worked for you, Raven.

state.text: Something about stripping has brought out a lighter side of you. Now everyone will expect that of me.

case.state: Why do you have wings? Is this the result of some Earth experiment with the organs it harvests?
Wings---and they're twitching. Clearly not decorations...Earth's organ experimentation has gone further than I realized.
I should've known there'd be bizarre artificial evolutions of humans on Earth...this girl has wings.
Not content to sustain themselves with harvested organs, it seems Earthlings are inducing new evolutions into their women. Hence Remilia's wings.
If Earthlings are managing to graft wings onto themselves, I can only imagine what strange modifications they've made to the Mejarian uteri they've stolen.
Is there a reason you felt the need to come armed to a friendly card game? Especially with men's mechanical sidearms?
I see Earth women are still stuck with men's clunky kinetic weapons.
If you're so into weaponry, try Mejare's laser rings. They're a lot quieter than those racketous male ones.
You'd get along with Barnette...if you seemed capable of getting along with anyone. She likes men's mechanical guns.
You sure like to talk big...as long as you've brought those clunky men's guns to a card game.
...Is there a reason you keep waving those clunky kinetic guns around? Women should know better than to use male weapons.
...You don't need to start any fights. I certainly don't want to hear the racket of those men's sidearms you've got.
I'll never understand Barnette's fixation on clunky men's guns...or yours.
...I want to believe you're more than a trumped-up thug waving her first firearms around.
On and on with the shouting...are you really just some belligerent drifter?
I have no patience for aimless thugs. Are you really nothing more than that, Revy?
A drifting thug, waving guns around, trying to intimidate strangers...far too familiar. Unless you're actually more than that.
So, you're some sort of enforcer at this Lagoon Company. I like a competent woman...but leadership might teach you discipline.
I can believe you're your company's muscle---a good shot is worth my respect. Have you considered some leadership?
I don't doubt your aim, but you could use some discipline. Gascogne put me in charge of the squadron to teach me some.
Some leadership responsibility might calm you down, you know. I was an aggressive rookie with good aim, once, too.
I saw that your arms were extended just as I came here---like they were made of springs. What was that?
You're more than just a boxer---I saw your arms retract as the game began. Explain yourself.
"Ribbon Girl." A strange title for a girl with strange springloaded arms...I'd like an explanation.
If you could retract those springloaded arms, then you can extend them. I'm watching you---and feel free to explain.
You have the fashion sense of Barnette, one of my pilots...that is, less is more.
You have the sense of style of Barnette, one of my pilots...that is, skin is always in style.
Dark skin, and a revealing outfit...you remind me a bit of Valore, another Dread team leader. Well, revealing outfits remind me of many young Mejarians...
"Rinkah of the Flame Tribe," was it? Maybe Mejare's first colonists took their fashion sense from your minimalistic style...
Is your relative lack of clothing part of the "Flame Tribe's" aesthetic? Mejare feels the same way.
Minimalistic clothing...you'd fit right in on my homeworld. Though the animal pelts would turn heads.
You're a..."princess"? ...With magic?
What's a princess? Some kind of leadership position? I guess magic would make you worthy of it.
A princess...is that like the Grand Ma? Well, she can't use magic...
You're royalty? I don't like it when people assume they're better than others...but magic might give you a good reason to think that.
You're a..."princess"? ...Of space?
What's a princess? Some kind of leadership position? Who in space makes these decisions?
A princess...is that like the Grand Ma? I thought you were just out in space...
So, you travel through space, too...how's it treating you?
It can get lonely out in space, wouldn't you agree? Even with a whole crew at your side...
You fly through space on an observatory? Sounds...strangely luxurious.
There's certainly a punk rock scene in some of Mejare's seedier bars...but I've never seen it combined with animal training.
Punk rock...I used to listen to those sorts of acts all the time. Granted, they didn't involve "Pokuh-mon"...
My parents used to claim your sort of punk music was "poison"...but I don't think they meant the use of venomous animals.
Mejare has an underground scene of punk musicians... breaking the mold, singing about sex with men. None of them were animal tamers.
Why are you carrying ammunition? What kind of place is this that small girls are armed?
Even young girls have bullets on them here...I knew this place was a bad idea.
Ammunition? Where's the weapon for it, and why is a young girl like you carrying it?
I was going to say you look too young for this place, but the bullets on your hip let me know you've got bigger problems.
You look a little on edge...especially with that red streak of hair. Were you engineered to have that?
That's an interesting streak in your hair. Mejarians have unusual hair colors, but not on specific parts...was it engineered like that?
That red streak of hair...is that natural? I've never seen piecemeal hair color engineering like that...
That red streak of hair seems to betray your attitude. With a piecemeal coloration like that, I wonder if you were engineered with technology beyond Mejare's...
You're a bit behind the times, ~player~. This is the old version of Ryuko...the one I moved offline, in fact.
Another older version of a character? Oh, yes, Ryuko...her being retired was my doing, actually.
That's an interesting red str---oh, wait, you're old Ryuko. My submission moved you offline, you know.
You shouldn't live in the past, ~player~. This Ryuko has been replaced...in fact, I was the one who retired her.
...Are you alright, Saki? You're all clammed up.
You look like a schoolgirl. Are you sure you want to be here? Is someone making you do this?
Are you alright...Saki, was it? You look so nervous...
Saki? That's you, right? You've hardly said a thing...and you're turning red.
You look like you've seen better days...and are about to see worse ones. Are you sure you want to be here?
Pint-sized and crass...street thugs always have difficulty integrating into our crew. I would know.
The Magno Family gets a lot of your type off the streets. They have trouble working with others...I did.
I see Earth society produces an underbelly of young women on the streets, too. Our crew has to whip them into shape...
...A loudmouthed, cocky thug fresh off the streets. Our crew takes in a lot of your type, and they get put in Reg moving crates.
...I've always been wary of the kind of overly-optimistic persona celebrities put on. I used to have one myself.
...In my experience, the cheery manner of an idol is meant to mask something. I did it myself when my family was famous.
An idol? ...I know how celebrities can hide issues beneath their image. I did.
I wouldn't expect a media star to play a game about revealing yourself...they have secrets like the rest of us. My family was the same way.
Even my cheeriest crewmates are hiding insecurities. Celebrities can be even worse with that---I would know.
Hunting space pirates? Some pirates have a good reason for what they do...
Oh, you're not from Earth, either? ...And you hunt space pirates. I see.
So, you travel through space, too...and hunt space pirates. Good luck with that.
There's a pirate named Rabat I wouldn't mind you catching for us...since you travel through space.
Good to see someone who shares my fashion sense...and origin.
These bodysuits can get uncomfortable, wouldn't you agree, Samus? Even out in space...
So, you travel through space, too...and you hunt space pirates? I'll keep that in mind.
What exactly is a "Magical Girl"? You seem to use it as if it's a title...do you actually have powers?
A "Magical Girl"? If you've got special powers, it'd be worth my time to see them.
Normally I'd doubt someone who called herself a "Magical Girl"...but the Paksis itself is extraordinary.
With what we've accomplished with the Paksis's help, I can believe someone when she calls herself a "Magical Girl." Now I'm curious...
You're a pilot? It's nice to meet you! We should discuss squadron formations.
These "Gundams" of yours sound a lot like Vanguards. I wonder if my Dread could combine with them...
Oh, wow, another mech pilot! We should talk after the game.
You're a pilot? I only took up piloting a few years ago, but I've really fallen in love.
It's good to see a fellow pilot! You even look a little like Belvedere, one of our bridge operators.
A mech pilot, hm? I pilot a Dread myself...but recent events have forced me to learn mech operation.
Are you sure you want to be here? You look young...and very naive.
A schoolgirl? And a bright-eyed one at that...this is making me uncomfortable.
What a cheerful young girl. You certainly look old enough to be here...but I'm not sure you're mature enough.
You know what you're getting into, right? I don't want a schoolgirl crying and wasting my time.
Please don't subject us all to your ongoing relationship issues with ~player~, Sayori. I get enough of that from my subordinates.
I have to manage my pilots' problems often enough, so don't expect me to play marriage counselor for you and ~player~.
...You seem a bit obsessed with ~player~. If you two have issues, you could work them out elsewhere.
...Sayori, are you in some kind of relationship with ~player~? Reminds me of when my pilots get too comfortable with each other...
I admit, your enthusiasm is infectious. You remind me of Dita, one of my pilots...always playing with her alien dolls.
It's like a schoolgirl version of Dita...oh, she's one of my subordinates. A sweet girl, but not responsible enough.

At least I don't have the weight of the game on me now. I can focus on analyzing how you've layered instead.
I'm masturbating...that's all you need to know.
Out of the many things that aren't any of your business, Jura, that's the most of all.
I wouldn't tell you that if I had a gun to my head.
You're not prying that out of me so easily...but it definitely isn't you.
You're getting dangerously close to nude. I still want you to win this for me.
Don't give up now, Jura. You have what it takes to win this.
I know you enjoy stripping, but I'd be very proud to see my second-in-command win this game.
Take your mind off flaunting your body for once and make sure you win this for me...for yourself.
Oh, perfect. Just what I wanted to hear.
Well, Jura, this had better be interesting...
Well, I am in a better mood than usual...
This has cheered me up a bit. Just get it over with.
Down to nothing at all...you'll find it thrilling, or at least I did.
It's better going naked anyway...it forces you to rely on nothing but wits.
Here comes the final test of your skill. Don't let me down, Jura.
You can still win this, Jura. Believe in yourself...I made you play this with me all the time for a reason.
Your first loss, after all this time. I'm proud of you, Jura.
Great work, Jura. You beat me soundly...now finish the job.
I never stood a chance. I never knew you could play cards so well...
You've been truly magnificent, Jura. All I need is this kind of execution in your piloting,
Jura, there's many things I feel you have the right to know about me. That's not one of them.
I'd rather not say...I guess that just makes you want to know all the more.
Perfect. I'm never going to hear the end of this from you.
None of your business...my sexuality is my own.
Very funny. Maybe I'll do that just to spite you.
You're quite the sore winner. Good thing you don't usually win.
Make fun all you want. I'm just happy to see you do so well.
Are you sure you want my unfashionable hands touching your things?
I'm fine just as I am. Let me relax for once.
I only ever relax when I sleep. Let me have this...
It's none of your concern, Jura. Focus on the game.
I'll sit here for as long as I want. It's the only agency I have left in this game.
Give it a rest, Jura. I'm not telling you something like that.
That's none of your business. But of course you'll try to butt in regardless...
Jura...I don't like talking about that sort of thing.
Can't you just stop with that sort of talk? I'm not telling you something that personal.
I don't think that's going to be an issue for you, Jura.
Don't tell me you're going to lose your nerve. I didn't even know about the rule going in.
It was surprisingly relaxing, so don't worry too much.
I have a hard time believing you're actually worried about this.
I'm interested in what a fashion designer might have to say about my suit. It's the prevailing style on Mejare...especially among our pilots.
I've always interpreted fashion as meaningless fluff on top of practical outfits. What's a designer's opinion on my bodysuit?
Fashion...a pastime for the rich and privileged. Still, I'm curious what a professional thinks of my bodysuit...since it's so common on Mejare.
My parents used to dress me in the latest fashions...now I just wear this suit, and I'm curious what a fashion designer thinks of it.
It's poker, not pokermon.
...You train pokuh---what?
These Pokemon sound interesting. Mejare doesn't have many animals.
You capture animals for your own amusement? That sounds a little cruel, but I guess Mejare treats men that way.
These Pokemon nipping at your heels sounds like Pyoro when he's making his rounds.
You live in a colder region of this planet, right? And these Pokuhmon creatures exist in every habitat? Maybe some kind of animal experiments let loose...
...Is it true that you're the heiress to a wealthy family? I was the same way when I was young...it didn't last.
...If you're the heir to a wealthy family, then you're probably used to media appearances. That was my whole childhood...
...Weiss, was it? I come from a wealthy background, as well...I'm now a pirate. So you can see how that ended...
I hope your family is treating you well. My parents were respected scientists...until they weren't. And I was caught up in it...
Intricate plate armor seems common among Earth women. The same goes for swords... just historical respect, or conscription?
With the amount of girls I see here with armor and blades, I have to ask if it's common for girls to receive combat training on Earth.
Mythra, right? I was told something about you "being" a sword...that and your armor makes me wonder if girls are drafted on Earth.
...You're dressed for antiquated ground combat. Is armor and edged weapons still a combat tradition among Earth girls?
Is it true you've made your career in pornography, Miss Jessie? Medical drawings can only demonstrate so much about men's biology, if you follow.
...Pornography may be a bit tasteless, but if your videos can show men in action, then they'd be useful resources for us.
A game of strip poker seems almost too quaint for an experienced pornstar. Does your work demonstrate men's physiology well?
...It may take some editing, but Earth pornography could provide insight into men's organs. You've starred in some, right?
Is it true you have a daughter, Miss Jessie? And that was with a man? What made you decide on him?
Personal accounts can be the most illustrative...you had your daughter with a man, right? How did you know he was the right choice?
Your daughter has a male parent, right? Or---father. What did you look for in a man who'd raise your children?
Choosing the Oma of one's daughter is an important moment for Mejarians. But if you had yours with a man...why him?
You seem interested in the history of this planet. My homeworld leaves men out of Earth's history...are there any legends about men and women?
I could learn a lot from a woman who's studied Earth's mythology. Have cultural perceptions of men and women changed over time?
You study mythology, right? Mejare's stories always centered around conquering men---do Earth's involve man-woman relationships?
My homeworld has little in the way of mythology compared to Earth. Do you know much about the cultural history surrounding men and women?
Slender, long-legged, and with a taste for revealing clothing...you would get a modeling job on my planet in no time.
A fashion model...I was given modeling offers as a child. There's a large industry for your body type on Mejare.
Do you find your modeling work lucrative here, Elesa? The Mejarian fashion industry seeks out slender girls like you.
I see Mejare's taste in both girls' bodies and outfits is present here. If you're ever struggling financially, consider a job there.
...Why have the others referred to you as an "angel"? You look like a normal girl.
...There must be an alternate meaning for "angel" in Earth culture I'm unaware of. You look normal...and angels don't impatiently demand sex.
...I can only assume "angel" is sarcastic Earth slang for promiscuity. Unless you have another explanation.
...I'm told you're some sort of "angel," but nothing about you looks supernatural. Do you know what that's referring to?
...As I said, I'm from the Mejarian system. We've never encountered alien life---how long have you been on this planet?
...Has Earth been communicating with your species for a long time, Starfire? Mejare was completely unaware of aliens' existence...
...Unbelievable. Earth first established colonies to find alien life, and yet it discovers it before we do. How long have you lived here?
...I have so many questions. When did your race first make contact with Earth? Mejare's had no such meeting with an alien species...
Is it true you're from an all-woman culture here on Earth? Maybe this is the origins of Mejare's colonists...
...Diana, are these "Amazons" an Earth society that rejects men? You may be the precursors to the women who settled Mejare...
...You come from an all-woman society, right here on Earth? How long has this been established? We may be descended from the same women...!
"Wonder Woman"...are there really enclaves of Earth women who live away from men? Maybe that's the missing cultural link between our planets...
I'm always pleased to see a young girl who's devoted to exercise, but your skin looks quite unhealthy. Have you visited a doctor?
A schoolgirl who's already committed herself to fitness is great to see...but what's given you your blue skin? Are you breathing properly?
Still in school...I wish I'd started taking my fitness seriously that early. Then again, your skin color suggests you may be exercising too hard...
Blue skin...are you suffering from some form of anemia? I hope that doesn't affect your athletics...
...Miss Jessie. Where is the man who impregnated you? Does he not mind what you do for a career?
Where is the father of your child, anyway? Has he accompanied you here---or on porn shoots, for that matter?
I'm surprised the man who fathered your daughter allows you to work in pornography. Maybe men don't place much stock in monogamy...
Pornography is a strange choice of career for a married woman. Does your child's father not consider that cheating?
How did you die in the first place, Spooky? If you don't mind me asking.
To learn here and now that an afterlife exists...if you're really a ghost, that is. Did you die of natural causes?
...Forgive me if this is too personal, Spooky, but what was the cause of your death?
I would still sooner believe you to be some apparition from the Earth's Paksis, sent to confuse and scare us...how did you die, exactly?
I can see our similar names getting confusing, but it's a pleasure to meet you, Mei.
Mei and Meia...I should consider myself lucky there's no similarly-named girl among our crew.
Pleased to meet you, Mei. We'll have to listen carefully so we know which one of us others are addressing.
Our names are quite similar, Mei. I hope that doesn't interfere with conversation as the game progresses.
You remind me quite a bit of our ship's lead engineer, Parfet. She's always excited about our machinery---and she wears baggy clothing, as well.
Our ship's engineer will be happy to know that there's girls just like her on Earth---not just in dress, but in unbridled excitement over technology.
Large, obfuscating eyewear...baggy pants...heavy boots...a positive attitude. It's like looking at our engineer, Parfet, right here on Earth.
You're just like our ship's engineer, Parfet, right down to your clothing. I respect her intelligence very much, even if she's too upbeat for me.
By your defensiveness, I get the sense that you're small even by Earth standards. Is this a side effect of your magical powers?
At first I suspected that Earth's resources led to smaller girls, but this seems like a personal issue of yours. Does "explosion magic" stunt growth?
If your body hasn't developed as much as the typical Earth girl, is it possible that it's from your magic? It might drain the body's energy.
Even at eighteen, you're as developed as our eleven-year-old nurse. Is it possible that "magic" has warped your body?
You're...a little pale. Are you feeling alright? And you're not wearing much...
So pale...muscular, but...you look sickly, despite how little you're wearing. Trouble breathing?
And Jura calls me pale. You're marble-white. And you don't really have the wardrobe for this game...
...Is there no sun on your planet? You're certainly dressed for it.
That's a vivid hair color...but the mechanical arm is more striking.
You're a fiery one. I'm sorry about your arm...or I would be, if it didn't look superior to my own.
My crewmates and I all have different hair colors...none of us have mechanical arms.
Genetic engineering on Mejare has resulted in outlandish hair colors...maybe we could regrow your arm.
I'd say I'm sorry, but...that mechanical arm looks pretty useful.
It's good to see a girl who can carry herself...and maybe lift herself, too.
I shouldn't pry as to how you lost your arm...but is that mechanical replacement useful?
You're a fiery one. Like if Barnette and Jura had their child...hopefully she'd have her arm.
I was wondering why a butterfly was being dealt cards. Do you actually have clothing to lose?
...I wasn't prepared to meet a sentient butterfly here. How exactly do you plan on "stripping"?
...Are you really participating in this game? I could accept a talking butterfly providing commentary, but you don't have clothes.
A talking insect...Earth's experimentation reaches new depths. How you plan to strip, "Flutter"?
...Yuelia. Why would you join this game as a butterfly and almost immediately change back? Were you trying to rattle us?
Why did you even come to the table as an insect if you're so quick to project a human form? Just to demonstrate your powers?
...Yuelia. Have you actually changed shape, or was that butterfly some sort of hologram? Either way, why did you drop the act so quickly?
Flutter---er, Yuelia. Was that butterfly form just a means of making an entrance? You dropped it at the first opportunity.
Are you sure you want to be here? Not to be rude, but you seem absentminded...a naive girl still in her school uniform.
..."Amy," right? I don't know how a carefree schoolgirl found herself here, but I don't want to see you get taken advantage of.
Hello, Amy. I'm surprised to see a young schoolgirl playing a game like this...I hope someone knows you're here.
"Amy," was it? I'm not sure why...but I get the sense that no one is looking out for you here. Be aware of your surroundings.
...Chun-Li, is it just me, or do we sound...somewhat similar? You're just a bit older than I am...
...When you speak, I keep thinking I'm hearing a recording of my own voice. We sound a bit alike, don't you think?
...Forgive me if this sounds strange, Chun-Li, but we sound alike. I wonder if my crewmates might mistake your voice for mine.
...Have you noticed we sound similar, Chun-Li? If I took a more upbeat tone, we might match.
...For some reason, your voice reminds me of how I sounded when I was younger. I guess it's just coincidence.
...Lotte, have you noticed we sound a bit alike? I had more of your nervous tone when I was a girl.
...This may sound strange to you, Lotte, but your voice sounds just like me when I was a girl. Can you hear it a bit?
Mhmhm...Lotte, have you noticed our voices aren't much different? Listening to you speak brings back memories...
You look like you haven't gotten any sleep. You need to take better care of yourself.
"Tomoko," right? It's important for girls to respect themselves and their bodies' health. You look exhausted and disheveled.
What's a girl like you doing here in a seedy place, looking tired and unkempt? You need rest, Tomoko.
..."Tomoko," right? Are you alright? Do you have a place to sleep? I hate seeing a girl in places like this.
...You keep speaking in slang. I assume it's popular among young Earth girls, but it's difficult to determine what you're saying.
...Are you intentionally using as much jargon as you can to confuse us? I might learn some Earth phrases if you explained them...
...What a strange girl. I should make a note of all the unusual phrases you're using and try to decipher them later.
...There must be a subculture among Earth girls that lends itself to strange sayings. Are you even interested in making conversation?
It's strange for me to see wealthy schoolgirls in uniform now...they don't tend to join pirates. But then, the first recruits were all from rich districts like mine.
...I'd say a wealthy girl in her school uniform would never join our pirate crew, but that's exactly how we were founded. I was one of them.
Is it true your family is well-off? Mine was, as well, but I still ended up as a pirate. Don't take your wealth for granted.
Hello, Maki. The Magno Family pirates recruit many drifters your age...a lot of us were wealthy, too. It can happen to anyone.
Is it true you're some sort of robotics expert? Our ship's lead engineer, Parfet, says she sometimes feels alone in her interests.
You're "half-genie," right? I'm not familiar with the term...I wouldn't think that pointed ears would warrant a separate race.
Aside from your pointed ears, you look like a human girl, Shantae. What's the meaning of being "half-genie," as you claim?
...Could you explain what the goals are of this "Fairy Tail" guild you claim to be a part of? It sounds vaguely like mercenary work...
"Lucy," right? Your "Fairy Tail" organization may provide some insight into Earth's economy...is it a mercenary guild?
I assume your belt is next. It's interesting to see another girl with a whip...our vice captain uses one as a weapon, not that she fights much.
...Our ship's vice captain is a woman named Buzam. She carries a whip for self-defense, much like you do...well, I assume yours is for that purpose.
Forgive me if this is too personal, but...how did you lose your arm? Was it a combat injury?
You're quite upbeat for a girl with a robotic arm...did you lose it while on a raid? I'm lucky to have had no lasting injuries...
...Shouko, right? You haven't said anything...are you alright? You have the same look rookies do on their first flight...
...You look nervous, Shouko. You haven't said a thing...I've met girls in my Dread team who get like that, but only when faced with a dogfight.
What a terrified young girl...it reminds me of pilots on their first mission, wide-eyed and scared speechless. Are you alright, Shouko?
It's nice to meet you, Shamir. You don't seem interested in this game...you mentioned being on a mission, right?
Hello, Shamir. I can appreciate a girl who's mission-focused, but I'm not sure how playing strip poker could be a part of that...
