Surely you weren't recruited as a warrior in your current state. How have you been allowed to become so chubby?
If you're really a warrior, then I imagine you weren't always so overweight. How have you gotten to this point, where your stomach is hanging out?
So grossly out of shape...I can't imagine you were like this when you first became a warrior. Is this the result of peacetime complacency?
...Azami, are you alright? You look pale...and I'm told you have a prominent scar. Are you worried about showing it here?
...I came here to ask questions about Earth's people and culture, but I guess you won't be giving me answers.
...I'm glad Mejare has mimes, as well, so I understand what you're doing. You certainly wouldn't explain yourself.
...Are you alright? You keep fidgeting and won't look at anyone.
...Is something wrong? You look nervous.
What an elaborate outfit...it's as if you're trying to totally hide your appearance. I hope you're aware you're playing strip poker.
You're displaying a lot of Earth fashion...I might be inclined to ask about it if you weren't hiding your entire body in it.
...What---monstrosity are you? With a human voice...it's like a vision the Paksis might give me, of a twisted and warped woman...
...Are you...a human being? You have a voice, and a form, but it's so distorted...our Paksis core has given me visions like this.
...Ryuko? Your uniform---w-what's this intense energy?
...Your outfit completely changed with that uniform's shape-shifting. Can it still survive if you remove pieces of it?
I was hoping to see this...do you plan to take that uniform apart? If it's a living being, can it separate?
...I can sympathize with a young girl rebelling against authority. But to think a teenage rebel would wield such power... w-what's happening now?
...I, too, chose to rebel against oppression. But how did a teenage girl gain access to such weaponry? ...And what's it doing now?
Knowing you, I'm sure your panties will come off in spectacular fashion...not unlike the man in my squadron.
No matter what you do, even taking off your underwear, it seems to be with intense passion. It reminds me of the male pilot on my team.
You only ever talk about eating French fries---besides eating them as we speak. What else is in your diet?
French fries can't be the only thing you eat---you'd be in an even worse state. What other "human food" have you discovered?
I often coach my Dread team members on fitness issues. Can you describe your diet, Erufuda? Maybe I can offer advice.
I'm told you attend an officer's school. I serve as a junior officer myself, but in a pirate crew---I have no formal education on the subject.
Bernadetta, right? You're quite shy for a girl who's attending school for military command. I'm not formally trained, but I lead a team of Dread fighters.
...Are you really a robot? You're so humanlike in look and mannerisms...even our navi robots are distinctly mechanical, though one of them has emotions.
...If you're really a robot, Earth's advances in the field are far beyond our own. We've only just created a robot with emotions by pure accident.
You're quite fixated on money. It was years ago that I even had any Mejarian credits to my name...now our crew just stockpiles it.
...You're a shopkeeper, I take it? I haven't handled money in years...our crew doesn't take jobs.
If you're here for some kind of sales pitch, I don't have any Earth money. In fact, I only handle Mejarian money when we find some on a raid.
The closest thing our crew even has to money is food certificates. I won't be involved in any of your business ventures this evening.
...An "animate" statue? I see...you must be some kind of host body Earthlings create to house the organs they harvest before transferring their consciousness.
...What's the meaning of your "animate" status? Maybe you're a test body to ensure the quality of harvested organs, or some experimental golem...
One of this planet's political leaders...I'm told you reside in a cold region. Mejare is a temperate planet, if you couldn't tell by my outfit.
I'd heard you were the leader of one of Earth's colder regions. That would explain your heavy dress...my own planet is climate-controlled.
It's my understanding that Earth's temperatures vary wildly based on region. I'm glad Mejare doesn't have that issue---I'd hate to dress for the cold the way you do.

state.text: What's the meaning of that ridiculous mask? Not to mention the reckless way you're swinging that machete around---!
Why are we set up next to an unhinged woman with a mask and machete? She's not holding it like it's for self-defense---!

case.state: Shouko, you've got some more of the men's language in your writing. We mostly use kana.
Earth's style of writing is fascinating, Shouko. You fuse men and women's language---Mejare doesn't use those more complex characters. A mixed letter system for mixed genders...
I'd never considered this, but the same way men and women live together on this planet, you write using a combination of our languages. Tarakkians use those kanji letters to encode messages.
Is it true you're a swordswoman? My deputy ensign carries a rapier, though I'd prefer she practice more.
I'm told you're an experienced swordswoman, even though you're a young girl. I don't care for edged weapons myself, but one of my pilots uses a rapier.
I don't know what your intentions are, but you'd best keep that knife to yourself. It's sad a child managed to get a hold of one in the first place.

state.text: Why is there a mentally unstable child permitted to run about this place with a knife? I won't hesitate to defend myself.

case.state: Why have you drawn your knife? In fact, I don't even see a sheathe for it. You're clearly not well.
"PA-15"...a codename? I'd expect a professional to have a better sense of gun safety.
You're far too animated to have that weapon out. Are you really a professional the way your codename implies?
"Pok-uh-mon"...I've never heard of such creatures. And they're apparently common on this planet?
I wonder if these "Pokuhmon" creatures are invasive species that have resulted from Earth's experimentation on regular animals...
Why are you hiding yourself? One of our bridge members dressed in elaborate costumes to shield herself from men's germs...
You're Myriam, right? That box looks like something Celtic might wear---a crewmate of mine who was afraid of the men we brought on board. Why are you inside it?
...Are you hiding from us in that box? One of my crewmates wore a bear costume in fear of men infecting her. An Earth girl can't possibly be scared of that...
...You're "Stella," right? I saw you enter through some kind of portal---what kind of technology is that using?
You were the girl who came in through a portal, aren't you? Our crew has encountered wormholes in the past, but you seem to have harnessed that technology for yourself. How?
...Yunyun, can you explain this "Crimson Demon" clan you claim to be a part of? You said you were going to be its Chief.
It's a pleasure to meet you, Yunyun. You said you were to become the leader of your "Crimson Demon" clan, right? How does it operate?
...Neptune, are you not an Earth citizen, either? You've mentioned a "Planeptune" being your homeworld.
You're from "Planeptune," right? Is that a region of this planet, or its own unique world like Mejare?
It sounds as if you have a reputation for exercise at your school. That's nothing to be ashamed of---my crewmates feel the same way about me.
My pilots often joke that I'm more easily found in the gym than my bed. It sounds like your classmates have the same opinion of you, Emi.
You're some kind of military official, aren't you? You mentioned something about keeping your emotions in check...is that part of your service?
You're Laevatein, right? A general and a princess...you were talking about how you were required to temper your emotions. Why?
Emi, do you solely focus on running in your exercise? Lately I've been trying to manage both slimming my waist down and building muscle.
My exercise schedule has been rough lately due to enemy attacks. Do you follow a regimen for building muscle? I've been trying to do that while keeping my measurements down.
Megumin, can you demonstrate your "Explosion Magic" here in a controlled manner? We've encountered Earthlings with some supernatural abilities before, but nothing like you claim.
This isn't the first time an Earthling has demonstrated superhuman powers like your "Explosion Magic." Can you perform it here and now, without endangering anyone?
Has Gamindustri always been such a religious planet? Our crew has encountered other colonies that have strong traditions of worship.
Religion isn't particularly strong on my homeworld. We're encouraged to honor the Mejarian Empire instead. Has Gamindustri worshipped like you say ever since its foundation?
Galatea, is your level of sentience unique among Earth robots? It's far beyond any AI we've been able to mass-produce on Mejare.
If it weren't for your exterior, I would have thought you're a normal woman with the emotions you display. Has Earth produced other robots like you?
How much of the mythology you study is still present in Earth's culture? Does a religious element still exist today?
From what you've described, it sounds like Earth has a rich mythological history. Has that led to a modern religion of any kind?
You're part of a band of travelers, right? Do you lead this group? I spend a lot of time forming combat strategy for my Dread team.
...Megumin, are you the head of the party you adventure with? I lead a pilot assault team, most of them around your age.
As I understand it, you train animal species called "Pokémon" at a high level. You speak as if it's a widespread practice.
Just how common is it to be a "Pokémon trainer" on Earth? Apparently you compete at the top level, whatever that entails.
...Shouko, have you always had this communication problem? Or did you develop it later in life?
Did you have an easier time speaking to others when you were a girl, Shouko?
So, based on these "Grimm," you haven't secured this whole planet to live on. Mejare's enemies are all offworld, and its military is built around space combat.

I'm not sure Mejare's imperial forces would be equipped to defend against "Grimm" creatures inhabiting large parts of the planet's surface. Most combat takes place in orbit of Mejare or the nearby Tarak.
You're a celebrity for your combat prowess, aren't you? I took to piloting well myself when I joined the Magno Family.
I understand you're a famous fighter on this planet. I remember rising through the Magno Family myself---I'm the youngest pilot of my rank.
...You're not just a normal woman. You've got sharp teeth, and you smell of smoke. What's the meaning of this?
...You're Bowsette, aren't you? I know enough about Earth girls to know they don't have fangs. What's going on?
I never learned much about the computer games you play. Are they just your hobby outside of goddess duties?
You seem more enthusiastic about playing computer games than your role as a goddess. I've hardly tried any before.
Good game, Emi. I'm glad to have gotten the chance to meet you---an Earth girl who takes good care of herself.
...You're out, Emi. This was fun---I think you've improved my opinion on Earth girls quite a bit.
Have you learned how to cook all the food you've been eating? That would at least translate into a useful skill.
I hope you've been preparing all this food you eat yourself. That would at least let you appreciate it properly.
Even though you were created by an artist, it seems like you're free to go where you please now if you're here. Is that true?
You've mentioned the gallery you were housed in quite a bit. Are you free to live as you choose now if you've come here?
I'd expected to find more outgoing girls here who could teach me about men. But...if you can't speak, you probably don't have much sexual experience, do you?
Even girls who can speak don't always communicate their feelings well when it comes to sexuality. You're still...inexperienced, aren't you?
I'd hoped to learn from Earth girls' sexual experience here. But another outsider's perspective might be equally valuable---what have you noticed about the way men look at you?
Another outsider to Earth sexuality, but one who's still observed it, might actually be perfect to ask on this visit. So...have you noticed whether men find you attractive?
Now that you're showing more skin...I don't see any scars. We're both lucky to have avoided that, or worse.
Your work sounds as dangerous as mine. Neither of us seems to have suffered any permanent injuries, but...the risk is always there, and it can happen in an instant.
Since you work in combat yourself, you must know the feeling...any battle could be your last. We're lucky to not even be injured.
I understand that you didn't plan to have her, but do you and your daughter... have a good relationship, at least?
I hope that your pregnancy being unplanned didn't leave you bitter towards your daughter. Now that she's older, do you get along?
...Your daughter would be around my age now, wouldn't she? Even if you didn't mean for her to be born, I hope you've appreciated each other since.
...It can't be good for a girl to think of herself as an accident. Do you and your daughter treat each other well, despite that?
It sounds as if your society is largely women with a handful of men. That's an interesting parallel to our ship, with the three male prisoners we have aboard.
...Men aren't common on your world, right? But a handful exist. With the men we've captured, we've created a similar situation aboard the Nirvana.
...Yuri, can you tell me about the stories you read? Literature would reveal a lot about Earth's culture.
If you do a lot of reading, then you should be familiar with Earth literature. What do the people on this planet write stories about?
So, there are more Earthlings with supernatural powers...you're not even touching the ground. You have some command over spirits?
...I shouldn't be surprised to see a floating girl with spirits around her. We've already met Earthlings with telekinesis. Who are you?
...You're Perona, right? Another Earthling superhuman...how are you levitating? And what are those ghosts you bring out around you?
It makes sense that Earth has pirate activity of its own. And if the population has superhumans, the body count must be even higher. What are you trying to achieve, exactly?
Perona, what's the goal of the Thriller Bark Pirates? Battles with Earth's government must be intense if you all have supernatural powers.
You work in a team of "huntresses," don't you? If you don't have a weapon, I guess you fill a supporting role.
...I guess you're the medic on your "huntress" team, or other support. Those in combat would carry weapons.
...Aren't you a "huntress"? You're unarmed. Unless you support the fighters on your team, much like our regisystem.
Bulma, you're married, aren't you? To a man. I'd like to know how men and women treat each other in a relationship.
The "Vegeta" you keep mentioning. Is he your---husband, is the word? I'm not familiar with married men and women.
...What are you? Some kind of projection...I wouldn't put it past the Earth Paksis's abilities, but for what, to create a virtual barfly?
...Is this what Earth creates with its Paksis energy? Some sort of projection of a sleazy girl to entertain bar patrons?
...Penny, are you really some kind of android? You look and act just like a human girl...Earth's robotics are far beyond our own.
If you're really the fighting android you claim to be, then Earth really has unmatched technology. Our only sentient robot was an accident, and he doesn't look human.
Your name is Lyralei, isn't it? Is "Windranger" an official title on Earth? There isn't much use for bows beyond ceremonies.
..."Windranger." Is that a designation in Earth's military? Like an archer for parades or festivals.
Those ghosts you summon leave the victim lethargic, right? Our prisoners have said they were taught women perform something similar on men. We "suck their energy."
Apparently, one of the claims the men's homeworld makes about women is that we drain their energy. That sounds like the same effect your ghosts have.
When we captured our male prisoners, they believed encountering women would sap their strength. As if they felt "sleepy." I wonder if your ghosts are related to that rumor.
...That flying partner of yours. "Tikki." There's a girl on our ship with an electronic blob companion on her shoulder similar to her.
That spotted creature you're speaking to---is she a living thing? We have a Plutonian refugee girl who keeps "Q-chan" with her, an electronic companion near her head.
Based on these "Muggles" you're talking about, it looks like the supernatural powers some Earthlings have are for a privileged few.
These "Muggles" you keep mentioning...I should have figured that there would be a lower class on Earth that lacks access to your powers.
I guess we've only encountered Earth's elite up to this point---people who would be granted telekinetic powers. So there's a class of "Muggles" who are denied them?
What is this "Grail" you're looking for? That's not a term for any cards on my homeworld.
Why are you so fixated on this "Grail"? Unless it's an Earth term for a good hand.
...You're more naive about men than I expected from an Earth girl. Were you raised away from other people because of your powers?
Don't Earth girls grow up around men? Or were you separated because of those ghosts? Earlier, you seemed...clueless.
What is this "Puyo" energy you keep referring to? The way it affects "dimensions" would fit the resources Earth is said to have.
I wonder if this "Puyo" energy you're talking about could be related to Earth's Paksis. What does it have to do with different dimensions?
What are you doing, waving that knife around? You'd look dangerous enough with just the mask. Is this your idea of a prank?
Put that knife down and show your face. Are you even here to play cards? You could hurt someone with a joke like this.
..."Susie." I'm giving you the benefit of the doubt that you're just a girl trying to scare us with a kitchen knife and a mask.
Our engineer Parfet has probably modeled characters in a computer the way you do. I've seen her program side projects on a whim.
You work as a "character modeler," right? Our chief engineer uses the ship's computers for her pet projects.
I think my parents would've liked if I were more studious like you. I never would've pursued their research---I was hardly ever inside.
Quietly reading books in school is probably how my parents would've liked to see me. They were scientists, and I was always running around and fighting.
Who or what do the Straw Hat Pirates oppose? Representing Magno's Family, I give my word we're not looking for conflict.
I guess we represent each other's pirate outfits. The Magno Family's only enemy is certain planet's governments. What about your Straw Hats?
...Shouko. This person you have feelings for...it's a man, right?
...When you said you were waiting for the right person, there's a man you have in mind, isn't there?
...You're training under this "Jeralt", aren't you? It was annoying enough for me to give a man orders.
"Captain Jeralt" is training you to be an officer, right? I'd have to swallow my pride to take orders from a man.
...My parents were government contractors. In another life, I probably would've ended up like you, attending an imperial academy.
...I never gave it much thought, but my parents probably would've sent me to a military school around this age. They worked for my homeworld's government.
This "Doctor Eggman" you're fighting...he uses robotic drones as soldiers, right? It wouldn't shock me if Earth's Harvesters benefitted from his research.
The Harvester fleets we've been fighting use unmanned machines. Your "Doctor Eggman" uses the same technology, right? Does he hold some high position in Earth's leadership?
An Earth encyclopedia is probably a more reliable source on men's reproductive organs than a strip game. Have you written articles about that?
...Did you write any encyclopedia articles on men's physiology? I'd rather get that information directly than stare at a man fiddling with himself.
Our ship's reg crew and spa attendants both try to maintain your same attitude of "service with a smile." As Chief Pilot, they're usually trying to serve me.
You talk like our ship's spa attendants. Dread pilots get special privileges, so they offer things like "revitalizing my beauty."
A lot of our ship's support crew had household servants of their own when they were younger. That's mostly how you work, isn't it?
I don't know Earth's "shrines," but you're basically a maid, right? Much of our crew was wealthy enough to have house servants.
I remember my first time in our flight simulators---I almost panicked until I got used to the controls. You've been talking about your work in computer simulations, right?
Many of our new recruits are shocked by how realistic our flight simulators are. It sounds like your "Online" simulations have a similar effect on people.
...Chell, why are you letting that robot speak for you? Or maybe I should ask you why you're speaking for her, "Wheatley."
..."Wheatley," right? Is there a reason you've been speaking for Chell this entire time?
Wheatley looks like a more primitive model of our ship's navi robot, Pyoro. He's gained the same sort of human emotions since he was exposed to our energy core, too.
Maybe Earth has perfected the same process that gave our navi robot Pyoro his sentience. Wheatley has the same habit of being eager to help and to talk.
You look a lot like the rockstars on my old magazines. I guess the "punk" movement survived space colonization.
I remember listening to punk rockstars like you back on my homeworld. It was my first act of rebellion, besides leaving my room messy.
...Is this a hologram the club has to entertain us? I remember hearing that my homeworld's wealthier bars were the same way, and wishing I was old enough to get in.
I think the higher-class nightclubs on Mejare have holographic singers of their own. By the time I was old enough, I was in seedier places.
As a representative of the Magno Family pirates, we don't mean your Blue Rogues group any harm. You conduct your operations on airships in the lower atmosphere, right?
Earth is such a verdant planet in this time, it makes sense your Blue Rogue pirates would operate from the atmosphere. Our hideout is in low orbit.
Earth isn't surrounded by asteroids the way Mejare is. Our Dreads need custom loadouts just to survive atmospheric entry---it must be easier working from the air.
Are there really so many Earth animals that girls go out to train them for a living? On Mejare, most of us only had birds.
I'd heard about all the different animals on Earth. It sounds like it's common for girls to become tamers.
My homeworld keeps its animal populations under strict control. I'm sure they're native to Earth like we are...you must have wildlife problems if there's so many "trainers."
...Fluttershy, are you feeling alright? You're so nervous, it's like your whole body has jaundiced.
Fluttershy, you've...turned yellow all over. If this game is making you feel that anxious, you should probably leave.
...Are you going to be sick? You're jaundiced all over. No one's forcing you to be here if you're uncomfortable.
It can get cramped even on a spaceship as large as the Nirvana. It's been a long time since I was even on a planet's surface...sailing with natural air on your skin must be nice.
Even when we encounter a new planet, I usually stay behind to command the Dread team from orbit. It must feel good to sail the open ocean and feel the wind in your hair.
With our hideout in Mejare's asteroid belt, and being stuck in deep space the past year, I'd love to get a chance to sail under blue skies. You look healthier for it.
...Lux, were you born with your ability to use this "light magic"? Or was there some kind of infusion process--- maybe exposure to a bright light?
...Do you remember seeing some bright light before you acquired your magic, Lux? You mentioned your powers involve light.
You haven't been in Demacia for some time, have you? I'm the same way on my homeworld. Even royalty can be branded a criminal.
I know how it feels to be an outlaw in your own homeland. It's been over a year since I was on Mejare's surface...
I guess neither of our homes are above exiling someone deemed undesirable---even if she used to be wealthy, or even royalty.
I was about as close to a princess on Mejare as a girl could get. The daughter of a famous family...but now I'm a common criminal living offworld. That's what happened to you, right?
...I have another question. Even Earth women don't know everything about men's bodies, right? Do they report being surprised by certain things?
Have you done any...popular research on men's bodies? As in, things even an Earth girl might be confused about?
...How much do you weigh, exactly?
Have you been tracking your weight through all this "dieting"? What are you sitting at?
...What is your weight, anyway?
You're a navigator on your ship, aren't you? Their work is important, but I'd rather go out on patrol than sit and watch radar.
You said you're your crew's navigator, right? I'd feel anxious just watching the computers for danger---I try to scout ahead in my Dread.
That underwear...I remember seeing it in school as an example of what girls wore on Earth centuries ago. Just how far back in time is this Earth...?
...You don't just have a taste for old-fashioned underwear, do you? I learned corsets and garter belts were Earth girls' clothes from before the frontier era.
...You paint with your feet, don't you? One of the men on our ship has an interest in painting---and he's a doctor. He'd probably like to see your technique.
Our male doctor apparently has a painting hobby. He'd probably find it fascinating how you use your feet.
What is this "Aether" technology you study? Some kind of crystalline energy?
...Is "aetherology" the study of energy crystals? Maybe Earth began its research in this time.
...Why is your "Team Magma" trying to expand Earth's landmass? This planet shouldn't need to be terraformed for humans to live on it.
...Earth is where all humans come from, isn't it? It shouldn't need the terraforming its colonies do. But your group is trying to change its environment...?
...Do you mean to tell us there's a place we go after we die? My homeworld has some stories about angels and underworlds, but most don't take them seriously.
You come from...an "underworld" after death? Most women on Mejare hardly even believe in that sort of thing.
...What is "Hell," exactly? An underworld in the afterlife? My home planet never put much stock in religious stories like that.
...You're a chemist, aren't you? My mother worked in the same field---I still have a test sample she gave me.
All the science-minded girls I've met in the last few years have been engineers for our Dread fighters. My mother was a chemist like you---it's a little nostalgic.
Are those girls around you---ghosts? Some kind of energy projection? They've been reacting to us...!
What's the meaning of this? You've been talking to those two---ghosts this entire time.
Both of your friends seem pretty adamant about you flirting with another girl. I thought that was rare on Earth---or punishable, even?
I thought girls usually marry men on this planet. Those friends of yours would rather you didn't...is that why they were killed?
...What "foreign threats" do the Avengers defend Earth from, exactly? I'd expect a border fleet to do that job.
...I understand you're part of this planet's foreign defenses. Who have you actually been fighting?
...I hope you're feeling more comfortable now. The way you talk about your adventures with a smile...it makes me think about how far our own crew has traveled.
It's odd seeing you get embarrassed when you've been so positive all night. Maybe I should treat our own crew's travels as more of an adventure.
Do you have any plans to return to Demacia? Our own crew is actually heading back to Mejare to warn them of a threat.
I don't know if Mejare will ever welcome our crew back, but we're returning there now because we know it's being targeted. Do you ever see yourself coming back home?
You're pretty lax about your officer's training. I wouldn't tolerate that, even if the girl were flawless.
Is your military schooling really as easy as you make it out to be? Even if you perform well, laziness can set a bad example.
...Are you not happy with your shyness, Yuri? Keeping to myself is exactly how I've tried to act for years.
For a long time now, I've tried to only engage with others when I have to. But you've spoken about your shyness like it's a burden. Is that how you feel about yourself?
I can believe you have fully human feelings. Are you here to explore your sexuality? Or were you programmed to prefer certain kinds of people?
Our navi robot hasn't displayed any interest in sex, although he has been babysitting. Are you here to figure out your sexuality for yourself?
You train these "Pokémon" animals in a colder region, right? Maybe that's why Mejare doesn't have any---it's not terraformed to sustain them.
My homeworld was never developed to have regions as cold as your "Sinnoh" sounds. That might explain the lack of "Pokémon" there.
You work with "animal rescue," right? My homeworld keeps its animals under supervision. The average citizen almost never sees them.
Mejare doesn't really have any of the "animal rescue centers" you work at. Almost all of its animals are already held inside government facilities.

...Do you have any data on men's preferences? What do they look for in women?
...Physically, I mean.
I guess I should ask about men's perspective. Is there some body part they tend to fixate on with women?
Who exactly are you working for in "Overwatch"? It sounds like a mercenary outfit.
I respect your role as a medic, but the way you talk about "Overwatch" makes them sound like mercenaries. Is that right?
Senko...is your work sexual somehow? I didn't want to make that assumption, but I don't know what else to take from your being here.
...I was giving you the benefit of the doubt before, but you're really a prostitute, aren't you? That's why you're making offers here.
Our crew actually likes to dabble in music sometimes to keep our spirits up. We haven't formed a band yet, but there's been holiday choirs that even I've joined.
Girls couldn't believe it when I joined our ship's choir for once. Maybe everyone will get adventurous enough to start a rock band of our own eventually.
I understand if you can't join our crew, but you'd still make an excellent combat instructor. Even a brief seminar could help shore up our security.
If you can find the time, our crew would appreciate you providing any combat training. Few of us actually have a background in weapons or martial arts.
...You've gone through a lot of schooling to experiment with these chemicals, right? I don't really know what that's like.
...What was it like, climbing through the ranks in academics? I assume you've had to study bioalchemy for a long time.
For a girl who lives away from others, you're actually pretty shapely. It's impressive.
I think most girls would let themselves go if they lived as recluses. You actually have a nice figure.
Maybe I'm just being paranoid. Bad memories with the media...I'll stop bringing them up.
...I'm sorry. I shouldn't be so cynical about the first celebrity I meet here.
I was serious about your skin condition, Sakura. Maybe you're trying to feel beautiful here, but it looked like it's spreading.
That gray rash really did look serious, Sakura. I've never seen anything like it---it's like your flesh is rotting.
...Do most Earthlings wear that body makeup? Or are the organ harvests here only for the elite, and this is how you've had to manage?
...That makeup you had. Earth does its best to maintain appearances, doesn't it? Or is rotting flesh the sign of a have-not who can't afford new organs?
You're not going to lose your nerve, are you? The thugs I ran with years ago used nudity just to break girls in.
This doesn't seem like it ought to embarrass a biker thug. I had to learn how to brush off nudity on the streets.
I wonder...the Earthling we met in our time looked far healthier. Maybe this Earth is from just before the Harvest was created, if you're applying makeup just to maintain society.
Could it be...? This era saw Earth about to go extinct, and so the Harvest was put into motion? Once people were reduced to wearing makeup...
What exactly is this "Yuritopia" you want to create? It sounds a lot more serious than I'd expect a schoolgirl to be.
What is a "Yuritopia"? For a schoolgirl, it sounds like some grand plan.
Did you come here to be more outgoing? Bathing was always one of the few ways I spend time with the others.
For how much I avoid my crewmates, I'm always with them in the changing rooms. You may be onto something if you came here to socialize.
You talk about your "Pokémon" as if they're your friends. Isn't it your job to tame them?
If you take "Pokémon" from the wild, I'd think they'd be aggressive. But you don't seem wary of them at all.
No one on Mejare has features like yours---the ears, or the tail. I guess I should take this to mean humans are more diverse than we thought, even beyond men.
On Mejare, having a tail or ears like that would make you look---not quite human. But our idea of "human" didn't include men, either. There's others like you, right?
Our ship recently had an accident where our crystal core dissolved into the water supply. Apparently it boosts women's hormone production. Do you know anything about the chemistry of that?
Does "bioalchemy" include studying hormones? There's been rumors of "female essence" in the water of one of our decks where our energy core leached into the plumbing.
I learned in school that Earthlings used to speak all sorts of languages before the planet was united. That's why some of your phrasing is off, right?
There are some first-generation colonists on Mejare who have still trouble with the common language. Did you grow up speaking something else?
What's this "rebellion" you're recruiting for? This planet must be politically fractured if you're seeking royalty.
You're recruiting "princesses" for some rebel cause, right? What's happening in this planet's politics to warrant that?
I'm not surprised Earth has identified a whole class of people as "mutants." What exactly is it targeting?
How does this planet decide who's a "mutant" and who isn't? Not that I can't believe Earth labels certain people as subhuman.
You were raised in isolation, weren't you? This "Silvite" civilization was a small pocket of this planet?
You're here to learn about other people, right? The "Silvites" that raised you didn't have contact with the outside world?
What do you know about how often men and women have sex? Taking that thing inside you...it doesn't seem like something you could do on a whim.
Do Earth couples have sex often? And does it always involve sticking that tube inside? I'd expect a girl to have to prepare herself...
Some of my homeworld's Imperial training programs had names like the "Knights of Favonius." How did you enter into yours?
Your "Knights of Favonius" remind me of the "Young Mejarian Imperial Training Corps." What led to you deciding to join them?
"Miss Lisa" sounds like someone I know from our own crew---Miss Gasco, our quartermaster. She handles weapons supplies more than record-keeping, but she's got that same calmness.
There's a woman on our ship, Gascogne, who manages munitions and supplies with the reg crew. She's got a relaxed air about her, as well---just like this Miss Lisa of yours.
New York is your hometown, isn't it? The way you talk about it, it sounds like this planet's capital.
From your descriptions, New York City sounds like it's at the forefront of this planet's culture. Is the government seated there?
How long has your home been under foreign control? For a long time, our crew thought Mejare was independent.
It sounds like both our homes are pinned under some greater power. I just didn't realize it about Mejare until recently.
If there's female hormones you can isolate, are there male ones, too? Maybe it'd help explain men's behavior.
Is there a "male hormone" to complement the female one? And does it cause any behaviors, like competitiveness?
A lot of girls on our crew used to play instruments back in school, like your piano. Our hideout never had room for them, so we've made do with a choir.
You play the piano in school, right? Our ship's choir has had to fill that role for a lot of the girls who were student musicians.

state.text: What---are you? You look like alien life taking the shape of a girl---has Earth been colonized by other species?
Even Earthlings shouldn't be so deformed that they've got tentacles and---extra eyeballs. Is this planet actually housing alien species...?

case.state: How do your crew's airships function? Do you know much about how they're built or the materials used?
If you could explain the design behind some of your airships, I'd understand this time period better. Space travel has to have started somewhere.
...You're awfully modest. I'd love to stand that tall, or be so muscular. But you're covering yourself.
...You're built taller and stronger than some of our security guards. Are you embarrassed about your body somehow?
That robot, Cupil...it floats around like one of our navi models. Maybe it's not just ships you have earlier versions of.
"Cupil" looks a lot like our ship's helper robot---a round floating face. The captain says he's an old "navi" model from colonization times.
You're some kind of fighter, right? Those old scars look deep, and deliberate.
Those old injuries look serious---and not just random accidents. You're a martial artist?
...What exactly is a "youkai"? You fight them, but also live alongside them? Inviting them to parties, even.
Would Earthlings be more familiar with "youkai"? Sometimes you talk like they're pests, and sometimes like they're your neighbors.
It sounds like this "Gensokyo" region is mostly female. I thought there were as many men on Earth as women.
Is there a reason men are so rare in "Gensokyo"? Or are they rarer than I realized all across Earth?
I wondered if there'd be other Earthlings with psychic powers. Are they something only nobles get?
It makes sense an Earth princess would be gifted PSI. The other esper we met was probably from the ruling class, too.
...Have you thought much about romance, now that you're traveling? You're here, after all---and half-naked.
...It's hard to ignore now, isn't it? Sex and romance. I guess you came here to explore your feelings?
You live on a set of islands here, right? You haven't said much about where they actually are.
...Where exactly are the "Nowhere Islands"? It's like they're supposed to be hidden.
You're confident for a schoolgirl. Have you played a lot of card games before?
Is there something to Earth poker I don't know about? Or have you just played this a lot? I'd expect a schoolgirl to be less sure of herself.
"Lastation" is its own world, right? What brings the ruler of a whole planet to Earth?
...So, you rule this planet of "Lastation" as a goddess. What are you doing on Earth, with commoners?
What do you mean by protecting your city from "ghosts"? Is that some kind of Earth slang?
You work as a "ghost hunter" for your city, right? I'd like to know what that means.
Does Earth's government really tolerate its agents stealing gems? My homeworld claims all its imperials are model citizens.
Mejare's government doesn't tolerate any crimes against the empire. Earth's must be more lenient if they know you're a thief.
If you're really some "zombie" that exists outside Earth's Harvest, then what made you this way? And for what purpose?
I don't buy that you're clueless about this "zombie" thing. But there's clearly more going on than borrowed organs. How were you turned immortal, and why?
The fact funeral directors even exist means this probably isn't the Earth from my time. No one on Earth dies, or is born.
Funerals themselves might die out on this planet in the future. Earthlings are trying to keep their bodies alive forever.
Your traveling party was just you and two men, right? I'd feel tense around them if I were outnumbered.
...You're the only girl in your travel group, if I understand. Are you really that comfortable around men?
What are you studying at this officer's academy? It sounds like you'd prefer to regain Brigid's independence peacefully.
Is diplomacy part of your schooling, or is it just military training as a "vassal"? You wanted to negotiate your freedom, right?
What's a summoner, exactly? The way you're dressed reminds me of priestesses on Mejare.
...Do "summoners" work in temples? Maybe you're just what we call a "priestess" on my homeworld.
Your---"father" was a summoner, right? I think my parents wanted me to be a scientist or politician, like them.
...Did you always want to follow your male parent as a "summoner"? That's definitely what my family wanted from me.
Your sense of humor seems...dated somehow. I guess that doesn't make any sense, when I've never been to Earth in the first place.
I've never been to this planet before, but still, the way you talk comes off as...out of fashion. I don't know why.
"Constanze," right? I don't like socializing, either. But no one will tolerate you if you don't return it.
...Sometimes I think of others as a nuisance, but you have to at least speak to them. They don't owe anything to you.
...I'm glad I can trust my pilots enough to not bark left, right, up, down at them all mission.
...You know, a good leader shouldn't have to give orders for every little action.
...It's hard to hear my native language butchered like this. Now I know where the men's idea of blocking women's speech came from.
...Is this what the men were talking about when they said women's speech would rupture their ears?
...Are cats popular pets on Earth? Girls don't usually wear bird costumes on my homeworld, even though we have a lot.
Most of us keep pet birds on Mejare. Is this a celebration of cats, pretending to be one?
...Respectfully, you're not my mother. "Ma'am" is enough.
...I know you're just being friendly. But I'd rather not call you "Mom."
Are you advertising a fish special here? It's a good, lean source of protein.
...Does this place serve fish? I usually take the low-fat meats in our mess hall.
...Am I supposed to make conversation? "Meia."
Has Ninetales been struck by her own "curse"? She can't seem to communicate.

state.text: Ugh! Who're you? Some kind of humanoid Harvest drone? Patrolling the planet's surface...!
You---look just like those Harvest cubes. Only human...does Earth have robotic soldiers, as well?

case.state: We haven't discovered any alien life in our sector. And yours has so much that you exterminate it for a living?
So, your Federation's found enough alien life to want some exterminated. There's only been humans on our colony worlds.
That power armor---it's like you've condensed the power of a mech into a personal combat suit. Is this something all Federation soldiers have?
Your Federation is far beyond us if that suit is standard-issue. It feels like the kind of power we'd put into a fighter ship.
...Are you really an alien? Even as remote as Mejare, we haven't discovered any foreign life forms.
None of Earth's colonies have found alien life. It's hard to believe the normal-looking girl in front of me is meant to be one.
If I understand, then you command your squad of "dragon hunters" without fighting yourself. Is that right?
Let me make sure: you organize these dragon-fighters, but you're not on the field with them?
Our ship's medical team is understaffed. If you'd like, we could use an experienced nurse.
Would you consider joining our crew? We're shortstaffed, and a trained nurse would put girls at ease.
...You're speaking like you're on a mission. Things like "hit rate" or "rank" sound like piloting terms.
What are all these phrases you're using? Our Dread team has the same kind of jargon about "accuracy" or "class."
...Is "Barbatos" your god on Earth? That religion may not have survived the frontier era.
I've never heard of "Barbatos" on Mejare. It might have been left behind on Earth.
...I'm sorry if you lost your hand in an accident. It's the kind of thing we can't replace when it happens to pilots.
Even with Mejare's medical prowess, something like losing a hand is still permanent for pilots. What happened to you?
Do you just watch your Pokémon fight, or are the trainers involved? I could see it requiring fitness.
Do you physically train yourself for these Pokémon battles? You might be put in harm's way.
Is that raven some kind of helper robot? Ours just look like eggs, even with how popular pet birds are.
For all the pet birds girls have on Mejare, there aren't any assistant robots shaped like them. That's what "Oz" is, right?
All the fairytales I read had goblins that looked more monstrous. Mejare must save the idea of "women's beauty" for humans.
I've never seen a goblin that looked like a human girl. My homeworld always had tales of beautiful women fighting ugly monsters.
You're---some kind of scientist? Studying energy, on top of that?
...You work in "sustainable energy," right? For people's living districts?
...I was an only child, so my parents always doted on me. What's it like having a sister?
...Do you get along with your sister? I didn't have one growing up.
What's wrong with Earth's oceans that your group is trying to terraform them? They looked full from orbit.
Earth shouldn't have to be terraformed, especially to add water. Is there a drought in this time?
...You're not very shy. Are you spending your time in school chasing after men?
You go to school with men your age, don't you? Are you this forward with them?
Is "Blastia" some kind of energy source Earth is working on? Or is it a weapon?
What exactly does "Blastia" do? Are you harnessing it for energy, or weaponizing it?
...How far back is this time? My mother was a chemist, and she told me "alchemy" was before people understood chemistry.
Isn't "alchemy" what ancient Earth chemists were called, before there was any science to it? That's what my mother told me.
You're an archeologist, right? Magno's Family doesn't have any crew for surveying. Even our engineers are all devoted to maintenance.
It's impressive that your pirate crew can afford to have scientists aboard. For a long time, we were just focused on survival.
I'm still getting used to the psychic link our ship gave me to some of my crewmates. But you're not even fazed by spawning your own limbs.
...Is this really like nothing to you, cloning your body parts? Our ship gave me a sort of psychic power that I'm still wrapping my head around.
I get the feeling you're just humoring us. Are most of your crewmates younger than you?
...Are you sort of your crew's "big sister"? It feels like you're not too concerned with any of us.
Do you get any coworkers telling you you're too focused? It never sits right with me when everyone is taking a break at once.
Even our captain says I work too hard. Do you get that at your job? I feel like someone should always be scouting ahead.
...Are those crystal lines part of your body? They look charged with energy...!
There's---energy lines fused with your body. Is that why you're so hyperactive...?
...Do others think you're hardheaded for staying diligent about missions? I hate just sitting idle.
I respect taking your guild's work seriously, and my crewmates respect that in me. But they still call me stubborn sometimes. What about you?
...Do you really take your job seriously? You seem more concerned with eating sweets.
...It's hard to believe you're the "responsible" one on your team when you're busy eating ice cream. Are you just enjoying your time off?
I haven't thought about it much, but I'd probably be in an academy right now, too. Schoolwork is its own kind of stress, isn't it?
You're leading your academy class, right? That kind of study work must be its own challenge...I've never pictured myself as a student today.
If you don't feel respected by your peers, you should try leadership. They don't pressure me to socialize because I already put myself at risk for them.
I've found that others will both appreciate you and leave you alone as long as you volunteer to help them. For me, that's leading the Dread team.
Why are you so insistent on helping us? Being so pushy is just bothering someone, even if you mean well.
If someone doesn't want help, I don't think it's right to keep forcing yourself into their life. It's just nosy.
Is coming to this place some kind of sexual outlet? If you're still in school, you should try to make friends instead.
...Do you have friends in school? A girlfriend is probably healthier than coming here for experience.
Our crew has to do its own share of "rehabilitating" recruits if they've been on the streets for a while. I was one of them.
I was one of our crew's "late recruits" who'd been living on her own too long. We usually have to scare them straight, like you're doing.
If you like writing poetry, I could help give some inspiration. We've seen a lot of surreal things as we've crossed the galaxy.
...Are you looking for any inspiration in your poems? I can't show you, but I've seen beautiful sights in space---and some bizarre ones.
If you're a loner among your friends, I guess that extends to relationships. I'm not always sure what I'd want in a partner in the first place.
...Do you know what you're looking for in a partner? It can be hard just to open up to your friends.
...You're not shy about your relationships, so I'll ask. Is there anything you wear that gets men's attention?
You're awfully proud of all the men you've dated. Is there a kind of---outfit they like, or something else...?
...Do you get much say in what you represent? I'm sure you don't want to associate with anything corrupt.
If you're sort of conscious, who's in control of your image? Can they force you to sing for any project that pays for you?
Is it true that men are always supposed to lead the relationship here? I don't like the idea of one telling me what to do, and it doesn't seem like you would, either.

state.text: Mejare would call you the "Oma" type---someone who can take care of themselves. But on Earth, that's always supposed to be men. Is that right?

case.state: You're really impressive---both your weapons and your skill. And you work totally alone, even as part of the "Federation"?
So---you pilot your own ship, and complete all these missions without any support? Even in your powered suits, that's incredible fighting skill.
Your old gang sounds like our crew---only stealing from the rich. For us, it's the military, so we don't make enemies with the public.
Those heists you used to pull on the wealthy are basically how we operate, just stealing imperial ships. It's made us popular with poor civilians who want to join.
...Do men like your body type? I can go on about excess body fat, but our prisoners don't seem to notice.
...I keep talking about fitness. Do you stay this way because men like it? I haven't noticed any stares from our prisoners.
...Have you ever lost someone close to you, Hu Tao? Or have you just buried others' loved ones?
I hope you're not so flippant when you bury someone's family. Do you even know how that feels?
It's clear you have respect for weapons and technology. I'm happy to discuss our Dreads with you if you could tell me more about your own equipment.
If you're speaking in lingo to guard your technology, I don't mind sharing the specs of our own weapons. That's a fair exchange.
Are you really too busy for relationships? I say the same sort of thing---but it's also just easier to avoid them.
...I could probably make time for dating if I really wanted to. I'm just not sure if it's for the best. You're the same way, aren't you?
Girls who like to read probably don't join pirates if they can help it. What do you find so fascinating about books and poems?
Most of my crewmates are interested in weapons or machines, or even aliens. Literature was never something I really understood the appeal of.
...With all the fighting you do, have you ever escalated things with a girl who wasn't looking for trouble? On the streets, I... made a habit of that.
I understand the urge to fight and prove yourself. But there were times I instigated it, and ended up really hurting someone. You know the feeling, don't you?
So, idols aren't supposed to date on this planet? Celebrities on Mejare always preached about how important it is to get married and have children.
On Mejare, it was sort of scandalous for an idol to be single for too long. Good girls settled down quick to raise a family for the empire. But for you, it's the opposite?
Placing a police officer on dangerous missions almost seems like a punishment. I've pictured that sort of thing as Mejare's conditions for reintegrating our crew.
Sometimes I wonder how I might ever live on Mejare again. Joining some special unit like yours might be the only way they excuse piracy.
What have you done with yourself since driving the "Pigmasks" off your islands? Is there a greater goal now?
What do you want for your islands now that they're in peacetime? Fighting is easier to understand, in a way.
...It's not easy to do this, is it? Not the stripping, but---showing weakness. Especially when you fight your whole life.
...When you live your life fighting, exposing yourself like this---it's more about the vulnerability than the nudity. Don't you think so?
Even with all that support, don't your breasts get in the way? Especially if you're trying to be stealthy.
It can't be easy dealing with those things when you're trying to fight. Excess body fat is just a nuisance.
Some of those crystals you steal are power sources, right? The "Chaos Emeralds"? You haven't given much specifics on what they do.
Those "Emeralds" seem like your most prized jewels of all. What's their "Chaos Energy" actually capable of?
From the sound of it, the best part of your travels was the hot springs. I spend a lot of time in our ship's jacuzzi.
If the Nowhere Islands have as many hot springs as you say, I would've liked to travel with you. Our jacuzzi always keeps me relaxed.
Even my suit's not as advanced, but we still dress pretty alike. Do you exercise a lot between missions?
I guess your suit's as ahead of mine as your armor. But having some gym clothes on underneath makes it feel on purpose. Do you train a lot, too?
...You're getting some work done, too? It might be easier on a bigger screen.
It looks like this isn't before Earth had personal planners. They must have started smaller...
You're..."Natasha Cerebellum." I could've sworn these notes said "Nina Cortex."
"Nina Cortex"...or, "Natasha Cerebellum"? Someone must have changed this intel.
Does your "dreamcatching" include visions? I've been dealing with flashbacks and telepathy ever since I fell into our fusion core.
Our ship's core has been giving me visions for almost a year now. If those count as dreams, you have plenty to work with.
Just like Earth, the alternative_opponents folder is lost to time.
Alt skins were once saved to alternative_opponents. I'm glad our reg system has never been that inefficient.
"Despite everything, it's still you." That sounds like something our captain would say.
This talking skeleton is just going to keep making a fool of himself. But "despite everything, it's still you"...our captain's said to think along those lines.
This sounds like the language Tarak thinks women speak. "If they listen, their ears will rot."
Is this what Tarak thinks women sound like? It's a good thing we shared a language.
I'm bad with words. I won't speak rhyme. There's better uses of my time.
All this rhyming must fill your head. I'd rather be inside a Dread.
I wish I came from the kind of show where we could survive space by wearing scuba gear.
I can't think of a worse place to wear a spacesuit than the bottom of the ocean. It's meant for zero pressure.
I don't know why, but you two remind me of our commander. Even though you couldn't be more different.
...Our vice-captain is stoic and focused. She never socializes. But for some reason, you two have the same aura.
...Ehm. I'm sorry, it's just---you act a lot like her, too. My Oma would go out and hold events, and my Fama'd sit at home, researching, keeping calm.
...You really do look like her. You've even got the same air about you---quiet, supporting someone close to you...I'm sorry, I should let this alone.
There's a magnetic storm separating Mejare from any nearby systems. Is Gensokyo's barrier the same kind of dangerous passage?
What's the "barrier" that blocks off your homeland from the rest of Earth? We only recently left Mejare's system because of a storm surrounding it.
Maybe it's better to ask if you've ever had a bad experience with a man. I'd like to know what to watch for.
If sleeping with men is no big deal, then all that matters are warning signs. Was one ever too rough with you, or...?
What are you doing in school if you make a living hunting monsters?
It seems like you're already accomplished as a huntress. But you're also attending... some kind of high school?
...This is all an act, isn't it? You can handle yourself just fine, here or in combat. Why play dumb?
You don't move like someone who doesn't know what she's doing. Even the way you look around is sharp. Are you trying to get us to drop our guards?
If you're embarrassed about your origins, I'm still coming to terms with how I have male ancestors.
It's bad enough what Earth's turned into, but then to learn men were my ancestors...you must know the feeling.
Are men really willing to throw away their lives just to please you? An imperial "princess"?
If I understand, men volunteer to entertain you, and risk their own lives for it. Is that because you're a noble?
Are there any phrases you've struggled to figure out? Sexually, I mean. I've had trouble just with what to call men's body parts.
The way people talk about sex, it must be hard to learn what they mean sometimes. I get that same feeling when I hear about men's bodies.
Earth has done everything it can in my time to come off as some monster that's conquered the galaxy. Seeing you makes me think we should just send them comic books.
In my time, Earth might as well be an inhuman cosmic terror. I don't suppose we could convince them to read comics instead.
I wouldn't put it past people to form a cult around their own destruction. That's what happened with you, right?
Do you really have a cult worshipping you here? It wouldn't be the first planet we've seen with something like that.

state.text: Everyone always told me I take after my Oma. I hope that doesn't extend to looking for a partner like my Fama.
I've never been attracted to girls like my Fama. But she used to say I'm like my Oma. That better not be some sort of complex.

case.state: Why have you been with so many "boys," anyway? Was something wrong with each one?
...Can you say more about all the "boys" you've been with? Why go through so many of them?
...Are you the leader of your huntress team? You seem like you're level-headed enough.
...Have the girls on your huntress team chosen a leader? If you're calm in this situation, you might do a good job.
You sound so invested in your friends' lives. Almost too much. Unless they really need help, I try to leave my pilots alone.
I keep to myself outside of running the Dread team. You know your friends better than I do, but it sounds like you can be nosy with them.
I didn't have any special reason for joining our crew. The captain just picked me up off the streets and said I had potential. What made you join Team Aqua?
Before I joined Magno's Family, the captain spoke to me personally. She said it'd give me a purpose in life. Is that what happened with you and Team Aqua?
At least for pirates, it takes some selfishness to climb the ranks. A desire to prove yourself. Maybe you help others so much, you're not advancing yourself.
I rose from new recruit to wing commander in a few months. Knights might be different, but I don't think you're not working hard enough. You might just be too selfless.
...When I'm alone, my mind wanders to questions like what my purpose is, or how I can prove I exist. It sounds like you think about the same things.
...It's easier to do squadron work or scouting than sit around and think. You know those feelings, don't you? "Why do I exist?" or "What's my fate meant to be?"
The way you---feed on men's semen. It's strange enough that it's meant to go in your vagina, but in your mouth...is that even safe for a human?
Men's---seed is your food, right? Are they surprised when you eat it? If it belongs in a girl's vagina...
What kind of weapons or ships do you use for your hunting work? It might help me get a sense of the time period.
I'm not sure how advanced this era is. What kind of technology do huntresses have?
...I can't imagine dealing with what happened to your resistance group. Magno's Family has never stooped to terrorism.
Your "White Fang"...our crew has been my only home for years now. I'm not sure what I'd do if I thought we were becoming terrorists.
...I don't want to pry, but I might learn a lot from you and the man you used to date. Do you mind talking about him?
Your---"ex-boyfriend." The man you dated. If it's not an issue, I'd like to hear more about your time with him.
I guess Earth's search for second-class citizens goes back further than Mejare. It treats space colonists a lot like "Faunuses."
In my time, Earth treats anyone not born there as less than human. Before us, it must have been "Faunus" people.
...It's hard, isn't it? Staying cool, but knowing when to let go. I'd actually like someone else to lead in bed...if I trusted them.
Keeping calm and taking charge is good for a battle, but...it's not what I want to do with a partner. Maybe you can relate.
...So, your race has a connection to people's emotions? Earth is supposed to have a Paksis of its own.
Earth's Paksis might have some deep roots in the culture here, if there's whole races who can sense emotional auras.
"You can't just let your emotions control you." That's what I tell pilots, after I learned it myself. And it's what you do to people, isn't it?
The way you exploit people's feelings---that's what I always hated about myself. Getting carried away and making reckless mistakes.
...I wonder if I would've slept around if I went to an academy. I'd just started high school when things fell apart.
I was already on the streets by the age schoolgirls start dating. I'm not sure if I would've been like you if I ended up in an officer's school.
Our crew is in deep space right now because of a wormhole. Have spontaneous portals ever been a problem for you, too?
Our last mission ended up creating a wormhole and throwing us across the galaxy. Have you ever run into that sort of accident?
It took a common enemy for us to accept men. You were similar, right? Loners who joined against something greater?
I never thought men would be anything but enemies, but we ended up joining forces. You and the "Fifth Crusade" sound like that.
As far as I know, a succubus is how the men on Tarak see all women---monsters who paralyze and eat them.
Our prisoners were convinced women "eat their guts" when we brought them onboard. Maybe that came from succubi.
Our crew actually found a colony that's a lot like your vision for Earth. It was 99% water with only one island city.
Your goal of raising the sea level might make Earth look like the colony Anpathos. The whole planet was one citadel built on an ocean.
...It's a little hard to understand you. Is this just how most Earthlings used to sound?
...I'm not used to hearing strong accents. This isn't so far back that the language is all different here, is it?
Come to think of it, it's lucky we could even speak to the men, or other colonists. We all sound pretty similar.
Looking back, communication's hardly been an issue for our crew. Even the men speak with the same dialect.
Is there no chance of a girl marrying you? Do you get any female challengers?
Has it only been men challenging your dungeon? Or would you marry a girl if she cleared it?
Do you think you might settle down with someone from your school? Male or female.
Have you thought about dating someone long-term? You've surely met a lot of classmates.
I didn't go to school long enough for there to be politics. Did you climb up to Student Council President on purpose?
Some of the older girls say our Dread team can feel like the Student Council. I wouldn't know. Did you just fall into that position?
...I wouldn't be able to tell you were born male. Is that what you use alchemy for, to change your body parts?
...So I understand, you used to be a man, and you built this body yourself? That's what alchemy is?
You're wanted for being able to read some ancient language, aren't you? Breaking men's code makes you an elite agent where I'm from.
Knowing men's language is the mark of the elite on Mejare. Why is your government after you for reading glyphs?
I don't know how you can stand lugging that weight around. I feel bloated if I overtrain and then overeat. And that's just a few hours.
Sometimes, after a hard workout, I eat too much and get a potbelly until I digest it. Even that feels gross.
Is there really a "Pokémon" you're after that can terraform a planet all by itself?
I thought you were trying to terraform the oceans using some energy core or a machine. But your plan is just capturing some animal?
You're awfully sure no one will ever finish your dungeon. Do you really plan to go through with marrying them?
...Do you have a plan in case someone actually completes your challenge? You clearly don't want them to.
...Do men approach you a lot? If they like big breasts the way Mejare does, there's no denying yours.
Busty women like you are Mejare's biggest beauty symbol. Do you get a lot of attention from men the same way?
Maybe leadership is different for a princess, but I always avoid being dramatic. I don't want the Dread team to panic.
When I lead my squadron, I try to keep everyone calm and focused. I don't know if leading a country takes more flair.
Have you had any experience with men? It sounds like you just watch them, even here.
...Marriage is one thing, but have you ever been close with a man? This isn't much different from hanging around brothels.
You don't seem like you're having trouble locating us. That's part of your "bending," right?
...There's some way for your bending to help you "see," isn't there? Enough to tell where we're all standing.
I heard Earth's Paksis feeds off people's bad emotions. So your job is to keep it under control and purify them?
...How long has Earth been using that red Paksis? It warps people's feelings, so there's forces that come in to set them right?
You're busy all throughout the day, right? You haven't said anything about other workers.
Your work schedule sounds busy. You must be if you're trying to run your government all by yourself.
It makes sense you perform as an idol. People love whatever they endorse, even on Mejare.
Idols' performances drum up a lot of public support. Mejare uses them the same way you do.
I like sparring, but I've never studied a martial art. What drew you to "kung-fu"?
You study martial arts, right? "Kung-fu." I'd like to know more about it.
It sounds like you go through steaks a lot. I usually order fish because it's leaner.
I guess you eat red meat to bulk up? It's got a lot of fat. Most of my protein is fish.
...Even in this time, Earth is sending robots after our bodies. Is that all you do? Sex work?
I've had enough of Earth's machines wanting a piece of my body. Is that your whole purpose?
...Where you come from, Earth is covered by machinery, and humans are nearly extinct?
...I don't want to misunderstand. Your "Earth" has more machines left on it than people?
...You know this girl, ~player~? You should stand up for yourself before it gets worse.
...This girl's teasing doesn't seem friendly, ~player~. Maybe you two should step outside the game.
What kind of weaponry does your ship have? You must have to defend yourself from attack fleets.
Other crews must attack you on occasion. What do your ship's defense systems look like?
I don't know a lot about ships in this era. Is there space to relax, or to bathe?
Sailing ships seem---cramped. Is there much living space on yours? I mean, places to train, or relax, or shower.
How easy is it to work with your teammates? It can be hard getting everyone to cooperate, even on a small team.
It sounds like you're the leader of your traveling party. Does it take a lot to coordinate everyone?
How has Earth mastered robotics so well? Mejare has nothing like you---not like a human, let alone a whore.
Earth's robotics are so advanced that they've turned them into prostitutes. It's---hard to believe.
You look really well-built. I train a lot myself, but I'd never stand up to some of our security guards.
Our security guards are built big and sturdy like you. Even if I tried to bulk up, I'd still be undersized next to them.
...D-does pointing out your "crusader" act ruin this for you, or just make you more humiliated?
Uh...all this "purity" talk is just a charade. Would you prefer I didn't say that, or were you waiting for someone to point it out?
...I think I fought a girl like you once, on the street. She kept asking me to hit her, and she wasn't really fighting back.
I might've been in a streetfight with your type once. It took me way too long to realize she just wanted the abuse.
What's your role in your traveling party? It can't just be to humiliate yourself.
I can't picture a traveling party putting up with your abuse-fetish. This must be your chance to express it.
Our crew has learned that even something like a crystal can have a consciousness. It's not surprising you've got a psychic link with the animals you raise.
You must train your animals by sensing how they feel. It's not so far-fetched since we discovered our ship's core has feelings of its own.
I have a hard time sleeping unless I've done everything I can. That includes tiring myself out. But it sounds like you do the opposite.
I can end up lying awake in bed if I haven't trained hard enough to be tired. Using sleep to control your strength sounds strange.
A power like yours seems like it would draw stares. Is that what you wanted when you came here?
...I guess you don't mind getting attention for your power. You're showing it as much as your body.
...Can you speak for your crew? I serve as Chief Pilot. Absent any higher officers, I represent "Magno's Family."
I'm an officer on our crew---Wing Commander, and Chief Pilot. Are you qualified to speak for the Straw Hats?
...There's a refugee girl our crew took in. She grew a habit of bullying other girls and teasing one of the men aboard.
The girl we rescued from an escape pod got pushy with some of the crew members around her age. Including the ones she liked.
...Miss Samus. Are you alone even in your off time?
Fighting alone is one thing, but...is there someone you fight for? A friend, or a partner...?
...So. Are you seen more as a human or as a machine by the people who pay for you?
I should've been more respectful before. Do your customers treat you like a person?
...It sounds like it's mostly men who buy your services.
...Do you not get many female customers? You keep talking about men and their "cells."
What kind of combat training have you gone through? I'd like to know how your powers factor into techniques.
I should ask before your armor's gone---how have you been trained to fight? How do you use your light magic?
...I'm sorry if this is nosy, but you're not just an ordinary girl, are you? It's in your eyes.
...You don't have a civilian girl's look in your eyes. If it's not prying---did something happen to you?
We've had to deal with death cults of our own. Entire colonies have been run by them for a ritual suicide.
Our crew's had its own run-ins with cults. Luckily, they wanted to kill themselves more than us.
You're a swimmer, aren't you? Sports are a good outlet for stress. I should've used it more.
I should've done more sports in school. Swimming like you would've gotten out some of my energy.
You should think about building some muscle. It's not just good for combat---it'd make your figure look even fuller.
...Have you thought about bulking up? Your bust and hips are big, but you're kind of skinny for a fighter.
Using AI and voice samples to make an idol program...that's probably better than Mejare. Idols can be as young as six there.
Mejare loves idol performances, but it barely has any robots or AI. Sometimes young girls even get funneled into doing it.
...We're very different. I couldn't stand sleeping all day or writing poems. I'd feel trapped in my bedroom.
...I couldn't live the way you do. I'd get restless trying to write...naps would feel like a waste of time.
...Mitama. What makes you think fate is so unchanging?
You've said some things about destiny and fated paths. Why do you see that as so set in stone?
Our captain used to be a priestess, so our crew has a reputation back home for being a cult, too. We're called her "Family."
If you went to Mejare, you'd probably hear about Magno's Family being a cult. She was a priestess before founding us, so we're sort of her "flock."
...So your issue was survival. Have you had any combat training? Do you know how to handle weapons?
How did you manage those monsters? Do you have any experience fighting or using weapons?
I compared you to that refugee girl before, but maybe you're more like the man she was chasing. He hates being taken lightly for how small he is.
The man that girl was teasing is undersized. He has a big mouth to make up for it. You share some things with him.
...You remind me of a lot of people. I'll end by saying that keeping your guard up isn't easy, or rewarding.
...Before you're out completely, I'll just say: pushing others away doesn't make you stronger.
What's the purpose of your employer? It sounds like they hold a lot of sway here on Earth.
Does your "Lobotomy Corporation" control much of this planet? Or does it have some other goal? You make it sound powerful.
You've been scanning your environment. Is there something we should know about this place? Or you?
You're "Kyoko Kirigiri," aren't you? Is something wrong? You've been looking us over--- and everything around us.
What does your combat experience look like? You've mentioned hunting "monsters," but not how.
How do you do all your "hunting" and "quests"? Do you have combat training or special equipment?
...I wasn't trying to complain about performing earlier. Singing onstage wasn't the part I regret.
...I did sound morose about my idol work before. But doing those shows was never the problem. I liked being in the spotlight.
No one's troubling you anymore, right? What have you been doing since?
It sounds like you're not in danger anymore, at least. Have you found a better situation?
I don't know much about comics, but you remind me of my apprentice pilot. She's got a reputation as a "UFO Maniac."
You're a lot like our trainee. She's not into comics, but she's full of energy, and she collects all sorts of "UFO" and "alien" things.
You have rivals, don't you? "Team Magma"? Which one of you has an advantage?
Dealing with that rival gang must ruin a lot of your plans. Are they in a better position?
...You've been playing coy, but I'd appreciate any real advice. About---men.
...I really am serious. What should I ought to know before I get close to a man?
Are you feeling alright? Now that you've lost some more---it's like you still have hangups.
...You seem a little anxious about sex. More than I'd expect from an Earth girl. Is that wrong?
...I should ask you personally before the game goes any further. Our Dread team could use a girl like you---someone who didn't choose to fight, but is good at it.
...Smart, resourceful, and experienced is all we could ask of a pilot. And we're shorthanded. I wanted to tell you that before things got any heavier.
I heard you're a trained fighter, but what exactly are you fighting? Are you part of some standing army?
...What's the purpose of your Keyblade training? I don't know much about this planet's politics.
...The time's come. I get tense just waiting around for action. Maybe you're more relaxed now, too.
...I don't know if you're feeling any better, but facing the moment like this usually puts me at ease.
What kinds of projects do you usually work on for your ship? It can't be easy without a full team.
You do a lot of your engineering work by yourself, right? What are you building most of the time?
Oh, you have a crew of your own. Are you from this planet, or did you also land in from another colony?
...Are you an Earth pirate? Our crew is from Mejare, one of its colonies. Maybe you're visiting from one, too.
Do you run your farm by yourself? On Mejare, all the cattle are in government facilities.
On my homeworld, all the farmers work for the state. There's not enough space or resources to do it alone.
You don't need to perform tricks for us. Stripping nude should be enough of a show on its own.
...Showing our bodies ought to hold everyone's attention. You can save your magic tricks.
...If you're some kind of Earth idol, I can see where its attitudes about good and evil began. That, and its organ issues.
...Missing body parts, and quick to judgment. That sums up my impression of Earthlings.
I-is this---a girl mixed with plants' DNA? I think I read once that they were resistant to damage...but are Earthlings really this desperate to survive?
W-what---are you? You can't be human. Unless Earth was trying to preserve themselves with plant genes at some point...!
If you can write poetry in the middle of this game, there's no excuse for me not to get more work done...
...Surely I can finish this schedule between rounds if this girl can compose lyrics.
...If you want inspiration, space is very beautiful. Not just stars and planets, but comets and gas clouds...
This planet is beautiful, but so are the stars. There's a lot to write about if you watch the skies.
Your "father"...he wants you to be an archer, right? A fighter.
...If I understand, you were raised to be a soldier---on your parents' wishes.
...You'd like to know more about men yourself, right? Even if you know other girls pretty well. We're both here for that.
If you've been with a girl, but not with a man, that's something we have in common.
