{pyoro}Hey, security alert! Meia, take extra precautions around this lady!{!reset}
What's up?
{pyoro}She's---dead!
I'd assumed your colony was meant as a settlement. But the research you've mentioned could be its actual purpose...
Was Mars colonized to live on? I'd assumed it was like Mejare. But if the people are mostly scientists...
Did you previously have more of a field position? And now, as acting leader, it's more of a command...
If I had to be Acting Captain...I wouldn't be able to fight anymore. Is that what's happened to you?
We hear your status has come with combat training---and actual combat.
...You're not an idle ruler, are you? You've fought battles personally.
I'd like you to share what you know about Earth's politics in this era. With your profession, I figure it's a lot.
A political journalist may be as good as we could hope for. Can you tell us about the Earth of this time?
I agree with you about the supernatural. Reality doesn't stop at our ability to explain it. Our own crew can attest to that.

Our crew has encountered a lot that we can't explain. But that doesn't mean there's no explanation.
...Wouldn't you agree?
Do you ever accept any help on your farm?
...So, even with the others nearby, you always do your work alone. Right?
There must be more disease in this time. You can't control your environment...
I remember learning how planets' surfaces aren't as sterile. In this era especially, you could catch any number of things...
...You work for Earth's government, correct?
Government employees must number in the millions to manage this whole planet...
We weren't sure that people had made it off-surface in this time. But supposedly your parents were astronauts, and you lived on a station...
...So, this era has manned space stations. In orbit, at least. We hear your family was involved in one...
If your curse poses a threat to us, then you should keep that mask on all game.
Did you really come here knowing you might lose control and hurt someone? Unless it's as simple as leaving your mask on...
You probably figure all religion to be nonsense, too...
Any kind of worship must fall under superstition for you, as well...
There are a lot of luxuries on Mejare, but camping isn't one of them...
Camping's not the kind of hobby you could have back home...

"Pokémon training" is like an animal tamer?
...It must be prestigious.
..."Pokémon training" must be very respected here.
...Can you tell us about that place you've traveled through? "Kalos," and all the nature in it...
"Kalos" isn't an Earth region we've heard of. But if you've hiked through much of it, I'd like to know...
If you could share some of your experiences...Earth has a lot of land to learn about.
Whatever you've seen of the outdoors, we'd learn a lot about Earth from it...
Earth is supposed to have a lot of wildlife. I figure half your job is choosing what to train...
Out of all the creatures on Earth, how do you select what's worthy of training?
...For a monster, you've seemed composed. What would change that?
We should be wary of you... shouldn't we? Is there a "trigger"?
What sorts of places are your "digsites"? It sounds like they're---all sorts.
...You have an interesting job, digging into the planet. And these sites could be anywhere on it?
It's frustrating trying to lead a team, even with their respect. I'm sure you understand...
Even if the others value your leadership, the balancing act is a pain...
Do you see yourself as "different" from Earth people? In some way that'll never change...
Now that we're down to it...do you think you're truly "Martian"? A new, separate kind of human...
At these campsites...I hope you're doing what you can to keep Earth's environment clean.
If camping is popular here, hopefully people treat nature with respect.
..."The smaller the dog, the louder it barks."
I'm no Trainer...but I know animals make noise to look confident.
...Do you consider yourself a "person"? That you have feelings?

Do you feel you have a heart?
...Do you "feel" anything?
What sorts of Pokémon do you train? How do you tell what can put on a "performance"?
You must be able to see Pokémon's potential. Maybe some species are better suited for what you do...
Your true form...you're supposed to be one of those "penguin" birds?
If our intel's correct...this is some modification to you. And you're really a "penguin" bird...
...Your trance has worn off, then?
...You seem back to normal. Should we still watch what we say?
I'm sure you have a lot of fans as a public figure...
Hero work gives you a lot of admirers, right? A lot of exposure...

...With all your training, have girls gotten crushes on you?
...Or men, I guess.
Trying to stay cool, and trying to stay fit...can definitely win you admirers. I don't know if that's happened to you...

How do you feel about your face being out there?
...In the media.
Once your face is on camera, it's not yours anymore. Does that bother you...?
Your "hero" work...are you Earth's most celebrated people?
Are "heroes" like you at the top of Earth's society?
You've been training your whole life, right? You've even gone to school for your powers...
It sounds like your life and your training have never been separate. Even with family or school...
Is there someplace you really want to camp in?
Beyond your own experiences...where would you want to visit?

Would you say there's any overlap between leading people and leading Pokémon?
...In other words, between you and me.
Would you say you're anything like a field commander? We each have teams of our own, after all...
...Our intel says you were once "High Prosecutor." Can you say more about that? Especially..."of Hell."
...Your former title is listed as "High Prosecutor." "Of Hell." We hope you can provide some context.
Our records of Earth's history are poor. We'd need more context to understand the claims you're making---about "Japan," and ancient times.
We don't know a lot of details about Earth's history. It would help if you explained more about the part you ruled, and how long ago that was.
...As I understand it, even though you're female, you allowed your subjects to believe you were male. Is that right?
People thought you were a man when you were in power... and you allowed them to. Is that accurate?
I hope this has made you more comfortable with yourself. Maybe it's even strengthened your Quirk.
Even a normal fighter has to understand her body. You might leave here more confident and more powerful.

Would you say you were born to fight?
...Made to fight.
...You weren't born, but made. And your powers are meant for fighting...
One of our prisoners is like you. A good talker, but a bad liar.
You've been social all game, but it's easy to tell when you're lying. We have a man aboard who's the same way.

Your homeland---with its own history and myths.
...It seems remote.
It doesn't sound like there's many people where you live. You even have your own mythology, right?
Pyoro, I'd like you to run a scan on this woman. She claims to be over 1400 years old.<hr>{pyoro}That's not feasible even with cryogenics...

Pyoro, check this woman's biometrics. For age...1400.
{pyoro}Gimme a break. Humans wish they could live that long...
When we got intel that an explosive magic user would be here...I pictured someone taller.
...You're the user of "Explosion Magic"? Maybe it was foolish... but I thought you'd be bigger.
...It doesn't take a curse...to feel like you might lose control.
Fearing that some ugly part of yourself might hurt someone... you're not alone in that.

{pyoro}W-warning! Unknown readings, 12 o' clock! Unknown!{!reset}
Pyoro...check your history banks for anything under "Club Penguin."

{pyoro}G-ggh...e-error. What the heck is up with that girl's biometrics?{!reset}
...Pyoro, can you scan your records for any history of a "Club Penguin"?
Is it true you spread one religion among your people, but practice another?
We hear that, under your rule, there was a religion for your subjects---and a different one for you.
...Would you say you have any weakness? Something another witch does better...
...Do you outshine the other witches in everything?
When even burgers and fries are being sold by a back-talking model...that feels very Mejarian.
Back home, a girl with sass and sex appeal is used to market anything. Even a fast-food joint...
...A "fisher." That's something you wouldn't see back home... not unless the farms count.
All the fish are farmed on Mejare. What you do...it's something only the Earth could provide.
Is New Amsterdam like a lot of other cities on Earth? Full of rival gangs...
When you say there are gangs everywhere...is that just "New Amsterdam," or all over Earth?
Your race...you live totally within nature? Within a forest...
When you say your people are "children of the forest"...you really live your whole lives there?
Did you reign during peacetime? Here and there, you've mentioned your military...
You've mentioned your command at times, but not whether you were actually at war back then.
...Miss Tojiko. What is it that makes your relationship strong? Strong enough to last all this time...
Miss Tojiko...why do you think you two have stayed together for over a thousand years?
So...do Earth people see this as getting in touch with nature?
I don't suppose people here see this as more natural.
Any one of us was likely to be pushed this far. I don't know why you thought you wouldn't.
You came in awfully confident that you'd win a game of luck.
...There's a lot of information floating around about you. Your world, your species, and your past behavior...
According to rumor, you're a lot more than just a girl with strange looks. Or rather... you've done a lot more.

{pyoro}Are conditions stable, Meia? Oh, it's that girl...{!reset}
...Rosie, you mentioned a robot modeled like Pyoro?

{pyoro}Making rounds! Whose turn is it?
...That girl said something about her robot.{!reset}
A "KL" model?
...I ran with a gang for a while, too. Back on Mejare.
Magno's Family is no street gang...but I did used to be part of one, a few years ago.
Is it true that each of the Kokiri has a fairy like yours?<hr>{pyoro}I can detect faint communication between them...
{pyoro}Another loss recorded for Saria. She isn't alone, either...{!reset}<hr>No Kokiri is, apparently...
..."Witch." Are you not comfortable giving us your name?
...We're meant to be friendly with each other here. You don't need to call yourself "Witch," at least.
There's a war involving your whole country, right? Not just the Kokiri...
From the sound of things, your "Hyrule's" been consumed by war...
...What do you enjoy most about your home?
In times of peace...what part of your woods is most important to you?
...You're not just a girl, right? You're older than you appear.
You look like a young girl...but that's not the truth, right? It's just how you age...
...You really understand all there is to know? Anything that might happen, and all the roles we might play?
Your Tao...so you're prepared for any situation? There's nothing beyond your understanding.
...You're an AI entertainer? Meant to act just like a person...
...It's our understanding that you respond like a person would. An AI built made to entertain guests...
So that---spirit is under your control? It doesn't seem like it...
That---"Haunter" is just doing whatever it wants. You need to keep it under control...
...Do you consider yourself blessed? To talk with ghosts the way you do...
Your spiritual connection...is that something you were born with?
What subject do you plan on teaching? Something environmental?
Apparently you're training as a teacher...a teacher of what?
...We've heard that Earth princesses used to be modest. You're very forward with what you want...
...From what we knew of Earth, a princess in those times was reserved. Modest. You're neither of those things...
...You're confident in your body? Your immortal body. I assume this is the form you chose...
I don't know much about your Taoist rituals...but you're satisfied with your immortal body. Right?
How many..."Yordles" live on this planet? We only knew about humans...
Is your species...common here? "Yordles" living alongside humans...?
Your...species. You are a different species, right? It wasn't experiments that gave you your skin, or horns...or arm.
...We came to Earth expecting humans. But you're an---"Inphernal," right? Not some experiment...adding and replacing parts.
To think even demons have schools and hierarchies...
It's hard to imagine demons bothering with something like school...or student councils. Why organize at all?
What were you reading that was so engrossing?
It took a lot for you to put that book down. But you didn't even say what it was...
A schoolteacher with knowledge of ancient ruins...that's our intel on you. If it's true, you could teach us a lot about Earth's history...
Can you share what you know about Earth? Its ruins, and its history. I assume that's what you teach...
...So, the free time you have...you use it to garden, right?
...Is it true you're a gardener? If only in your spare time...
I-if you're really undead...how long has that been the case?
...What's your true age? How long have you---stopped aging?

{pyoro}Meia...do you think I have a soul?{!reset}
The way we think of them, Pyoro. Though apparently...they're tied to where we're born.

{pyoro}Could it really be that only Earth humans have souls, Meia?{!reset}
As far as we can tell, Pyoro, you have one... but not every culture agrees.
...Is it true? That to you, this is all just some simulation? And that's the reason for all these distortions...
Your explanation for this place's anomalies...is that the whole thing isn't real. That we're in some kind of program. Is that right?
A world full of nature...that's the dream many have for Mejare.
The Mejare's biggest challenge has been to make our home a world of greens...
Also in the intel about your region...was a "Team Flare." And that, with your Pokémon, you fought them off...but their goals weren't clear to us.
Can you tell us about the "Team Flare" that had a presence in Kalos? We heard that you and your Pokémon fought them personally...but not what they were after.
From your divine perspective...what advice would you have for the terraforming process?
...We're only human. Not so attuned to nature. What advice would give us---if we were trying to terraform?
It's possible we're not of this world, either. We came through a portal of our own---we thought it was a time warp, but maybe there was more to it.
Our ship's core, the Paksis---it brought us here. It's opened portals through space, and we thought this one was through time. Maybe, like yours, it was through dimensions.
You lead a fighting squad of your own, don't you? Among your other pursuits...
You lead a busy life, from what it seems...is it true heading some combat team is one part of it?
...Vivosaur battles sound like they can be grand-scale. Where exactly do you hold them?
...Is there a venue for Vivosaur battles? From the sound of things, they aren't always easy to contain.
When you say you died and were reborn a Sage...was that some kind of ritual? Or just a way of treating the "incident"...

The incident that made you a Sage...you speak as you died.
...Is that some kind of metaphor?
Earth does seem more conservative than Mejare...in clothes and in attitude. Even if they come from temperate forests...
Even Earthlings from temperate climates seem to cover up more than we do... and be less eager to strip down.
...Do you have your share of loyal customers? People living in the village nearby...
Selling in a small village...there must be repeat customers. People you get to know.

S-some---robot? Those teeth could hurt someone...!
{pyoro}Danger! Hostile subroutines and poor materials! Danger to itself and others!

{pyoro}G-ggh...l-low structural integrity...but high aggression! This unit could cause harm!{!reset}
We can tell even withoutanalysis...!
...Do you have friends in the occult? Anyone to turn to, or to help...besides the ghosts themselves.
If the ghosts you talk to are your only company in doing so...that's a lonely experience.
How is it you make a living? Is that related to your hobby, too?
Is your interest just a hobby? Or do you offer some kind of service to people?
So the reason you came here...is just to make friends?
Are you really just here for friendship? Most people's reasons for coming...well, they'd be dirtier.
...It's strange to watch you, so desperate for companions. I spent so long pushing everyone away...
It's hard to watch a girl seem so lonely...when I did everything I could to be alone...
Your clothes wouldn't be out of place back home. But you don't really seem to want to the attention they bring...
On Mejare, girls dress for attention. To show off our bodies. That doesn't seem your style...and yet you're wearing it.
...Can you handle yourself here? You seem nervous and confused about this whole game.
...You understand the rules here? You're comfortable? If you're not willing to play, then don't be a nuisance.
{pyoro}Warning! I detect a high voltage inside Fischl's "Oz." It is possible he can deliver electric shocks!
{pyoro}Caution! Fischl's "Oz" gives readings similar to a high-voltage capacitor. Be wary of contact, or of any sparks!
Why is it...that you play such a character?
Why do you show...only what you wish to be? Even in a game like this...
So clothes, for your people, are purely self-expression... and not for any modesty. Right...?
The "Penguin World" is nudist...but you still accessorize. Is that right? In order to express yourselves...
We were advised before landing on this planet to receive shots. If the era's correct, you should know about vaccines, too...
This is well after vaccines were first developed, isn't it? We needed some just to come down here.
Our homeworld is known for its beauty, but also its technology---especially medical. Even our enemies have praised it.
Mejare is the planet of women...of beauty. But what's impressed even Tarak is our technology, and how we use it for medicine.
The mental can affect the physical. The way you're so nervous...it can rub off on patients. It's the same for any kind of leader.
Confidence inspires others. It's something leaders learn, to keep their teams at ease. The same is true of doctors and their patients.
What is it about camping? Is it just nature's beauty, or also the challenge of surviving?
People do like overcoming challenges they set for themselves. Does going outdoors count as one for you?
It seems you view food as pleasure, even out in the wilderness...where it's more a necessity.
Even outside where food is scarce, you seem to take pleasure in what you eat...
You seem to have a grudge...against your "father." Your male parent.

state.text:
Your "father"...is like a male Oma, right?
...Are things difficult...between you and him?

case.state:
{pyoro}Meia, that girl over there...{!reset}
What is it?
{pyoro}Biometrics indicate some degree of malnourishment...

{pyoro}Malnutrition, Meia...{!reset}
What? I ate earlier today.
{pyoro}Not you. That Earthling girl...
...Are you here in any official capacity? For your "academy," "monastery," or "empire"?
A princess...a student...and an officer...from a church. Are you here as any of those things?

Your church's faith seems rather strict.
...Does that butt up against your own pride?

You don't like being told what to think, do you?
...Even if it's your church doing it.
It sounds a bit too good to be true to come here and play a poker game...with Earth's secret overlord.

You run the organization...that runs the Earth itself.
...If that's true, we really know how to pick poker games.
...Is it true you're much older than you appear? You don't carry yourself like a younger girl...
Your true age...it isn't so young, is it? You hardly seem to be keeping it secret...
...What is the nature of these "rifts" throughout your kingdom? Where do they lead, and who has come through them?
...So space and time are unstable in your "kingdom," as well...do you understand much about the "rifts," and to where and whom they connect?
...Our limited intel said you were "time-displaced." About a hundred years from when you were born...
As we understand it...you were born far earlier than this present time. A century, give or take...
...That the ruling class of Earth consists of vampires who prey on the living is...unsurprising.
If you thought telling us Earth is ruled by undead, who rely on stolen life, would surprise us...it really doesn't.
...How long have you been a star in Fontaine? I mean...from what age?
Is your celebrity status back in Fontaine...something you reached in adulthood?
Using microwaves in combat sounds good for stealth...but grisly for your enemy.
...Your microwaves may be undetectable, but I picture burns and blisters on the target---or worse.
...I don't suppose you have a whole performance planned for us. It is built right into the game.
Don't feel like you have to be our entertainment...moreso than the game expects.
Paiway was proud enough to show me her drawing of when I had severe brain trauma.
...I, too, have been crudely drawn after suffering accidents.
I must ask why a maid has a supply of large knives on hand... and seems quite skilled at handling them.
...I wouldn't think housework requires a set of knives on your person. Nor that it'd require the skill you seem to have with them...

{pyoro}Pyoro~! Are you playing against a robot, Meia?{!reset}
She seems to oversee program routines in a larger system.
{pyoro}Wow, memories...

{pyoro}Pyoro~! What is across from you? A program operator AI?{!reset}
Plugged into a larger mainframe.
{pyoro}Ah, like I was...
Are you truly committed to your housework? If you'd ever consider battle, you wouldn't be our first recruit that shows promise through her clumsiness...
...You remind me a lot of our trainee. She's not all that fierce or confident, but given the right guidance, she has potential...even if she's more interested in dusting.
At first a leader, and reduced to singing...somehow we're opposites in that way.
...I used to be a singer, and when that was no longer possible, I found myself keeping order. I've gathered you're the exact opposite.
Your heart doesn't seem to be in this..."Marianne."
...Is something bothering you? "Marianne."
If you consider yourself a burden to others...then I do wonder what made you decide to come here.
You seem to have a bigger problem with your presence here than any of us do. With that in mind...what brought you here?
T-to think---Earthlings would fuse themselves with fungi. Anything to survive, at the expense of humanity...
M-mushrooms, of all things...I don't know how their DNA would even help humans survive. We should be glad the results aren't worse...

{pyoro}Scanning...scanning...no security risks detected. Unit appears harmless!{!reset}
That seems too good to be true...

Pyoro, run a diagnostic on this robot.
{pyoro}Roger!
...All scans negative! AI routines fully benign.{!reset}
...Are you sure?
Assuming that style exists anywhere, it's too conspicuous. This coloration blends into machinery.
She can be as bubbly as she wants. I doubt she has the responsibilities you or I carry.
She looks young, Jura...and in a better position. She can afford to be happy, so let her.
Wherever she comes from, I'm sure that pattern is optimal. She must wear it for a reason.
That's quite the outfit. I thought my suit was revealing.
If that suit is meant to be a disguise, this "France" planet must be taxing on the eyes.
Hm? Someone else with blue hair...
You're from planet "France"? Well...it's certainly got an aroma.
Did you slip into your native language before? That's a little cute.
Despite our differences, humans throughout the galaxy did agree on a language...
Was that a taste of what they speak on planet France?
...Are you flustered, ~player~?
This is such bare-bones poker...
...Do you know what you're doing?
...What do you want us to say?
I don't have as much to learn from you...so I hope this game is competitive.
...It's luck.
If I understand the rules, we're all bound to end up the same...
...Someone's luck is someone else's loss...
Pull yourself together, ~player~.
If you don't mind being on the backfoot, join our crew...
...Try changing tactics.
Pride in your body will have to make up for pride in your skill.
...Don't throw the game.
Bad situations breed.
When the enemy is weaker, you press harder.
...You're still a woman, ~player~.
...Are you taking this seriously, ~player~? It can be hard to tell with you.
You don't quite seem like pilot material...
...~player~, is this just going to keep happening?
I'm too used to my officer's duties. I feel the need to chastise you into playing better...
I wouldn't accept a girl under my command playing so poorly, you know.
My Vandread relies on ramming speed, you know...tearing through opponents in a hurry.
...~player~ lost again? I'm busy.
Even I feel the need to speak in my defense sometimes...
...Make sure we aren't cheating, ~player~.
I wouldn't put it past this place to rig the game.
If you don't feel like you can win, tell us all you know ahead of time.
I demand the very best from my pilots, ~player~...and also from my opponents.
~player~ once again...
Again...are you feeling alright, ~player~?
~player~'s losing so much at once...
It's easy to forget how bad you're doing when another girl is under fire.
...Is something wrong, ~player~?
A few rounds can really transform your look...
If I can handle this, you can handle losing.
...Don't second-guess yourself because of bad luck, ~player~.
Any girl can shoot down an enemy---or watch her strip. It's how she handles defeat that matters.
...You're not still looking to me for advice?
I could've kept working if ~player~'s just going to fold like this...
Maybe you'd make a better pilot than poker player.
I won't complain about gaining ground.
If you were Mejarian...
...Play as best as you can. That's an order.
...As you might imagine, I'm not interested in trading rounds with you at the moment.
Don't give your enemy a moment.
Again...
...See an opening, then pound away.
I hope you're taking this seriously, ~player~.
...It's a bit late for me to give you any advice, don't you think?
...Didn't this planet invent poker?
...I try not to let anything faze me, but losing like this always gets me fed up. Maybe you're the same way.
Stuck naked, nothing feels like enough...

...Would men cheer for you losing so much?
...It's not just them.
...Do you want advice, ~player~? I'm not doing so well myself.
It's my job to keep girls calm when we're under fire. I'm not sure I should extend that to my opponent.
This is Meia. Despite some setbacks, situation is improving.
Don't make excuses, ~player~.
...Ngh. I don't want to cheer for some other girl's clothes falling off. N-not unless I'm winning.
I-I'd say take your loss with---dignity, but they aren't having that, huh...?
...Hagh. ~player~ again...?
...I've got time to look at you more closely now. You really are pretty, ~player~...so do your best to win.
...Don't look to the girl who lost for advice, ~player~.
...~player.toStutter(1)~, do you want to end up like me...?

Hah...
D-do you feel like you could've saved that round? Or...is it fate that we might end up together like this?
M-maybe I should stop and watch the crash.
Haaanh...hoooo.
You can do it, ~player~. You certainly don't need my advice.
If you prefer skill over luck, our team is looking for new pilots.
Do you feel like you made the best play you could have?
This might be the point in the game where you have to take risks.
I hope you don't take losing as hard as I do.
Men put on a brave face when they've got no options left. Most girls don't mind showing weakness.
This game might be mostly luck, but don't give up because of that.
...Get adventurous once you're out.

...~player~, have you seen my stylus?
...Never mind. It's your turn again.
It's a pleasure to meet you. You are? ..."Sherry." That's actually my Fama's name...or was.
...Your name is "Sherry," isn't it? That was my Fama's name. It's a pleasure...
"Sherry"...that was my Fama's name. It's nice to meet you.
Hello..."Valore"? That's the same name as one of my fellow officers---a dark-skinned girl with red hair. It's a pleasure.
"Valore"...you're not the first girl I've met with that name. It's the same as one of our wing commanders---I've spent a lot of planning time with her, since we share a rank.
...Your name is "Valore"? It's nice to meet you---you have the same name as a colleague of mine. We share a rank...I should get to know her better.

state.text: You look good in our flightsuit, ~player~. Are you sure you don't want to join the team?
Don't you feel like you could take on any opponent in that thing, ~player~?
Our suit is hugging all your curves really nicely. Now we just need to see you in a cockpit.
...You're wearing one of our ring guns. I don't blame you---I'm just surprised Earth had them in this time.
..."~player~," right? That ring can fire lasers---we use them all the time. Are they really such old technology...?
...Your ring's not just jewelry. It's a weapon, like mine. I thought they were Mejare's signature...
So they do serve coffee here. And you take it like I do...
...Black coffee. Most girls prefer some cream. I'll have to get a cup myself...

case.state: ...Two Pair, and you lost. My flightsuit never stood a chance.
When it's this close, you've got to start getting reckless. Here and in flying.
That was a good winning streak, ~player~...just not good enough.
...You know how to win, so you should know how to lose.
That took some time...
...Should I state the obvious?
...The whole crew knows my poker face.
Any good pilot could use some luck on her side.
I was watching you. That was enough time without a loss for each of us to strip and then some.
That was long enough that you probably know what you're doing.
...You were biding your time.
We know a big target when we see one.
With my clothes...one loss is equal to any streak.
You lasted a while, ~player~. How do you feel about your position?
...I don't let girls get too far ahead of the pack.
Just like Miss Gasco...
I was just about to comment on how well you were doing, ~player~.

...Not too bad a round.
...Paper-thin defenses.
Unnh...it's like something's---n-never mind me.
Nirvana, this is Meia. I've sustained some damage...and am "returning fire."
...Take some breaths.
I can offer advice, but even that would only go so far.
Something about this place must make everyone nosy.
~name~'s turn...
I don't take victories for granted, or my opponents.
Earth's Harvest cubes are intimidating. Its women, less so.
~name~, did you exchange the same sort of cards you usually do?
Let's see how an Earth girl handles herself when the stakes rise...
...When my skin can breathe, the luck flows out.
I'm sure you know the drill.
I'm glad it's someone else's turn...
{pyoro}Pyoro~...did you lose, ~name~? You're not like machines...humans get to make mistakes sometimes.
I believe we decide our own fates. But with cards, it's hard to feel that way.
Maybe you had a feeling before we even showed them.
...Do you have something to say to her, ~player~?
Maybe sharing a sex is enough to feel camaraderie on this planet.
Cards don't always feel fair, do they?
Even when we've met other colonists, I'm usually in orbit with the Dread team. It's nice just to chat.
If I can find a way to win this, I'm going to take it.
There's one way I've already lost...so I'll make sure to win now.
...We're here to beat you, ~name~, but not to mock you.
...Is it rude here to look another girl in the eye?
...Whenever you're ready, ~name~.
Earth has a knack for putting us on the defensive. I'll take any chance to reverse that.
It's a nice change of pace to not have to give any orders.
...Don't worry about me, ~name~. It's your turn, anyway.
...Are you not only interested in the cards, ~player~?
Another round down just means preparing for the next.
I've lost more than enough.
I guess it's been a trend for our crew to retreat several times before pushing back.
It's been interesting to hear what Earth girls have to say for themselves, ~name~.
...You shouldn't write off a weakened enemy, you know.
This really isn't so stressful.
...Well?
Maybe I should join one of the game nights in Reg for once.
The pessimist in me sees all the ways I could lose each round. I'd been getting better about that---it must be the men rubbing off on me.
...You can read, ~name~.
If you'd like something more skill-based, we should spar sometime.

"Formation delta-four" is when our rookies fall in behind me.
...Do you follow?
I've more than led the way for you.
...Would you rather it was me, ~player~?
...There's still work to do.
It never feels like what you've swapped was enough.
No excuses, ~name~.
She'll handle herself.
It's---hagh. W-well, it's a lot easier for me to understand how I feel when it's another girl's turn...
I-I wasn't happy with how the cards treated me, either.
Whenever I lose, I have to make it right somehow. This---ngh---damn game...I guess I'll have to settle for looking you over.
I-I'm---a junior officer, you know. I can give orders...and take them.
I-I can't help but keep up with the game still.
A girl's body---mmn---is no secret.
Mm---~name~. What's next from you...?
The only stake in this I have now is seeing who loses next. And...w-well, I wouldn't mind if it's you.

I've been cooped up on that ship for a long time...the same crewmates, the same bodies.
...Well, make your move.
Mhmhm...don't make me wait to see your choice, ~name~. I always get anxious and scout ahead.
Hehe...I know I've got no right to demand anything from you. So just show me how you handle things yourself.
T-there's---still some female solidarity in this world of men, right?
...Does losing get on your nerves, ~name~? You can see what it's reduced me to.
If I have to rely on others to finish you off, I guess I can think of them as my "crewmates."
Hoohhnn...hoo...hoohn...
Mmn? Mmn...
...As annoyed to lose as I was?
Hoohhnn...y-your turn. Don't mind the loser...
Tss...o-ouughn. I-it's no fun watching others compete...
...I can take care of myself, ~player~. Watch ~name~...
Now it's really none of my concern who swapped what...
D-do it quick. I'm still---dripping here.
Remember to smile, ~name~.
At least the pressure is off for once.
If you're worried about losing, I feel a lot better now.
You can start whining when you start masturbating.

{pyoro}Pyoro~...is it time to go, Meia?{!reset}
No, I'm just watching the game play out...
This game only gets harder as people drop out. The worst hand starts getting better.
Come on, ~name~. It's just a game we're playing.
...I'm still watching the game, ~name~. It's your turn.
...I don't want to watch you stand around, ~name~.
You want to win, right?
Keep things moving.
I still want to see exactly how you'd fit in on our crew.
I hope you're enjoying the competition.
I have more conditioning to do...
If there were betting, I'd still be playing.
This is Meia. The enemy is still engaged...
...I already lost a long time ago, ~player~.
...Come on, ~name~.
...Do you figure who's going to win, ~player~?
...I'm still paying attention.
...Black hair goes nice with pale skin. The same kind of thing happens against my suit.
I feel like I don't see a lot of black-haired girls on our ship. It's mostly Amarone, and I guess Onnushi...
...It's a nice color, right? Having blue hair. Girls say it's relaxing to look at.
...Blonde's sort of the "traditional" beauty. I don't know how much you value that.
That dark red hair you have is pretty striking. My trainee's the same way, plus the other team leader, Valore.
I've spent a lot of time around girls with your kind of scarlet hair. Dita, our trainee, has hers really long---and Valore, the other wing commander, cuts it short like mine.
One of my pilots has green hair like yours. It doesn't really match her personality.
...You were born with your hair that color, right? Something here isn't causing people to age quickly...?
Our captain tries to hide it, but her hair still hasn't turned white, even at 108. This is just---your natural look, right?
I know brown hair is really common, but we have a lot of different colors on our crew, so brunettes actually stick out a little.
Brunettes aren't a rarity around here, right? For us, there's Ezra, Parfet...I swear our crew has more blues and greens.
...You've got a pretty look to you. That orange hair and pale skin. I'm not sure I have a crewmate like that.
Your hair...it's pretty striking. Pink's something even we don't see a lot.
I used to know a girl who dyed her hair pink---one of the gangbangers I hung out with. It's pretty loud, and so was she.
My mother's hair was a lot closer to your purple than my blue. And my Oma was brunette...I'm not sure how I ended up like this.
This is a bit like looking in the mirror. When I was a girl, I got a lot of compliments for my green eyes.
Do people mention your green eyes? They're pretty---I've never had a problem with mine.
Blue eyes are pretty common on our ship. That's not a bad thing, though---they're really striking.
I think I heard somewhere that blue eyes weren't very common on Earth. A lot of them must have settled Mejare.
A lot of us have ended up pale like you. It's part of living on a spaceship.
Mejare is a fleet nation, so it doesn't get much natural light. You'd fit in pretty well with your skin tone.
...Do you get girls telling you you look like a ghost? I wish they minded their own business.
...Is your skin naturally pale? My family's is, too. I'm not sure exactly what part of Earth they were from.
I heard that Earth used to treat dark-skinned girls unfairly. Mejare doesn't have anything like that...we switched it for men.
A lot of us are pale, but dark skin like yours is really pretty. The girl who shares my rank has it, too.
I've always kept my hair cut short like yours. I don't want it getting in my way in a fight.
Maybe you agree that short hair is a lot easier to deal with. Not to mention... I think it's cuter.
Your hair is beautiful to look at, but it seems like so much work to maintain. I don't know how my crewmates manage.
Even if long hair like yours is prettier, it's just too much hassle. This is about as long as I can tolerate.
Do you know what men think of girls that are taller? We're both above average, I'd think.
...I'm not as tall as you, but we're both on the higher end for women. At least, back home...
I used to think I grew pretty tall until I saw some of the girls on our crew. They're like you---starting to rival men's heights.
Girls on Mejare might tend to grow pretty tall on average. You don't see a lot that are your size.
You're a cute size. It's different---a lot of girls back home grow up tall and slender, with long legs.
...So you're not interested in men at all? That's familiar---just not that helpful.
It's ironic to come all this way to meet women who live with men---only to meet one who couldn't care less about them.
You'd fit in where I'm from. Girls fall in love all the time. It's nice to know that's not unique to us.
...If I understand you, I guess that makes me a "lesbian," too. At least the idea exists.
...Even with a bit to go, I can tell you look good underneath.
Do you like to exercise? Some girls look better with clothes on---some look better naked.
Where I'm from, girls mostly talk about curves and measurements. I think a little tone goes a long way.
...I have a feeling you look better with clothes on.
...Don't you take care of yourself at all? You ought to feel embarrassed to be here.
...Your body isn't something you can just ignore, ~name~. You need to get in shape.
...Food must be much more abundant here.
You're built like some of our security guards. I mostly do bodyweight training, but I have to wonder if some of it's genetic.
Our Reg Chief has got a lot of muscle like you. I'd like to think there's a sweet spot between agility and bulk.
I guess you're a civilian? Even if most of our crew's not in fighting roles, I still think it's important to train, even a little.
You're on the thin side. I know girls mostly talk about being buxom, but you shouldn't just ignore your muscles.
Girls on Mejare tend to be pretty slender. Your kind of full figure's not a bad thing, though.
...Is your look popular on Earth? The sort of pear-shaped build. It's not as common back home.
Wide hips are nice, but you take it pretty far. Maybe that's the style on Earth, with more food to go around.
{pyoro}Pyoro~! Magno's Family accepts all women who wish to join their ranks! Their only requirement is: "work to eat!"

state.text: You remind me of when I was in school. They always said girls who run around and fight grow up to be Omas.

case.state:
...~name~, if you fell in love with another girl, do you think you'd be the one to protect her?
...That must be a weird question here.

state.text: On Mejare, we'd call your type an "Oma-girl"---sporty, aggressive. There must be a name for it here, too.

case.state: ...I liked a lot of bands who dressed like you. I even did it myself---but that was later.
...So there are punk bands on Earth, too? I had your kind of look for a while, back when I ran with street thugs.
...You have the same look in your eyes as my trainee. Like you'd hardly even know what sex is.
...You don't seem like the type of girl to sign up for this.
Barnette's green hair doesn't really match her personality. What about yours?
You go to school with men? They don't seem able to focus for long enough.
You're a student...I'm a dropout. Let's leave it at that.
...So, what's planet Switzerland like? I've never heard of it.
You're a doctor? The Nirvana could use you...our only doctor is a man.
You're a doctor? The Nirvana could use you...I don't trust Duero's knowledge of women sometimes.
You're a doctor? The Nirvana could use you...Paiway's just a child nurse in training.
{jura}This game's just full of rarities, isn't it?
A tie...there's no better game I could've asked for between two friends.
Mhmhmhm. We tied...this is some game we're having. After all this time meeting strangers...
...We were supposed to meet new people, and we end up in a showdown---tying. Unbelievable...
...Ties are so rare in this game. We really are having a clash---I can't let you overtake me.
...This is almost like a dogfight, the way we're clashing. You'd never beat me in a Dread, and you won't do it here...Jura.
...A tie? This keeps getting better. Jura, you may be my second-in-command...but you're also my friend.
...A tie. This couldn't get any better...defeating you will truly be something special.
...Mhmhmhmhm. Mhmhmhmhm! We tied. Come on, let's keep going.
...We tied. This is why I love going one-on-one...you're truly worth defeating.
...A tie. Even with all the one-on-one poker I've played against Gascogne, we've never, ever tied. Come on...next round.
...We tied. This really is a showdown...let's do the round over, shall we?
...We tied. This game was truly meant to come down to the two of us...wouldn't you agree?
...What now? O-oh, a tie?
...Did you just tie? This game---really needed me moving things along.
...Tied. I'll let you figure out what to do...

A tie?
...That's pretty rare, but we don't need to dwell on it.
...Doesn't anyone know what the rule is here?
...A tie. If there's no suit ranking, let's reshuffle.
...A tie. Let's just redo the round---there's no point arguing.
...Oh, a tie. It seems like everyone has different rules for this kind of thing...

...Pyoro, what are the odds of a tie here?
{pyoro}11,470 to 1...gg-ghn. At random. With two players. *Klick...*
M-more input required...
A---a tie? Damn it, to see something so rare, and I wasn't even participating...
...A tie. This has all the makings of an intense game of poker, and I've already lost...
...Did you two just tie? That's never even happened to me, with all the poker I played with Gascogne...
...What's the problem? A tie? Damn it, and after I have nothing left but to watch people strip...
...Unbelievable. A tie? I have no stakes left, so I say both of you strip...
{jura}No fun at all, is he? It's OK...we all have each other.
{jura}What a killjoy---but no one ever said men were fun. Just relax...
{jura}Hmph. Maybe we should think of eating him instead.
{meia}~name~...I-I want more.
...Don't remind me.
...If I'd handled it better, I'm not sure I'd be here.
Jura---!
As far as I can tell, anyway. You're male, right, Corrin?
We don't have the best track record with spotting disguised men, so honesty about your sex would be helpful.
As you can see, we're not very experienced in telling men and women apart.
Give him some space...it's probably embarrassing.
...That sounds like a man's name, so I guess not that one.
...If those films starred any men, then no, we wouldn't have them.
Where I'm from, we love to be admired. Giving and receiving. The men seem pretty shy about it.
They're showing it to you, aren't they? They want to be seen. Men never seem to want to be.
..."Blade"? If it weren't for those parts, I'd think you're fully human...
...I see. Blades are---augmented humans...?
The planet's not terraformed. All the living districts are ships in orbit.
Mejare is a fleet nation orbiting the planet. The surface is undeveloped.
...That's not a costume. What is she?
...She's not just dressed up. Those are mechanical parts.
Is fear not part of Earth's Halloween, then? Maybe Mejare introduced that so we'd get used to calling men monsters.
That's strange. On Mejare, Halloween is all about "scary things." We hear stories about men, the disgusting monsters.
You seem uneasy about this. Didn't you grow up around women?
I never thought a man could be so uncomfortable with nudity. A year ago I was convinced you didn't wear clothes.
For a man to be so uncomfortable around women...you really are a model Tarakkian.
Get over yourself. I didn't know any men until I was nineteen, and you don't see me all flustered.
I thought for sure men just saw clothes as a means of avoiding women's germs. You seem to really want them on.
I never thought a man could be so uncomfortable with nudity. A year ago I was convinced you didn't wear clothes.
It just seems like something men want to keep safe. I've seen them instinctively reach for it---with their hands.
I've seen men go to cover it, is all. Like they're worried about it being exposed.
Agh---! What is that floating blade? You're another Esper, like that Earthling child---!
Wha---what's the meaning of this? A floating, talking blade? So Earthling Espers have powers beyond telekinesis---!
Wha---a hybrid, and another Earthling with telekinesis? With---a talking blade? Explain yourself!
I---I now have more questions. Earthling Espers we've encountered, but ones allied with talking swords...we have not.
..."Warmbloods"? I see...you're not from Earth. Neither am I...though I am still very much human.
...I think I understand. You're not human...and you're not from this planet, either. To think I'd meet alien life here...
"Warmbloods"...is that the name of your race? Men are alien enough to me, but meeting an actual alien life form...
Ah, I see. You're not an Earthling in the first place---we've never encountered an alien species in our exploration.

state.text: Don't try to distract me with stories about your colleagues! As if I'd let my guard down around a man with a weapon out---!
"Dynamike"? Don't waste my time with nonsense---you expect me to listen to a man with explosives on his shoulder?
Why wouldn't I take you as a terrorist? A rocket launcher goes far beyond a personal sidearm!
Carry it around for self-defense, I assume? Don't insult my intelligence!
If you would never fire it, then why bring it at all? And in such a cramped space, with innocent bystanders---!
It's reckless to bring explosives into such a crowded area, regardless of whether you plan to fire it! Why do you even have it?
And what might drive you to kill someone? That woman being a pirate from one of Earth's hated colonies?
Unless you have to kill someone? If you're here to eliminate a few Mejarian aggressors, then just say it!

case.state: ...I meant a hostile man, but it's true that many threats exist. Can you describe what you've encountered?
My homeworld is all-female, though it seems it's the only human settlement that's like that.
You don't know how you got here? You're obviously concussed, or at least something like it. Can't you ask someone to escort you to a hospital?
...You can't be serious. I knew men could be hardheaded, but even the man in my squadron might admit he should get his concussion checked.
You don't know? My crewmates call me stubborn---I think I'd excuse myself from a mission if I were confused where I was.
We go by "Magno's Family," after our captain Magno Vivan. Who or what is this group resisting?
We're named after our leader, as well---"Magno's Family," like her former congregation. Do you oppose your government, or a foreign enemy?
"Raynor's Raiders." So, you're more like our captain, the priestess "Magno's Family" is named for. Who do you "raid"?
...I'm sorry for prying, but is there a reason I shouldn't ask you about this?
...I'm sorry if this is awkward for you. You're older than the men we've taken prisoner, so you seemed like a good fit.
...I'm sorry. I thought an older man might not mind this sort of topic. Is something wrong?
...Well, the man in my squadron has a slim frame, too---on top of being short. He still has my respect.
I didn't mean that as an insult. My team's male pilot is shorter and slimmer than most women, and he holds his own.
...That makes more sense if you're not from this planet. Earth's technology makes my homeworld look primitive, and we already outstrip our neighbor.
One of my pilots is just as attached. She raves about the noise, the kickback, the adrenaline rush---she insists on bringing them for missions.
So there's other Sentinel models. Are there any that focus on range or mobility, like a Dread fighter?
Our Dread fighters are built for speed and maneuverability over versatility. Are the later-generation Sentinels designed more like that?

state.text: Very funny. What's worse is how close we already are to that tube of yours---if you've got one.
What I'm really worried about is what's living on your rod-organ. There's barely anything between us and that thing already...!
So is making tentacles out of your nosehair. If a normal man could do that, our prisoners probably would've tried by now.
You've already crossed the line on what I expect from men. None of our prisoners have weaponized their nosehair.

case.state: ...My homeworld doesn't have any "independent forces." You're not the only Sentinel militia, are you?
...Earth must be really splintered in this time to rely on a militia against "kaiju" invasion. Are there any other mech forces like yours?
...I don't know what I expected. And out of all of them, you studied nosehair?

Nosehair is a strange one to specialize in, then.
...As if they're not all strange.
It's a big reason people have colonized other worlds in my time. Life wasn't sustainable here.
The Earth I know wasn't taken care of. People fled to colonies like Mejare for a fresh start.
You have to watch your strength with a girl, don't you? They always told us not to grapple with men.
Touching men was dangerous for other reasons. I always just thought about men's size difference for combat.
...What do men do to unwind?
...You'll have to show me what unwinding means for a man, too.
...What's happened to your people? Have there been attacks from offworld?
"Last remaining"? Were the others wiped out by an enemy?
I-I don't know. Isn't that what you'd want?
I-if you--act differently from other men, don't you want to be treated different? I don't know what your roles are.
I think you'd fit in just fine. Or, you would---if you were a woman.
...If you weren't a man, I'm sure they'd accept you.
Do you really have it in you to not try and surprise u---n-no, you don't.
What I expect is that you can't help but try to one-up your---self---!
...Maybe not, but I'd like to hear how you're managing.
...How have you been getting by?
...So it's another gambling game. Why don't you just tell me?
It'd be simpler if you explained it. Do you bet money the same way?
...You might as well, but it may not be so foreign, after all.

Putting it like that makes me think our experiences might not be so different.
...Go ahead.

{pyoro}Pyoro~! Meia, those two have near-identical biosignals! What's going on?{!reset}
Something technological, maybe...
...Oh, Pyoro.<hr>{pyoro}At your service! Meia, how come that giant guy and his little lady have such similar readings?
..."Unsavory practices"?
...Where, exactly?
Why use cards as weapons?
They sound powerful, but I'm not sure how cards became weapons in the first place.
...Your liberation, or theirs?
...Whose liberation?
...Some kind of rodent? It looks intelligent...
I've seen rodents before, if that's what it is. It does seem smart...
...You also remind me of another short, loudmouthed man I know. At least he's under my command.
...I didn't realize short men with unfounded pride were such a common breed. The other one takes orders from me.
..."Shenanigans"? What kind of conflict is Chaldea facing that you'd describe it that way?
It must be thin fabric, then. Why even wear it?
You've just lost. But why are you wearing the blindfold, then?
...So what's your reasoning for wearing it? Some kind of Earth fashion statement?
...Do you care to explain that?
See better? I'd like an explanation for that...and why you wear it in the first place.
I would like to look you in the eyes. Men are mysterious enough without being mechanical.
You do have functioning eyes, right? Or did your creators not bother with those?
You're not afraid to look me in the eye, are you? I'm just a normal woman.
Don't think I forgot about that thing...but you're free to look me in the eye and call me a liar.
...Right. Well, you're certainly amiable, but so was a man who cut our engines and sold us out to the Harvest.
...Well, keep up the friendly act for long enough, and I might start to believe it. That's how a man tricked me the last time...
...I admit it's hard to be suspicious when you're so laid-back. Rabat didn't waste much time with that facade...
...You have to understand. The last friendly man I met quickly chucked a robot at my face.
That was a sword? You had it holstered like one of those kinetic men's guns Barnette collects...
A blade? I would've expected a scabbard for that...and a holster for the mechanical guns men use.
You had a sword holstered? It looks like it's made of energy...but at least it's less threatening than men's mechanical guns.
Oh. I thought you were carrying a kinetic sidearm...men on Tarak always seem to use those, not that I understand it with the racket they make.
Duero is one of our male prisoners---a-agh! What just happened? Jotaro! You did something!
The Nirvana has a few male prisoner on b---wha---what? Something flashed by---!
Mejare is all women. Duero is a prisoner from the male planet Tarak---ngh! Jotaro! What was that flash all about?

state.text: You're right. Duero is among our male prisoners---agh! What just flashed by? Answer me, or you'll be joining our prisoners!

case.state: ...Right. You could try to act that way, then.
Then I suggest you stop leering at me like a killer.
I consider men in general to be a threat, so maybe it's just my nerves. I invite you to convince me of that.
...Then stop carrying yourself like one. This game is uncomfortable enough already.
You're a strange specimen. Male, wings, living in the sky?
You live in the sky, was it? There's a lot more to the universe than that.
So, what's an "angel," exactly?
Whatever that item is, it's rather decorative for Tarakkian men...the common citizens, anyway.
Is that military attire? Tarakkian soldiers' garb can get rather decorative...but only the soldiers.
Your outfit is decorative for a man. Tarakkians tend to wear rags.
I guess I can understand wanting to keep your face hidden in a strip game...wait, you're taking it off already?
...Oh, so you aren't concerned with hiding your identity. I thought you might just have wanted to maintain some anonymity here.
...Wait, don't tell me your rod is---s-so soon?
Wait, are you---out of clothes?
I've seen men instinctively reach for it, is all...just not like this.
Men just seem worried about it being exposed. You're definitely not like them in other ways...

U-uh---! What now?
Or---who...?
W-what's tha---who is that...?
...I wasn't looking down on you. He's has earned my respect, even if I could throw him around.
...He's saved my life, so it'd be rich of me to underestimate a man on the short side.
...I know what even an undersized man is capable of in battle now, thanks to him. You have nothing to be ashamed of.
That's---not going to change things.
...Starting small...
...And that's it?
Yes, I'll be watching...
That's your turn, then...
Don't watch us. Do it.
...Hmm.
Keep things simple...
We know so little about you...
That's fine for now, just do it...
This won't take long?
Men make sense in this way, at least...
Makes sense, even for you...
You're not like our prisoners...
You'd think men's clothes would be more interesting...
To show even some skin...
I see you're not making this easy...
I hope to see a man nude quickly and easily.
Hmph...
Just that...then do it.
{pyoro}News! Is this a good time, Meia?{!reset}<hr>Looks like it, despite everything...
Maybe we should have put our prisoners in uniforms.
If that's all, I've come back from worse odds, and against men braver than you...
...I thought men were more daring than this.
...That's not the part of men's bodies I was interested in.
...If that's your choice...
...Too small...
It figures...
...Where's he flown off to...?
Another empty turn...
I hate being on the backfoot like this...
I guess nothing short of your tube would feel equal to my breasts.
...He's just taking off something small, isn't he? Leave me alone while I fix myself.
...Something small, to match my chest...
...I really never pictured myself losing to a man.
...Something small. And why shouldn't he...
...Oh. That's a smart move, it's just...I was starting to get caught up in my own feelings.
You're still wearing your ~clothing~...I must have barely been a part of this game to you.
I've slipped so far behind you. Normally men being around has improved my luck.
...You're mocking me. But now that I've had to strip naked for you, I guess whipping your tube out would mock me just as much.
...I didn't have an interest in men's fashion when I still had my clothes on.
...Unrelenting...
This is too much...
...Tch. I always fly past the small fries.
...OK, never mind...I should've expected as much.
...Hm. This was never going to come easy.
...I got all worked up.
...Just an extra...
...You like your girls more agreeable, don't you?
...I got more excited than I'm comfortable with.
...You're here to win, right? It's not personal.
...Mmgh.
Still something small...
...That's it...
...That's not doing anything.
I figured.
...No fun.
That makes sense, but...
{jura}Sssh. Ignore him. Focus on us...
{jura}If men don't want to play along, we'll just force them to later, like always.
{jura}Can't you stop making fun of us for just a minute?
{jura}I think the men of the Nirvana are more handsome anyway, don't you?
Wha---me? I---I wasn't part of this conversation!
Jura, I'm sure you could ask Duero to---m-me? L-leave me out of this!
I---w-what? I don't want to be painted, especially in the nude.
...Who knows what men are thinking. Just---w-what? I---I didn't offer to pose for you!
...I'm glad you took it in stride.
...I would've preferred it if you focused on flirting with women, if anyone.
Sex is no obstacle for your affections, is it? Good to know...
Should I tell Barnette you're flirting with men now, too? Actually, she probably already knows...
...I didn't really watch movies growing up.
...You're asking the wrong person.
...You find your own space, even if it's in a cockpit.
You appreciate what you can get. Like a surface trip...or piloting a Dread.
I guess it makes sense that Earth would be facing several hostile forces of its own. That must be what prompted its development of the Harvest.
Yes, it's an Earth colony known as Mejare. I understand it's somewhat remote, and it was colonized late into Earth's expansion period.
...I was hoping to study a more human man during my time on Earth.
...Human men are already mysterious enough. You seem to have a whole host of mysteries to yourself.
...I see you---or your species---is fascinating, Dust, but even human men still elude me...this is all a bit much.
Do you...have much in common with human men? That's who I came here to observe---an alien with floating blades is well beyond that.

state.text: I'm not interested in who a man thinks deserves explosives shot their way. Consider this a warning!
The only one threatening to kill anyone is you, especially if you think yourself the judge of who gets fired on. I'm watching you!
Like who? If you have violent male colleagues, then I won't treat you any different---you have my warning!
Tch! I'll be watching you for sudden movements, as I'd watch "Bull," or any other man wielding explosives!
You've had a rocket launcher your entire life? This is nonsense---just be aware that I'm watching you.
Your entire---stop trying to distract me! Strange remarks won't distract me from watching your movements.
...As long as you're holding that thing, I find that hard to believe. And don't talk about my underwear---!
Tch---a man holding explosives and talking about my "panties" is about as uncomfortable as this can get. Don't move...
A likely story...I'm quite familiar with the "tests" both men and Earthlings put us through. Don't make any sudden movements...
I'm the one on a hostile planet, when men themselves are so often hostiles...you are testing me. And I'm watching you...
If you "aren't like that," then why did you bring it at all? Men...!
I find it hard to believe you'd bring explosives without a plan to use them...and I suggest you abandon whatever plan that is.
Is that so? I have faced down male soldiers with more intimidating weapons---don't think I'll hesitate to subdue you.
Maybe Earth girls wouldn't "mess with" you, but a Mejarian is quite familiar with men's weapons. Don't test me.
I could say the same. That doesn't change the immediate danger is poses in such an enclosed space---be warned that I'll fire.
I've dealt with more destructive weapons myself, but I focus on the present. Take care not to make threatening moves.
I don't know what to think, other than that you're a hostile on a foreign planet. By all means, convince me otherwise.
What I think is that I have every reason to consider you a threat, so tread carefully. You are not the first man I've dealt with.
And I am on this planet in peace, but instead I'm faced with an armed and dangerous man!
Then take a moment to consider my feelings, here on a hostile foreign planet with a clear and present danger!
I would relax if you would set down your weapon. A simple request for the average male soldier, but not for an insane suicidal rocketeer...!
How easy it must be for a man with explosive rockets to tell a woman to relax, especially when he's on his home planet. Set it down!

case.state: ...I won't insist on it any further. I can't believe I'm showing concern for a man in the first place.
...It's your decision. A year ago, I would've considered a wounded man a good one.
We've been defending ourselves from fleets of unmanned drones. Pinpointing a central leader ordering the attacks would make the fight much easier.
...So, you're close to the enemy leader and seek to depose him. Our enemies have been the aggressors, but they've only sent robotic fleets. We have no main force to attack.
Our crew has had to adjust to our new roles as freedom fighters---we were just trying to survive before. It sounds like these enemies have kept you fighting for a long time.
We've never considered ourselves heroes. It's noble of you to step in even if invaders weren't targeting you.
Multiple enemies...we only ever signed up to be pirates, and we got thrust into our current situation. Some of us feel frustrated picking fights we can't win.
...I wasn't asking you what it's like to fall in love. Just---if men and women fall in love the same way women do.
...Women fall in love on Mejare, Mr. Raynor. I was only asking what men and women might look for in each other.
...That's not what I meant. I know how women get into relationships---I just wasn't sure if men being involved changes that.
...That said, he does tend to overestimate himself.
...But he takes a lot of needless risks, especially for someone his size.
I see. So you operate as a team, too. We have our own supply ship in case battles don't go as planned.
So you're not fighting alone. Our Dreads usually hold formations or call in our support ship.
...Small comfort. Though I didn't give you enough credit that you'd actually save your groin for last.
...You mean you've actually got some modesty? I figured you'd rip off your underwear and cry for your necklace.
Mejarians would probably shave off their nosehair if you could see it.
Most of my crewmates would rather get shot than fight with their nosehair. We shave almost everything else.
If it is different, that means there's hope for it. The problem is still under control from the looks of things.
Let's hope it is different, for both our sakes. I don't want to see this place fall into ruin.
...And what does that look like? Lifting her up, or something more?
Does that "protection" mean anything in bed?
Only a few of our Dreads can combine with a Vanguard---the ones piloted by crew members that got caught in the Paksis.
That sounds a lot like our Vandreads. There's only a few pilots that can make one---the ones that came in contact with the Paksis.
...I know what that's like. It's not something I'd want to do anymore.
...You don't need to explain that. Drinking especially... it's not worth it.

My---Oma looked a lot like a man. I guess she acted like one, too, if that means being stubborn.
...And I take after her.
...A "manly" woman. You could say that about my Oma. Headstrong, and hard to get along with...so you could say it about me, too.
...If it comes to life-and-death, they might see your humanity.
...Maybe if you saved their lives.

...I'm an only child.
...Wait, don't tell me your rod is---u-uh. I guess it isn't...?

I don't have siblings. Wait, are you---out of clothes?
...Is that more underwear?
...That sounds familiar. We've had to deal with wave after wave of Earth drones.
...Our crew has the same problem. Huge fleets of robot "cube-types" coming to kill us.
I don't like card games very much, so maybe that's a good fit.
I wouldn't mind getting rid of my cards. This isn't how I like to spend time.
...Touch a crystal, and miracles occur. No...it's not strange at all.
Our lives "resonate" with yours, then. Crystals having feelings, and changing the world...

{pyoro}Meia, do you trust these two?{!reset}
It's not so strange. We have our own link---from our own crystal.
{pyoro}That body-linking might be some precursor to the Harvesters...{!reset}<hr>Or the Paksis. We're not that different...
Killing people before you steal from them is not a mercy.
...Attacking and stealing from people is your good point?
...Beyond death or injury?
Games can be made deadly.
...He's also quick to assume his own superiority. At least he's quite capable in a dogfight---your prowess remains to be seen.
...At the very least, his constant boasting is backed up when he pilots his Vanguard. I can only hope you have similar talents.
...Your clothing has a visual feed? Earth really is more advanced...
...I'm going to stop asking questions. Apparently Earth technology is beyond my grasp...
...I'm not sure if that counts as cheating. Why not just use your eyes?
...I have a visual feed, too. It's called my eyes.
The more you talk about this 2B girl, the more curious I become. Is she an android, too? Or...gynoid.
And "2B" is a gynoid, right? I'd very much like to see Earth's mechanical interpretation of women...
Earth has harvested enough of our organs to design a female robot. It's only fair I should get to meet this 2B.
It's a shame "2B" couldn't have come here. Apparently she has my temperament...and I'd like a conversation with a gynoid.
If that's true, my crewmates' comparisons of me to a machine are surprisingly accurate. I'd like to meet her.

state.text: If I really would get along with this "2B," then my stoicism is paying dividends. Bring her along next time.
Possess what? You're not making sense---I should've known to be wary of men!
Just when I thought I might trust a man here---! I don't know what a Stand is!
How can you project some strange instant energy and then have the nerve to ask questions? Men...!
What's this nonsense about a Stand? Be aware that I'm armed---and accustomed to fighting men!

case.state: Showy...like it was an effort to impress a "cute" girl.
I don't see what was so manly about it. If you're trying to impress me, you need not appeal to your gender.
Tarak is known for its ruthless efficiency, so flinging your sandals doesn't strike me as manly---it strikes me as flirting.
Well, it reminded me of one man I know...but I think you're just being theatric to catch my eye.
You look like you've got a lot on your mind...and that it's not going to stay there.
Small, talkative, male. You and Hibiki might as well be...what's the word? Brothers?
This is going to be a long game if you're going to talk this much.
...U-uh. I guess it isn't...?
...Is that more underwear?
He doesn't put up with those comments, either. I know what it's like to have something to prove.
He's gotten teased about his height a lot, too. I think it motivates him---I can understand.
...Are you trying to get me to say it? "Show me your tube already"?
...So there's things men cherish more than their "penises."
...I've seen men get attached to armbands, if that's what this is about.
...You're going to have to do better than that.
...I thought I might get excited, too.
...Are you teasing me, ~name~?
I can't believe I'm not staring at the man stripping.
...Can men masturbate without any help?
Let's get on with it.
As a reminder, our mission to~background.time~ is to learn about the male body.
Let's keep the game going...
...Mejare would have us believe you walk around naked.
I wonder how many layers separate us from...the tube.
...We've got a long way to go.
I guess we're more alike than different...
Men and their mysterious tubes..
Are you a typical Earth man?
...Men do have modesty.
...The revelations will come.
...Just filler...
...Just your ~clothing~...
...Well, then.
...Next round.
We know you've got bodies in there somewhere...
So much talking every round...
We don't have all ~background.time~.
...When the time comes, ~name~, I'll be watching.
...If you have no attachment to that, we could study it.
...I'm accustomed to women accessorizing themselves, but men doing it is new to me...
The only decorations I'm used to seeing on men are military.
I once believed men didn't even wear clothes...
If you were here to infect us, you'd probably be stripping faster.
...No need to think of the tube yet.
Do you have any data on male behavior, Pyoro?<hr>{pyoro}Yeah, ~name~'s taking his time...
We'd appreciate verbal descriptions in the meantime.
...Men have never bored me before.
Even Tarakkian men seem sheepish about nudity.
Duero, our male doctor, is smart enough to play poker...but he barely wears more than his labcoat.
I wonder if I could more easily gain your attention with food. That seems to work on our prisoners.
I don't like waiting around...especially for a man.
I should have taken tonight's patrol duty at this rate.
...The man on our Dread team doesn't waste any time.
...Would you consider yourself an upper-class man?
Men from Tarak dress more sparse. It is a desert...
I take it the reveal of my shoulders didn't excite you.
Normally women are competitors, and men are just enemies...
You can only put your opponent on the backfoot here in one sense.
...Why do men have those bumps on your necks? Are they what make your voices deeper?
...I guess part of men being human means they're often mundane.
Nothing to report on my end. It's a man's turn, even...
If you'd like me to turn around for you again, you'll have to do better.
There's nothing I hate more than a man with a smug look on his face...
This is among the best shots I've taken from a man. Second only to a bandit chucking our navi robot at my face.
I never thought a man would decorate himself. I guess we really are the same species.
Losing to a man...I can only attribute that to dumb luck.
I'm glad the man that ended up in my Dread team has more backbone.
...I've come back from worse odds, and against braver men than you.
Men's street clothing isn't too different from women's, other than the cut. I don't suppose you'd show cleavage.
I'm been searching for Dread pilots, but we do have some leftover Vanguards---men's crafts. Of course, you'd have to let yourself be taken prisoner.
I wonder if we'd get better answers about men if we asked women. Men aren't above boasting...
...Don't you have more to show me?
You're doing strangely well...
...It's a long way back to the ship.
...I can respect wanting to go at your own pace.
...I'm losing to a man. It's bad enough being saved by one.
...You don't seem very interested in me.
...More layers between you and women's fangs.
Pyoro's data storage has been growing without any outside upgrades...
If that's your move...I'm still not giving up.
...You're counting me out already, aren't you?
...It'd be rich for me to complain about smart decision-making.
I should just do some work in my head. I know the formations, anyway.
...I wouldn't expect a man to be generous, even to a girl in my position.
I know another man with a competitive streak.
Somehow even your chest doesn't feel like it'd be equal to mine.
I was always happy just to compete with other girls. Against a man, my whole pride as a woman is at stake.
You don't need to take pity on me, you know. I've been in my share of firefights against your sex.
...You really are toying with me. If we were in a dogfight, I wouldn't tolerate that.
...Women are supposed to be submissive to men on this planet, aren't they? I'm in that sort of position right now...you clothed, me naked.
I guess men have been challenging me in all sorts of ways since we took them in.
...They always warned us men had no mercy.
...Have you ever considered having a child with another man? I've heard men on Tarak do so using machinery, but they usually don't form couples.
...I already felt vulnerable around men. At least there used to be a thin flightsuit between us.
...Does Earth's government issue men any small items with your personal data on them? Tarak citizens all carry one---soldiers' combat knives or mechanics' dogtags, for instance.
...None of the men onboard have shown me much interest, either. I hate to say it, but...that hurts my pride.
...I guess you're not too excited by me.
...You really piss me off.
...Do I seem alien to you?
I'm not sure what's worse...losing to a man, or having to sit here and take it...
Hah...has Hibiki inspected his Vanguard lately? He's usually good about it...
Even when I masturbate for a man, his pride gets in the way. That sounds like someone I know.
...Mmgh. Always rely on yourself...
I've only met a few men. They've all left an impression in their own way...what about you?
You should know you have my full attention here.
...I definitely didn't take it well the first time a man humiliated me.
...Heh. Is this what I get for not being friendlier?
...Tch. I guess I've got no right to say anything.
...Are you just being competitive, or---ngh. Does the idea of showing me not excite you...?
...It's your choice. Try and make me beg for it if you want.
All I can say is, if you go for something bigger, I'll never forget about you.
You weren't much to masturbate to, with all those clothes on.
This isn't the first time a man's upstaged me and I've had to sit and stew in it.
...I mean, I came right in front of you. I guess that doesn't mean much on Earth.
If you wanted to impress me, then you'd take me down in a dogfight. Or maybe just pull that tube out.
I wasn't even close to that tube. Men always manage bruise my ego.
...Maybe I should keep going, just to fill time.
You won't back off even a little. That's like men, too.
You're really taking this seriously.
I should've known I'd lose. Men aren't too skilled, but they've got dumb luck to spare.
{pyoro}...A gentleman must never be rude to a lady, ~name~.

{pyoro}Pyoro~...so you want to see this man's "penis," Meia?{!reset}
P-Pyoro, I wasn't going to just say it like that.
{pyoro}But you always say things like that.
...I had more patience for this sort of thing with my suit on.
...That makes my underwear inadequate just looking at it.
...You're not like the others somehow.
You should be glad it's us you're playing against. Jura's girlfriend has a short temper and bigger guns, as you may have noticed.
You should be glad it's me you're playing against. One of our pilots has a short temper and a gun collection.
{jura}What a nasty little tease. We'll take care of you, Leader.
~name~---does winning mean that much to you...?
Y-you...you really don't care about us at all...!
{jura}We're both more prettier than she is, anyway.
That's not very reassuring. If it starts to involve me, I'll fire on you. Do I make myself clear?
I don't need your reassurance. Unless your body can withstand laser shots, keep it away from me.
Don't talk down to me. I'm armed---so for your own sake, don't involve me.
Don't treat me as some helpless civilian. I'm not interested in fistfights, and I'll shoot if yours comes near me.
...Oh, of course. You're just friends...Earth girls don't see each other in that way.
...Right. Women's relationships are usually more intimate where I'm from...but not on Earth.
...Oh. You're just friends. You can blame my Mejarian upbringing for imagining other things...
...Only friends? Of course...I forgot I was on Earth. Mejare must be unique with how girls see each other...
I'm not far off from it as-is. But my closet is bare enough that I'd accept charity.
It would help to have one other outfit, fighting gear especially.
...I see. How many "past lives" do you have, exactly?
...Hm. So even the "Ini" I met wasn't the first alias you've adopted. How many are you up to?
...So, you've lived behind an alias for some time. I'm surprised you returned to a place you've been, then...I guess "Ini" is another pseudonym.
It's not surprising that a criminal would live behind a mask. First your personality, and now it turns out "Ini" was a fabrication, too...
...That is a mechanical rifle, isn't it? It's certainly lethal, but it's still centuries behind in both efficiency and stealth.
"Underestimating"? It's not a matter of power---it's resource efficiency, and the way shots can be heard and traced. Either way, it's superior to your axe.
It was your decision, hm? That's good to hear...girls should take charge of their lives.
I see. I was muscled into coming here myself...but if you chose this, then I'll be less worried about you panicking.
Good---I was hoping you were here of your own volition. Consider this a trial by fire.
That's just what I was hoping to hear. Girls have to choose to be pilots themselves---otherwise they'd panic and get us killed.
...What's "the Colony" to you? We're only a small pirate outfit.
