...I'd put our ship under fantastic, and that's how we left. What's your method?
So how do you move through it? It took "fantastic" things from our ship's fusion core to make it past that storm.
Our crew members can be childish sometimes. The woman who runs the reg crew isn't fazed by much, either, and she's about your age.
Most of our crew isn't that old, either. Maybe when we get immature, that calmness is how the commander feels, or the reg crew chief.

When the moment comes, it's often just instinct.
...But I'm the one taking action, not waiting for it.
I couldn't stand waiting around to find out. I don't even know how my crewmates relax on the ship.
It's a good thing. I think so, at least. Mejare likes a slim look.
...Do they prefer slender girls where you come from? My homeworld's the same way.
It turned out to be a cry for attention. She felt lonely and lashed out.
It was her way of getting noticed. It's easier to make enemies than friends.
...S-so, the latter. This was awkward enough without me misspeaking.
...That answers that. I didn't want to say the wrong thing, and cause a---misunderstanding.
...I guess that is a use. Some girls always order those defensive loadouts on their Dreads...
...I'll be thinking about that the next time I order shields in Reg.
I mostly got in fights instead.
It would've been healthier. I ended up fistfighting instead.
...For a while, that's how I wanted people to see me.
"Without feelings"...I used to want to give that impression.
There's plenty I could learn about Earth girls. Are they different kinds of customers?
I'm here to learn about Earth. That includes the girls. Do they treat you any different?
She's pretty hands-off. She convinced a lot of us to join in the first place, but there wasn't much alternative.
Most of us didn't have other options. Day-to-day, she leaves the orders to our commander.
...It wasn't with monsters, but maybe I can relate to the feeling.
...It's probably not the same, but I haven't had good experiences myself.
Magical? What do you---u-ugh! M-Marinette, you---!
...What do you mean, magic---agh! W-what's happening to you---?
I'm saying you'd balance out better. You never know when you might have to rely on your own strength.
Relying on any one thing is never a good idea. You'd be surprised how much better you might start to move.

That's sort of like what happened to me. There wasn't much choice of whether to fight or not.
...But my parents had nothing to do with that.
It wasn't my parents that wanted me to fight, but that's what ended up happening. Things just don't turn out like we expect.
...I didn't mean it like that. So is there some way you can---tell if they need it?
...I shouldn't have gotten mad. Are you saying you can---sense their feelings?
It's not like they don't know the truth.
...They know about it. And they probably know it's among my reasons, too.
There are better ways to build strength.
You could've just lifted weights instead of carrying it.
That I understand. You live your whole life thinking nothing will change---until it does.
...One morning, when you woke up, and nothing was the same anymore.
...Well, it's not something I can hide.
Just as long as the others know why my suit is bulging out...
...That's about what I expected from Earth. A whole planet of people who are missing pieces of themselves...
...When you need something so badly from others, it's because you don't have it yourself. Either it's self-esteem...or it's organs.
Uh...I couldn't stay committed to it. As you can see.
...You don't have to do it around us. I couldn't keep it up at all.
...The view is always clear. Even out my room's window, you can stargaze---watch whole galaxies drift by.
For one thing, stargazing is easy. The bridge's biopark has a clear top to look out of. You can see the white nebula Mejare's in.
...That sounds pretty good. If you can be yourself, you don't have sacrifice it.
When I hear others talk about it, they act like you've got to be two parts of a whole. As if you become less like yourself.
It's just not what I'm used to. The men onboard are all pretty good about their duties.
Our prisoners are pretty dependable. Some girls even call them too serious.
It's relaxing. It clears my head...always gives me a new challenge.
Think of it like a mountain with no peak.
...So what happened?
...Are you going to explain?
...We like how we look.
There's no excuse. We just like showing off.
Isn't it more like hiding your feelings? Dressing them up as other people, in another place.
...If that's the point, you could just say exactly what you mean.
...I've gotten that from girls, and only girls. I don't suppose you have a preference.
...Do you care if they're men or women?
...I don't think I'd make many compromises myself. But that turns people away.
I'm not telling you to change. I wouldn't. It's just...others might not want to change, either.
{pyoro}...Now she's making fun of me. Why don't I scan you for suspicious brainwave activity, huh?{!reset}<hr>Maybe you should...

{pyoro}Hey, lady, if you're gonna make this personal, I'll just directly ID you.{!reset}
Pyoro doesn't have directives to serve non-crew members.
If you've got the will for it, then I'm sure you'll be fine.
...That's the spirit. Maybe there's no need to worry.
Our crew's the same way, where it's a privilege to have goals longer-term than tomorrow.
...And just surviving is hard enough, let alone making plans for the future.
Fascinating...even Mejare hasn't progressed from designer hair colors to skin.
I was only concerned for your health. I trust that you're fine, but manipulating skin colors like yours is beyond even Mejare's genetic engineering.
I see...did your parents have blue skin, as well? My homeworld can create blue hair, as you can see, but skin is out of our reach...
If you say you're healthy, then I believe you. Still...between blue skin and rainbow hair, Earth's genetic feats are far beyond Mejare's.
...I'm better with actions than with words.
...Is it enough to stay silent?
Our captain is an old priestess. That's why we're her "Family." She even has the robes.
The boss of Magno's Family is a priestess. She still wears her robes, and she has prayer beads and tarot cards...
I'm sorry you have to deal with this, but we won't be sorry if we have to defend ourselves.
If we can understand it's out of your control, then you can understand that we might have to hurt you.
I mean...letting others do their part. And not just jumping ahead...
What I mean is---delegation. Things I could do myself, and want to, but...shouldn't.
...But not everyone does, then.
...So there are others who don't.
Maybe you know some Pokémon I'd get along with. And I'd let you try out a flight sim...
Too bad we can't try trading places. Our team has plenty of simulators...and you must know plenty of species.
I had an idol career as a girl. I was really carefree about it. But now...I'd have so much in mind.
I used to sing and dance like that, too. I was really little...it felt natural. Performing as an adult would have all those questions...
Mejare's system is the same way. Being so isolated makes it hard to accept others...or to be accepted.
Mejare is Earth's furthest colony---and the only one that's all-female. It's not easy to bridge those gaps...
...Drinking and fighting, mostly.
We'd trash bars and get in fights.
I see. That's always been hard for me, even when I know I won't be enough. And when the men joined, I got even worse...
...It's smart. I've often been too proud for it. Especially when the men came aboard...
...Is that it, then? A leader and a follower?
That's what you see in her... but what do you see in each other? I mean...as equals.
...You must prefer it that way. War would interfere with your studies...I figure.
...More time to study art and philosophy. Is that right?

W-what are you saying? He's right? How can that be...?
{pyoro}Even stolen organs should show up...
...What? I-I just thought he'd made an error...!<hr>{pyoro}C-could their life force diminish after so many stolen organs...?
...All at once?
...You mean, rather than worn down over time.

state.text: I-I see. I apologize for speaking to you more like a peer...
Ah, I---didn't realize. I should have been more respectful...

case.state: That's dangerous!
I would never tolerate this kind of negligence!
Are you trying to get us killed?
What's wrong with you?
Firearms aren't toys!
...Secret? What secret?
If your "secret" is breasts, I should remind you all women have them. Even some men do.
Breasts are no secret. Well, maybe on Tarak.
...I see you have a charming personality to match your skin tone. It's true we've never met alien life...but Earth has a history of twisted experiments.
...An alien...I have my doubts. Earth has never discovered alien life in its centuries of colonization...
..."Alien"? No human has encountered alien life, despite all our space exploration...you look like a modified woman.
...I'll be sure not to show concern for you in the future. Are you really a form of alien life?
...What did you call yourself? Mejare sees men as aliens, but honest alien life...right here? I assumed you were an Earth cyborg...
Underneath...your shirt? But why?
If I could undo my bra underneath my flightsuit, I wouldn't have to pirate for a living.
I consider strategy my strong suit...but I can't fathom what your endgame is here.
You can't be serious. How cowardly can you get?
Take your losses with dignity. Nothing's more embarrassing than a girl who can't own up to her failures.
Wearing makeup at all is already beyond me. To try to count it as an item is outright embarrassing...
Jura wears a lot of makeup, too...I hope she wouldn't try to count it as clothing.
Are you really that ashamed of your body? Or just of losing?
Don't waste everyone's time...have some respect for yourself.
You're a..."princess"? ...And for some reason this required disguising.
Is a "princess" some kind of leadership position? Is that why you wore an unconvincing disguise?
If you're a "princess" so desperate to remain disguised, then why did you show your face and play strip poker?
That was a disguise? I'm not interested in your politics.
Do you really need a trick to take off your clothes?
...I really wish you didn't treat this game as a magic showcase.
I'd appreciate it if you didn't waste time with parlor tricks.
I'm here for a brief game of wits, not magic tricks and lengthy showmanship.
If you think you're scaring me, I have to pilot against Earth's organ harvest fleet again tomorrow.
I'm sure you're very intimidating, Juri, but I deal with fleets of organ-harvesting robots for a living.
Street thugs don't impress me. I used to be one...and Earth's fleet of organ harvesters is a lot scarier.
During my days on the streets, I might've found you intimidating. Today I fear the organ harvesters Earth sends our way.
...What? You're saying complete nonsense. And are you really taking your shirt off already?
...Excuse me, Kizuna, I'm speaking to you. What's this gibberish about writing---and why are you starting with your shirt?
...Your choice of first strip is as nonsensical as whatever you're saying.
...Well, you certainly can start with your shirt. But what are you talking about, with "lines" and "writing"?
Isn't there any way to keep the blue one around? She at least has social skills.
At least you aren't waving a gun around this time...but your mouth is still just as filthy.
Fortunately, your split personality seems to keep you in check better than most maniacs.
Hello, Launch. For the third time now.
Wha---what's happening to you? There's an energy surge---!
...Marinette? What are you---what's going on?
Marinette, you're---glowing! What's the meaning of this?
A-agh! What's all this energy being released? Marinette---!
What's wrong? Is there something you're hiding?
...You seem a little uncomfortable to be taking that off. Besides the obvious reasons why.
...Misato? Are you alright? You're looking all flushed.
...So much for that comparison. Now you're taking the light away?
...Just when I compare her to the Paksis, she dispels it.
...Well, maybe we'll see what you look like now. I can't say I found the Paksis attractive.
...Hm. You looking like the Paksis reminded me of home...but I suppose this is more erotic.
I'm on a strange planet, and you want me to accept food? I'm not coming back to the ship with pink skin.
Judging by your skin color, you're eating far too many cupcakes. I'll pass...
Whatever's in your cupcakes, I don't want any. Bright pink skin can't be healthy, even if sugar were.
A cupcake? Fattening...from a foreign girl...might turn my skin pink. That's a lot of reasons to decline.
...Am I supposed to know this song?
Nothing about being a pirate is free, I promise you.
...Catchy.
All these shots and damage reports...it's like I never left the ship.
I certainly didn't picture a living ship taking damage today...it's as if I'm right back to work.
I can practically hear Belvedere's voice in my head, reporting this sort of damage to the Nirvana...
Every time you call out structural damage, instinct makes me want to rush to our hangar.
...Of course, being able to float would make it a lot easier for me to get out of mine.
I hope you realize how lucky you are to be blessed with these powers. I can't slip out of my suit so easily.

state.text: On the plus side, my suit zips in the front...but I think your levitation powers make it easier for you overall.
I guess floating makes removing your suit much easier than it is for me. Still, it can't be fun wrestling with a zipper in the back.

case.state: Already? Well...I guess all clothes are equal here.
For such a conservatively dressed girl, you're having a lot of fun with this.
Well, that didn't take long. I should have expected someone would strip like this.
That was fast. Is that modest look just a front?
Can't say I'm surprised. How many costumes can that thing give you?
How many costumes are available to you with that thing, anyway?
So if I rolled that die, would my outfit change? How many do you have?
It's sad how this doesn't even perturb me anymore.
I can't believe I've gotten used to this in the short time I've known you.
This really is spectacular. But couldn't you put it to better use than changing your clothes?
Agh! This power output...it's what I'd expect from the Paksis! What's happening to your body?
Ngh! It's---as if she's been enveloped by her own personal Paksis core! The energy it's giving off---!
Agh! Is this---the power held in that living uniform? It's massive---and her body is bonding with it!
"Animates"...is that your class of robot? There's only one recorded instance of a sentient robot on Mejare, and it was after one of our navigation units encountered the ship's Paksis core.
...So there's a whole production line of sentient machines like you. It took an accident with our energy core to spark emotions in one of our navigation robots.
Our crew actually has a navigation robot that's gained sentience---Pyoro, a unit that fell into our Paksis core. But it's not something we can reproduce.
Oh, that's---not necessary. Is there somewhere you can sit down...?
Oh---don't take off your prosthetics just for a game. You shouldn't have to be uncomfortable as you play.
Oh, are you...? You're already nude---there's no need to go further.
...You don't even look like you're wearing makeup. What're you...?
..."Makeup"? What're you talking about? Saki---?
...You're not wasting any time.
...Looks like you'd fit in back home.
Guess I'm not the only one going fast.
I figured this was coming...
If I'd kept up with you a little better...
Things are definitely getting interesting. Maybe I'll loosen up...
Haaah...hah. Don't worry about me.
It's good to see bigger items coming off. I came here in my underwear, more or less.
I'll be showing just as much if I don't keep hiking these up...
You hate to watch a girl pushed to the brink...
Girls need to be strong, ~name~...back home.
Showing skin is maybe a bigger deal on Earth...
And you'll make this interesting...?
We're reaching a turning point for all of us...
If you want some attraction, make me join you first...
Oh, you're...
If you're choosing that already...
If you're ready, with even that...
Don't get cold feet...
Men probably pull your clothes off all at once...
I can focus on women over men...with reason.
Looks, and leads, can be deceiving.
You...
Our quartermaster's a poker shark. We know how you feel...
Earth girls seem to dress heavier on average...
Piloting is more stressful.
We should have a flightsuit in your size...
{pyoro}Pyoro~! Surface scans are now complete, Meia! We're moving on to the---mantle...
That's not the kind of thing that encourages small talk...
This game is so stop-and-start...
Come on. This is what most are here for...
I don't suppose you consider yourself a pilot candidate...
Clothes just get in the way...
That's more like it.
I see....it looks like things are heating up.
You don't think about where we put on fat and muscle until you see men do it differently...
Standing in your underwear is nothing to be ashamed of.
I figured as much...we have little to hide now.
There wasn't much to guess about my outfit, and now it looks like you're in the same situation...
Things are evening up...
Don't make a fuss about showing underwear.
I don't have much use for bras and panties anymore. Things that can't be used as gym clothes...
Just when I was getting used to small talk.
I don't even know what most street clothes look like on me now...
Earth has beautiful nature. Don't be uncomfortable with yours...
Would you say girls here like bras and thongs, too?
{pyoro}More reports, Meia!{!reset}<hr>We're running out of opportunities...
Nothing really feels sufficient when I'm stuck naked...
A lot of our recruits are girls who used to be wealthy. They have to learn to be comfortable in their underwear, and then beyond...
We're really getting somewhere, and far too late...
You can walk around in a leotard, and yet underwear is "private"...
Nothing small, but nothing I'm happy with...
...What's the time? I usually check it on the watch in my suit...
...Does my situation make this easier for you?
We may be at a turning point. You must sense it, too...
Now does this make you want to win, or to strip some more...?

Hhnn...
You've got to show yourself now, huh? More or less.
S-seeing someone new is...s-so exciting...
It looks like...you're out of options. Almost...
Mhmhm...show me what you really look like.
Ngh---nn. You're getting serious, too...
That's more what I was looking for. Now it's how you own it...
S-still a world away...
So, there's not much left between us...

Some girls find underwear really exciting.
...Are there any men like that?
I hate being left out of the game, or any missions, too. It's put me in a bad spot before.
Why didn't we all start with the same amount of clothes?
If you think you're full of surprises, I consider that a male trait...
We're getting somewhere...the game's ending.
Well, now...
It's good to see bigger items coming off. I might as well be naked.
Guess I'm in the lead, at least while my suit is on.
{jura}Oh? You twitched a little. Is that from another fantasy, or...?
{barnette}Ah...I think ~name~'s getting serious, you two...

{meia}Ah!{!reset}
{jura}So you like the look of her, I take it?
{meia}~name~...y-you see how far we've gone. Back home, something like this...!
{jura}Don't complain about your underwear. I mean, look at us! You can see our butts...
..."Hate-fuck." Don't be ridiculous...blue hair is not enough to woo me.
Be quiet. No amount of sideline jeering is going to make a drunken soldier appealing to me.
...If you're trying to pair me with Sei because I have blue hair, Futaba, you two share a height.
...Yes, a "hate-fuck" would be the only way I'd ever find myself in bed with Sei. But don't count on it.
Uh...I guess that does suit you.
T-that's...an efficient solution.
You...seem a little hostile towards men. You didn't grow up on Mejare, did you?
Seems Mejarian relationships have a home on Earth, too...because you certainly aren't fond of men.
Take it easy, would you? Men aren't total monsters.
Your hatred of men puts Mejarians to shame. What did one do to you early in life?
So...you two are an item, I assume? And that's why you're defensive around men?
You...seem a little hostile towards men. Mejarian soldiers would certainly like robotic arms.
Seems Mejarian relationships have a home on Earth, too...because you certainly aren't fond of men. Is that how you lost your arm?
Take it easy, would you? Men aren't total monsters. I think they'd be afraid of your arm.
Your hatred of men puts Mejarians to shame. Did a man cut off your arm?
So...you two are an item, I assume? And that's why you're defensive around men...aside from losing your arm?
...Loners don't exactly fit in on a crew, do they?
...It's strange, isn't it? A crewmate insisting she's independent.
...If your pride's not the problem, then look for a good backup.
...Maybe you should seek out a second-in-command.
...Should we just leave you two alone? You seem to forming a romance as we speak.
...I didn't expect to see girlish love blooming here, but maybe I should have...what with the stripping.
You two...seem to be getting along. Good to see a familiar Mejarian relationship on this strange planet.
And I thought Earth girls exclusively liked men. You two are quickly becoming more than friends.
And the rambling drunkard claims I'm the agitator.
...You want to handle this girl, Jura? I think you two would get along better.
Can you take over this conversation, Jura? I'm sure you and Sei can find new ways to make fun of me.
I'd be happy to leave you alone. If only you'd do the same.
There's nothing to worry about, Marinette. I won't start a fight... and Sei is too inebriated to win one.
We don't need to be separated. Sei isn't much of a threat anymore---and I don't plan on provoking her.
Don't worry, Marinette. Even if Sei thinks about arresting me, she'll just trip over herself and fall asleep.
Earlier I might have been concerned about Sei's equipment, but now she can barely see straight. A fight won't take long, Marinette.
...I'm sorry you had to be subjected to this, Rin. But every girl who's cast aside eventually learns the truth about authority.
...Take this night as a warning, Rin---the state does not have your interests in mind.
Rin. The next time your planet's military claims to protect you, remember this image of a drunken imp.
...Always have respect for yourself, Rin, no matter what happens. Sei has all of her limbs, and she just abuses her authority.
You're drinking so much...don't you have to work tomorrow?
I can't be drinking like you...I don't get days off.
You don't have the height to be knocking all those drinks back.
Alcohol...empty calories.
Compared to this girl, Jura, you're downright temperate. Sorry I said anything.
Well, Jura, she's certainly giving you a comprehensive look into alien women's fashion.
Well, you're certainly keeping us on our toes.
Hm? Actual progress? Maybe I misjudged you...what do you think, Jura?

I see.
...It's weird hearing someone say they liked school. Fights were always a good excuse for me to get out of it.

...Oh.
And you like school? I was happy to miss classes sometimes---usually for fighting.
It's not a bad thing. Our crew tries to be a big family---and that means accepting everyone. Even men.
We're called Magno's Family for a reason. We don't reject people for not fitting in. We even came around on the men.
That's all anyone can ask of you.
That's what we tell recruits. We want their best, whatever it is.
You've got people to go back to. But that determination will keep you strong, no matter what.
Summoning that courage is what counts. But you've got other places to go besides our crew.
...From your mother? The captain's always telling me to relax...and enjoy life.
...The captain's always sharing advice with us, too. "It's worth living a long life."
You could just scare them out of a fight. Being a woman is a good start.
We prefer to terrify the enemy with our feminine charms.
...Maybe I would've skipped all that regardless.
...That doesn't sound like me, even then.
Most girls would say "have fun in all new ways."
Or maybe exchange "cute" for "hot."
..."Still"?
...You talk like you're running out of time.
The best part about those things is peeling them off---with nothing underneath.
There you go. Do it just like me---unzip.
You are more used to men. But accepting anyone's help still would've bothered me.
...Where I'm from, gender is everything. But I hated help from anyone, male or female.
Earthlings are used to both genders. Needing a man's help infuriated me---which may have been why it stuck.
...Where I'm from, gender is everything. I might have taken it better if it had been a girl...or maybe I wouldn't have accepted it at all.
...I see. If your life is short, you should try keep your options open.
There's no sense holding yourself back when you don't have long to wait.
Piracy isn't going straight. It just has a purpose...

If I was going to die, I wanted it to mean something.
...If by "going straight," you mean "joining pirates."
...I think they were flirting with you. I've met girls who spoke like that. I was one of them.
...They were probably catcalling you. It's not unique to men. I used to talk like that, too.
...This is the last time I try to make small talk about an Earth girl's interests.
And Jura wonders why I don't bother talking to people...
...At least you're passionate about it.
What's "1983"? I have no context for Earth years, Chiaki.
...Would you like it if I started rattling off my Dread's specifications?
Ah, yes. The enn-ee-ess. That explains everything. Thanks, Chiaki.
...Nayru? Are you alright? Blink if you can understand me.
...It stopped. Nayru, can you hear me? Say something.
...Nayru? Hello? You might just be feeling shock---try to relax.
...Are you alright, Nayru? It might've just torn your dress...try to speak, if it doesn't hurt.
...You must enjoy your work. I can't imagine taking sexuality so lightly....
...This is hardly my idea of fun. To watch girls strip nude every day so... casually...
...I would need an ulterior motive to be here...like studying Earth culture. Conflating sex and fun seems unwise...
Mixing fun and work seems ill-advised...but maybe that's the perspective of a fighter pilot. Sex seems so casual to you...
Tell me something I don't know. So they're just as mystifying to girls who live around them every day...
...You've lived around men your entire life, and you don't understand how they think, either? Unbelievable...
...Mejare would have you believe men don't feel anything at all. It's not encouraging to hear that Earth girls struggle with them, too.
I don't have time to observe men all day and figure them out. I was hoping Earth girls understood them better...
"Exciting"? Well...our prisoners certainly brought some intrigue of their own on board. And some---intimate cockpit seating.
"Exciting"...to a certain kind of girl, maybe. They have helped us unlock new power---provided I sit up against one of them.
I guess there's a certain "excitement" when joining my ship with a man's...for the power gained, not our---seating arrangement.
I have crewmates who find men's presence on our ship far more exciting than I do. Even when I co-pilot with one, it's...strange.
Their bodies? Well...some are certainly taller than others. But they're nothing like women...
Women's bodies are "nice." Men's are much broader, harsher...utilitarian. No matter the size...
...Well, men's bodies certainly aren't graceful like women's. They're built to destroy, or do heavy lifting.
I...suppose so. But next to women, men are so...angular. More suited for crushing rocks than caressing someone.
Comforting? Men's strength is the first thing Mejarians are warned about as girls. "Never let them catch you."
Therein lies the difference between Earth and Mejare. You see men's strength as a partner's protection---we see it as an enemy's weapon.
...Maybe if I trusted a man enough, that imposing strength would be a comfort. We were all spun stories about how they'd restrain us...
..."Comforting." Even as pirates, we're warned to never engage in hand-to-hand combat with men if we can help it. They're such burly animals...
I guess that's true...I've learned men aren't all the same beast. Some are shorter, some serious...some cowards.
...You're right. As a girl, I was taught men were all the same beastly, hulking monster. But some are actually intelligent...or handsome.
...I was hoping for general advice, but maybe men are just as complex as women...each one requires a different approach.
Surely there's general characteristics men share. I was always taught that there was nothing that made them different from each other.

I appreciate it.
...Out of curiosity, how many of your videos fit what I requested?
...You didn't consider that for long. Just how many of your videos feature you...taking a man's seed?
...That's the subject of most of your work in the first place, isn't it? How many videos have you and a man starred in?
...That was a rather paltry request, wasn't it? How much of your work features a man penetrating you?
..."Birth control"? So Earth girls use some sort of device to prevent pregnancy... that can't be flattering for the man.
"Birth control"? Oh, I see...you have a means of blocking men's seed. Still, that must put an air of mistrust over things...
...So, not only does sex with a man have a looming threat of unplanned pregnancy, but you can employ "birth control" and show you don't trust him.
...I see. I can't imagine there's much of an emotional bond with a man when you're desperately blocking his attempts to impregnate you.

This was an interesting spot for a game. Maybe I'll fly over and check the "London" that should be nearby...
I'd like to think I showed off a big pale moon of my own tonight. That's romantic, right?
Earth's moon has been looming over us all game. I think I'll go and see how we looked from there...
...OK. I'm not waiting for the rest of you to jump in.

This was a really nice place to play. Open air and a pretty pool...thanks.
...This wasn't really a bad place to play, it just---wasn't for me. Thanks anyway.
...Good game. If it were just more open in here...I think I would've liked it.
...It wasn't the wallpaper, but I'm feeling more romantic now. Take care.
Maybe this "decoration" is finally working its magic. So long, ~name~.
Happy Valentine's Day, ~name~. One more time for the road.
...So, did I bring you any love this Valentine's? I at least brought you some victory.
Didn't being so high up make it that much more thrilling? Maybe it's just the pilot talking...

If you thought the view from up here was nice, you should see it from the stratosphere.
...Time to go.
Aah...that was fun. Let's get the water going and wash up.
It took all game, but I'm finally happy to be by the showers.
...Mm. I hope you all enjoyed the sight as much as those holograms did.
Take us to a more neutral room next time. Someplace private.
I guess that grants you the throne, ~name~. You should know, though---pirates live outside the law.
I think I put on a pretty good show for the royal court. We certainly keep the empire's attention.
This was a really nice spot to play in...open air and a view of the sea. Now if only you served me some juice...
I'm sure the winner gets any drink they want. And the losers have to lie on top of the bar...
We have to go now...take care of this forest. They're not easy to make.

Good game.
...It was nice to see the "terra" in "terraforming."

In a place like this, you remember...we're all animals in a machine.
...See you.
Planet Earth...technology hiding flesh. How very fitting for our trip...

This epilogue is legacy content featuring older art.

The Nirvana...
Far in the future.
There you are.
It's good to see you again...~name~.
Welcome to the Nirvana.
I'm sorry I couldn't invite you to my home...or rather, this is my home.
I hope that uniform is comfortable. It's doing its job...you'll blend in with our lower-ranking guards.
That makes things easier for me...for us.
...You understand, right? I don't want my crewmates seeing me with some strange girl...
...There's no need for any rumors.
Don't take it personally. You're a sweet girl...
...One I enjoyed playing poker with.
I feel like I learned a lot from you.
...Come with me. We'll tour the ship.
We're right by my quarters...there isn't much to them, as you can see.
But I like to sit here and draw up flight schedules... schematics...that sort of thing.
Leading the squadron takes up a lot of my time. You're here with me in a rare moment of freedom.
Let's head out of the living areas...
Oh, hello, Leader!
Leader Meia! How are you?
Good evening, Gasma. And you, Fallopelle.
(S-she knows our names?)
Hush! U-uh, Leader, who's the new girl?
...This is ~name~, a new recruit. I'm showing her the ship. Leave us be.
Y-yes, ma'am!
Y-yes, ma'am!
Here we have the training room.
Weight machines, flight simulation consoles...very stimulating.
...You didn't say much during our game.
...Do you think I'm in good shape?
Here is the Nirvana's hangar, where our Dreads are stored.
...This? That's not a Dread. It's a Vanguard, a male vessel...
It can physically combine with a few of our Dread ships. Including mine.
We call the fusions Vandreads.
Yes, I'm aware of the parallels to man-woman sex in "combining" ships.
I think I preferred when I wasn't.
...And this is our energy core, the Paksis Pragma.
We believe it comes from technology made by the original Mejarian colonists from Earth...and Tarakkian, too.
It wields a power we don't fully understand...and it seems to feed off of our emotions.
...It seems to be shining brightly today.
Now to pass through the Regisystem, where our weapons are...
Off in a hurry someplace, Meia? Stay a while, play cards.
Oh, Gascogne...I'm sorry, but not tonight. We have a new recruit.
Is that the fresh face hiding behind you?
Normally I'm the one to give tours---you must really like this girl.
...~name~, this is our quartermaster, Gascogne.
I spoke highly of her, as you'll recall.
But we must be on our way.
Charmed by Meia's brand of stoicism, ~name~? You're not alone.
Gascogne---
I'll be off now. Smile, smile!
...I'm sorry about that.
Now, here we are at the final place I wanted to show you...the main one.
This is the Nirvana's hot springs and spa.
I know this is forward of me, but we were both willing to play strip poker...
So...would you like to take a bath with me?
Thank you for this. Is the water nice?
There's been rumors going around the ship about its effects.
More potent hormones, enlarged breasts...probably untrue.
I hope bathing nude isn't too awkward for you. It's how our crew likes it.
Even after that poker match, I wasn't sure how Earth girls felt about each other...
...W-well, I suppose there's no point hiding my intentions any further.
I made it perfectly clear during our game that our Mejarians see other girls in a sexual light...
And as we stripped down together...
...I couldn't take my eyes off of you, ~name~.
You're a beautiful girl...
One I could invite to the hot springs without risking my reputation with the crew.
I'd rather keep things professional there.
I'm sorry if you feel deceived. Earth girls...are only interested in men, aren't you?
~name~...
I-I never thought... you'd feel this way.
~name~...
Mm...
Oh, God...I'd forgotten what this felt like.
Hah!
Ngh...
Can't let you do all the work...
I like girls who can challenge me, ~name~.
That wasn't so I could roll over and let you have your way with me.
I hope you're in as good of shape as your figure implies.
Ah...
Nnh...
Y-you---how'd you know my breasts were so sensitive?
...I let that slip during the game, didn't I?
D-don't stop. I want to test that enlargement rumor...
Mmgh...
Mmm...
How is this? Let me know what feels good...
Here...
This is as close as two girls can get...
Short of one becoming the Fama for another's daughters, of course.
I've been told I'm good with children...
I'm sorry, I just met you. I shouldn't say things like that...
Mm...
Nnm...
You're very healthy...I can tell just from how you taste.
Mmnh...
Don't believe me?
Nnmh...
Well?
How's the water treating you? Do you feel more feminine?
I do...more than I have in a long time.
Ok...now do me.
I want to see what an Earth girl is capable of.
Mmh!
Oh, God...n-no, keep going...
~name~...I'm so glad to have...m-met you...
And in such...an unlikely place...
Ah!
Mgh!
~name~!
Mm!
Mmhn...!
Gah...
Mgh...
Hah...hah...
I underestimated you once again, ~name~.
But this time, I'm happy about that.
Unless you'd like to live a pirate's life, you'll have to leave the ship soon.
But the water's warm...we can relax here a little longer.
Mm...
Nnm...
There you are, Meia!
Who's that with her?
Hahahaha!
Leeeader! Why didn't you tell us you found a girlfriend?
D-Dita! N-no, I-I---!
Oh, Meia, I just knew you'd fall for someone at that strip bar!
It's---not like that...!
You went to a strip bar?
Jura---!
Oh, right, that was a secret. Of course, Barnette already shook it out of me!
We don't care if you date someone, Meia. At least it isn't a man.
It's not a date! And don't tell anyone---especially Gascogne!
Err...
...I've been here the whole time, actually.
Come on, Meia, tell us about ~name~ here!
Are you two getting married soon? You're already really mature!
Is she joining the crew? How good of a shot is she?
...I'm sorry, ~name~.
Let's all take a bath together, shall we?
